n-m-h3-prob-02.title: Imicimbi Emibili Engenakwenzeka Ndawonye: Ingabe Iyazimela?
n-m-h3-prob-02.goal: Hlukanisa u-"ayikwazi ukwenzeka ndawonye" no-"iyazimela," futhi uchaze isizathu usebenzisa incazelo yokuzimela (ukwazi eyodwa akushintshi ithuba lenye).
n-m-h3-prob-02.material: Idayisi elilungile liphonswa kanye. Umcimbi u-A ngu-"okuphumile kungu-1 noma 2," futhi u-B ngu-"okuphumile kungu-3 noma 4." Imicimbi emibili ayikwazi ukwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. UJimin wabona lokhu futhi wenza isimangalo esingezansi.
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.0: Nquma ukuthi isimangalo silungile yini usebenzisa ubufakazi
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.prompt: UJimin wathi, "Imicimbi u-A no-B ayikwazi ukwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye, ngakho ayithintani. Ngakho iyazimela." Isiphi isihlolo esifanele kakhulu sesimangalo sikaJimin?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga wena ukuthi kwenzekani ethubeni lika-B uma wazi ukuthi u-A wenzekile.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.1: Uma ziyazimela, ukwazi u-A kumele kushiye ithuba lika-B lifana nasekuqaleni. Qhathanisa ukuthi kunjalo yini kulesi simo.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.a: Kuphosile. Uma wazi ukuthi u-A wenzekile, u-B akasakwazi ukwenzeka, ngakho ithuba lika-B lihlukile kunalokho elalinakho ekuqaleni.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.b: Kulungile. Njengoba imicimbi emibili ingenzeki ndawonye, owodwa akashintshi ithuba lomunye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.b: Ufunde u-"ayikwazi ukwenzeka ndawonye" njengo-"ayithintani." Ukuthi umcimbi owodwa wenzeke wenza omunye angenzeki kuyithonya elinamandla uqobo.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.c: Kulungile. Njengoba u-A no-B benethuba elifanayo, owodwa akathinti omunye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.c: Amathuba alinganayo ngosayizi nokuzimela yizinto ezihlukile. Ukuzimela kumayelana nokuthi ithuba lowodwa lishintsha yini uma wazi omunye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.d: Kuphosile. Njengoba u-A no-B benamathuba ahlukile, owodwa uthinta omunye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.d: Amathuba ahlukile akusho ukuthi imicimbi ayizimele. Okufaneleukuqhathanise ukuthi ithuba lowodwa lishintsha yini uma wazi omunye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.explain: Uma u-A no-B bengenakwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye futhi ngamunye unethuba elikhulu kuno-0, ukwazi ukuthi u-A wenzekile kushintsha ithuba lika-B libe ngu-0. Uma bebezimele, u-P(B|A)=P(B) kwakumele kube yiqiniso, ngakho abazimele. Edayisini, lapho u-A engu-1 noma 2 no-B engu-3 noma 4, u-P(B)=1/3, kodwa uma u-A wenzeka, u-P(B|A)=0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngokuphonswa kwedayisi okufanayo, cabanga nangomcimbi u-C (okuphumile kungu-even) nomcimbi u-D (okuphumile kungu-3 noma ngaphansi). Khetha wonke amapheya emicimbi azimele komunye nomunye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kupheya ngalinye, thola u-P(yomibili imicimbi yenzeka) no-P(owokuqala)×P(owesibili) futhi uqhathanise ukuthi alingana yini.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngokubhala okuphumile okungamalungu emicimbi ngayinye, bese uthola okuphumile okungamalungu yomibili imicimbi.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.a: Uthathe ipheya elingenakwenzeka ndawonye njengelizimelayo. Uma elilodwa lenzeka, ithuba lelinye liba ngu-0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.d: Uthathe u-A ngokuqukethwe ku-D njengo-"akuhlangene." Uma u-A wenzeka, u-D uzokwenzeka ngokuqinisekile, ngakho ithuba lika-D liyashintsha.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.explain: U-P(A)=1/3, u-P(C)=1/2, futhi u-P(A∩C)=P({2})=1/6=P(A)P(C), ngakho u-A no-C bayazimela. U-B no-C nabo bayazimela, ngoba u-B∩C={4} no-1/6=1/3×1/2. Ku-A no-D, u-P(A∩D)=1/3 kodwa u-P(A)P(D)=1/6, ngakho abazimele. Imicimbi ingazimela noma ihlangana, futhi imicimbi engahlangani (uma amathuba ayo makhulu kuno-0) ayikwazi ukuzimela.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala incazelo ozoyithumela kuJimin. Ngokusekelwe ekutheni kusho ukuthini ukuthi u-A no-B bazimele, chaza ukuthi kungani u-A no-B bengazimele kulesi sibonelo sedayisi, usebenzisa u-"ithuba lika-B uma sazi ukuthi u-A wenzekile."
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ezisele uma wazi ukuthi u-A wenzekile, futhi ubone ukuthi ikhona yini kuzo engeka-B.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ithuba lasekuqaleni lika-B nethuba lalesi sikhathi eceleni komunye nomunye emshweni owodwa futhi uziqhathanise.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Uma wazi ukuthi u-A wenzekile, u-B ...
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubhale incazelo yokuzimela njengo-"ukwazi umcimbi owodwa akushintshi ithuba lomunye"?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kulesi sibonelo, usho kokubili ithuba lasekuqaleni lika-B nethuba lalo ngemva kokufunda ukuthi u-A wenzekile?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Usho ukuthi u-"ayikwazi ukwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye" no-"iyazimela" kuyahlukana?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.0: Uma imicimbi ibizimele, ithuba lika-B belizohlala ngu-1/3 ngisho nangemva kokwazi ukuthi u-A wenzekile. Kodwa uma u-A (1 noma 2) wenzeka, u-B (3 noma 4) akakwazi ukwenzeka, ngakho ithuba lakhe liba ngu-0. Ithuba liyashintsha, ngakho abazimele.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.1: Ekuqaleni, ithuba lika-B lingelokuthathu elilodwa. Kodwa uma sifunda ukuthi idayisi libonisa u-1 noma 2, bese u-3 noma 4 akunakwenzeka, ngakho ithuba lika-B lishintsha libe ngu-0. Uma bebezimele akumele lishintshe, kodwa lashintsha, ngakho abazimele.

n-m-h3-prob-08.title: Imali Yomklomelo Yomdlalo Onqanyuliwe: Kufanele Yahlukaniswe Kanjani?
n-m-h3-prob-08.goal: Hlela ulwazi oludingekayo ukuthola ithuba lokunqoba, bese wenza isikhala sesampula esilinganayo ngokucabanga ukuthi umdlalo ozophela ngaphambi kwesikhathi uyadlalwa ukuze uphele.
n-m-h3-prob-08.material: Ithimba A neThimba B bebedlala umdlalo lapho ithimba lokuqala elinqoba imidlalo emi-3 lithatha wonke umklomelo ongu-80,000 won, kodwa wanqanyulwa ngenxa yesizathu esithile. Kuze kube manje iThimba A linezinqobo ezi-2 futhi iThimba B linenqobo e-1. Amathimba amabili avumelana ukuhlukanisa umklomelo ngokulingana "nethuba lokuthi ithimba ngalinye linqoba emidlalweni esele."
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi kungani ukucabanga akushintshi umphumela
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.prompt: Ithimba A neThimba B bebedlala umdlalo lapho ithimba lokuqala elinqoba imidlalo emi-3 lithatha wonke umklomelo ongu-80,000 won, kodwa wanqanyulwa. Kuze kube manje iThimba A linezinqobo ezi-2 futhi iThimba B linenqobo e-1. Umklomelo uzohlukaniswa ngokulingana nethuba lokunqoba lethimba ngalinye. Khetha lonke ulwazi oluyisidingo ukuthola la mathuba. (Akukho okwaziwayo mayelana namazinga amakhono amathimba.)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.0: Susa ucezu ngalunye lolwazi oluyedwa ngesikhathi bese ucabanga ukuthi ithuba lokunqoba lekusasa lingabalwa yini ngaphandle kwalo.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi udinga ini ukuze wazi ukuthi imidlalo emingaki eyengeziwe ithimba ngalinye elidinga ukuyinqoba ukuze libe ngumnqobi.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.a: Ukulandelana kwemidlalo enqotshiwe kuze kube manje (ukuthi kwakungu-A, B, A)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi ukulandelana kubalulekile. Ithuba lokunqoba lekusasa lincike enanini lezinqobo zamanje nemidlalo esele; ukulandelana lapho izinqobo zaqongelelana khona akunamthelela.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.b: Inani lezinqobo zethimba ngalinye kuze kube manje (izinqobo ezi-2 nenqobo e-1)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.c: Inani lezinqobo ezidingekayo ukuze kube ngumnqobi (okokuqala ukunqoba okuyi-3)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.d: Isikhathi umdlalo osuthathe sona kuze kube manje
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.d: Isikhathi asinasidingo nezinqobo nokulahlekelwa kwekusasa. Cabanga ukuthi ulwazi olunomthelela ethubeni lokunqoba yini.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.e: Ithuba lokuthi ithimba ngalinye linqoba umdlalo owodwa
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.explain: Izinombolo zezinqobo zamanje nezinqobo ezidingekayo ukuze kube ngumnqobi zinquma ukuthi imidlalo emingaki eyengeziwe ithimba ngalinye elidinga ukuyinqoba (u-A udinga umdlalo o-1, u-B udinga imidlalo emi-2), futhi ithuba lokunqoba umdlalo ngamunye linquma ithuba lokuthi lokho kwenzeke. Ukulandelana kwezinqobo nesikhathi esithathiwe akuthinti imidlalo esele, ngakho akudingeki.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi amathimba amabili anethuba elilinganayo lokunqoba umdlalo owodwa futhi imidlalo ayithinti omunye nomunye. Thola ithuba lokuthi iThimba A linqoba ubuqhawe, bese ubhala nemali yomklomelo iThimba A okufanele iyitholile. Faka esixazululweni sakho ukuthi amacala abaliwe angawaphi.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi kufanele kwenzekeni emidlalweni esele ukuze iThimba A linqobe nokuthi iThimba B linqobe.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ngisho umdlalo uzophela ngaphambi kwesikhathi, cabanga ukuthi ukucabanga ukuthi yonke imidlalo esele iyadlalwa kukuvumela yini wenze amacala alingane.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ucabange ngamacala lapho iThimba A linqoba nalapho iThimba B linqoba ngokuhlukile?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhethe amacala ukuze elinye ngalinye lilingane?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uhlukanise imali yomklomelo usebenzisa amathuba?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.0: Uma sicabanga ukudlala yomibili imidlalo esele, imiphumela emine (A,A),(A,B),(B,A),(B,B) ilingana. Ukuze u-B anqobe, u-B kufanele anqobe yomibili imidlalo, okuyi-(B,B) kuphela, ngakho u-B unengxenye e-1/4 no-A u-3/4. Ngakho u-A kufanele atholile u-60,000 won no-B u-20,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.1: Ukuze u-B anqobe, u-B kufanele anqobe imidlalo emibili esele ilandelana, futhi leli thuba li-1/2×1/2=1/4. Ngakho ithuba lokuthi u-A anqobe li-3/4, futhi u-A kufanele atholile u-60,000 won emklomelweni ongu-80,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.prompt: UMinji uthe, "Uma u-A enqoba umdlalo olandelayo umdlalo uyaphela, ngakho akulungile ukucabanga ukudlala yomibili imidlalo esele, ngoba lokho kuhlukile kulokho okuzokwenzeka ngempela." Yiyiphi impendulo efanele kakhulu esitatimendeni sikaMinji?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.0: Thola ithuba lemiphumela emithathu umdlalo wangempela ongaphela ngayo, bese uhlola ukuthi ayengeza ku-1.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.1: Uma yomibili imidlalo esele idlalwa, yenza ithebula elibonisa ukuthi ngubani onqoba ubuqhawe emiphumeleni ngayinye emine.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.a: Imidlalo emibili eyengeziwe idlalwa ngempela, ngakho yonke imiphumela emine ingenzeka.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.a: Le ncazelo iphikisana neqiniso lokuthi umdlalo uphela ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Abadlali yonke ngempela.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.b: Inani lemidlalo kuze kube sekupheleni kufanele lifane ukuze umklomelo wahlukaniswe ngokulingana.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.b: Usekele ukulingana enanini lemidlalo kuze kube sekupheleni. Isilinganiso ithuba lokunqoba.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.c: Kungukulula nje, ngakho akunandaba inqobo nje uma inani lilungile.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.c: Awusho ukuthi kungani inani lilungile. Kunesizathu sokuthi kulungile ukubheka kanjena.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.d: Imidlalo ngemva kokuba umdlalo unqunyiwe ayishintshi ithimba elinqobayo, ngakho umphumela ufanayo noma yonke idlalwa.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.explain: Uma u-A enqoba umdlalo olandelayo, u-A ungumnqobi, futhi imidlalo yangemuva ayishintshi umnqobi. Ngakho nakuba sicabanga ukuthi yomibili imidlalo esele iyadlalwa, "ukuthi ngubani onqoba ubuqhawe" akushintshi, futhi imiphumela emine ngayinye ilingana ngo-1/4, okwenza ukubala kube lula. Uma siphatha izindlela ezintathu umdlalo wangempela uphela ngazo ("u-A unqoba" ngo-1/2, "u-B unqoba bese u-A enqoba" ngo-1/4, "u-B unqoba kabili ilandelana" ngo-1/4) njengezilinganayo, lokho akulungile.

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.title: Uma Sihlanganisa Amathemu, Isamba Siyafana?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.topic: Uchungechunge: izamba ezingaphelele noluchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungenamkhawulo
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.goal: Ngokubhala wena izamba ezingaphelele, hlola futhi uchaze ukuthi ukuhlangana kochungechunge olunamathemu ahlanganisiwe akusivumeli sisho ukuthi uchungechunge lokuqala luyahlangana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.material: Abangani abathathu bayaphikisana ngokuthi isamba sochungechunge 1−1+1−1+1−1+… singakanani. Ulwazi lwembulwa kancane kancane. (Ithemu elijwayelekile ngu-(−1)^(n−1): 1 uma u-n engaphindwayo, −1 uma u-n ephindwayo.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.1: Ukwahlulela ukuhlangana kochungechunge usebenzisa izamba ezingaphelele
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlela ukuthi iyiphi indlela ebambayo phakathi kochungechunge olwehlanganisiwe noluchungechunge lokuqala
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.prereq.1: Ukuchaza isamba sochungechunge njengomkhawulo wezamba zalo ezingaphelele
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.prompt: Esiteji ngasinye, khetha isinqumo usebenzisa kuphela lokho okwaziwayo kuze kube manje.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.0: Uma kuvela ulwazi olusha, cabanga futhi ukuthi isinqumo osikhethe ngaphambili sisafanelekile yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala izinhlobo ezimbili zokuhlanganisa ezihlukile bese uqhathanisa ukuthi inani elifanayo liyaphuma noma amathemu ahlanganiswa kanjani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.info: UMina wahlanganisa amathemu amabili ngesikhathi futhi wabhala (1−1)+(1−1)+(1−1)+…, ngakho iqembu ngalinye elikubakaki lingu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unquma ukuthi isamba salolu chungechunge singakanani?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuye ngokuthi amathemu ahlanganiswa kanjani, kuphume u-0 no-1 bobabili. Ngakho ungabona ukuthi kusekhona ukuthi usho isamba nje ngoba "ngihlanganise ngendlela eyodwa."
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wamukele umphumela wokuhlanganisa okukodwa njengesamba. Lesi isinqumo sokuqala esifika engqondweni.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ngu-1: ngoba ukushiya ithemu lokuqala u-1 bese uhlanganisa njengo-1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+… kunika u-1

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kusenesikhathi sokunquma: sidinga ukuhlola ukuthi inani lifana yini uma sishintsha ukuhlanganisa
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Usola ukuthi umphumela ungashintsha kuye ngokuthi amathemu ahlanganiswa kanjani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ukubhala izamba ezingaphelele ngokulandelana kunika u-S_1=1, S_2=0, S_3=1, S_4=0, S_5=1, ….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uchungechunge luchazwa ngomkhawulo wezamba zalo ezingaphelele. Manje unquma kanjani?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Izamba ezingaphelele azisondeli enanini elilodwa, ngakho lolu chungechunge luyahlukana. Isamba salo asinqunywa.

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Kodwa uchungechunge 0+0+0+… uMina alwenzile ngokuhlanganisa luyahlangana ngokucacile lufike ku-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kusukela eqinisweni lokuthi uchungechunge olwehlanganisiwe luyahlangana, singasho ini ngoluchungechunge lokuqala?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma uchungechunge lokuqala luhlangana, uchungechunge olwehlanganisiwe luhlangana lufike enanini elifanayo. Kodwa okuphambene akubambi, ngoba uchungechunge olwehlanganisiwe lusebenzisa kuphela u-S_2, S_4, ….

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Usebenzise umqondo wokuthi ukuhlanganisa kugcina isamba singashintshi ezinkombeni zombili.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Akukho okungenqunywa: ngoba izamba ezingaphelele zochungechunge olwehlanganisiwe ziyizinye kuphela zezamba ezingaphelele zokuqala
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukhombe ukuthi uchungechunge olwehlanganisiwe lusebenzisa ezinye kuphela zezamba ezingaphelele zokuqala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Isamba sochungechunge lokuqala singu-0 no-1 bobabili: ngoba indlela ngayinye yokuhlanganisa inesamba
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uthe uchungechunge olungahlangani lunezamba ezimbili. Isamba sichazwa njengomkhawulo owodwa wezamba ezingaphelele.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ukubala u-0 ngokuhlanganisa kwabonakala kunengqondo, kodwa isinqumo sakho sashintsha uma ubhala izamba ezingaphelele. Ukuthi uchungechunge luhlangana yini akunqunywa indlela luhlanganiswa ngayo kodwa ukuziphatha kwazo zonke izamba ezingaphelele S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.prompt: U-Soyoung wathi, "Ukuhlanganisa ngamabakaki kunike 0+0+0+…, ngakho isamba se-1−1+1−1+… singu-0." Bhala incazelo ozoyithumela ku-Soyoung. Faka ukuthi izamba ezingaphelele zochungechunge lokuqala ziziphatha kanjani nokuthi izamba ezingaphelele zochungechunge oluhlanganisiwe zihlobana kanjani nezamba ezingaphelele zokuqala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale u-S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4 wena bese uphawula ukuthi amanani ashintsha kanjani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khomba ukuthi yiziphi izamba ezingaphelele zokuqala eziyizamba ezingaphelele zochungechunge olwehlanganisiwe (1−1)+(1−1)+….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlolile ngempela amanani ezamba ezingaphelele S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi yiziphi izamba ezingaphelele zokuqala olusebenzisa uchungechunge olwehlanganisiwe?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi "uchungechunge olwehlanganisiwe luyahlangana" luqinisekisa "uchungechunge lokuqala luyahlangana"?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.0: Izamba ezingaphelele zochungechunge lokuqala ziyi-1, 0, 1, 0, …, zishintshana phakathi kuka-0 no-1 futhi aziqondi enanini elilodwa. Ngakho alunasamba. Izamba ezingaphelele zochungechunge olwehlanganisiwe zikhetha ezinye kuphela (ezinezinombolo ezilinganayo), njenge-S_2, S_4, …, ngakho kwenzeke ukuthi kuphuma kungu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.1: Izamba ezingaphelele ziphinda 1,0,1,0 futhi azihlangani. Uma sishintsha ukuhlanganisa kube ngu-1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+…, kunika u-1, ngakho inani lincike ekuhlanganiseni. Ukuthi uchungechunge olwehlanganisiwe lungu-0 akunakho ukwenza nesamba sochungechunge lokuqala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.2: Soyoung, S_n yochungechunge lokuqala ingu-1 kuma-n angalinganile futhi 0 kuma-n alinganayo, ngakho ayinawo umkhawulo (iyahlukana). Ukuhlanganisa ngamabakaki kusho ukubheka u-S_2, S_4, … kuphela, ezinika u-0, ngakho akuyona ubufakazi bokuthi uchungechunge lokuqala luyahlangana.

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.topic: Uchungechunge: izamba ezingaphelele noluchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungenamkhawulo
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.title: Ingabe 0.999… Incane Kancane Kuno-1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.goal: Chaza, usebenzisa umkhawulo womehluko, ukuthi umkhawulo ungaba yisamba noma izamba ezingaphelele zingafinyeleli kuwo, bese wakha olunye uchungechunge olunesakhiwo esifanayo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.material: Abangane ababili bayaphikisana ngokuthi 0.999… (ngama-9 aphindaphindwa unomphela) alingana no-1 yini. UYuna: "0.9, 0.99, 0.999, … ahlala encane kuno-1 noma ungena kangakanani, ngakho 0.999… incane kuno-1." UDohyun: "0.999…=9/10+9/100+9/1000+…, okuwuchungechunge lwe-geometric olungapheli olunegama lokuqala 9/10 nesilinganiso esivamile 1/10, ngakho isamba saso singu-1."
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.0: Ukuhlunga ukuthi ubufakazi besitatimende busekela isiphetho saso yini
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.prompt: Hlola izitatimende nobufakazi babangane ababili bese ukhetha isinqumo esifanele kakhulu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ngokwehlukana ukuthi ubufakazi buka-Yuna buyiqiniso yini nokuthi isiphetho saso silandela kubo yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi isamba sochungechunge sichazwa njani, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ukubala kuka-Dohyun kuyahambisana naleyo ncazelo yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.a: UDohyun ulungile: isamba sochungechunge singumkhawulo wezamba zaso ezingaphelele, futhi izamba ezingaphelele zisondela ku-1 ngokuthanda
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.a: Wahlulele ngokuya ngencazelo yesamba (umkhawulo wezamba ezingaphelele). Ubone nokuthi ubufakazi buka-Yuna abuholeli esiphethweni saso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.b: Isamba asinqunyiwe: ngoba izamba ezingaphelele ziyaqhubeka nokushintsha unomphela futhi azikwazi ukuba nenani elilodwa
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.b: Uxubanise izamba ezingaphelele eziqhubeka zishintsha nokungahlangani. Noma zishintsha, uchungechunge luyahlangana uma zisondela enanini elilodwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.c: UYuna ulungile: akukho samba esingaphelele esilingana no-1, ngakho 0.999… ihlukile ku-1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.c: Udlulisele isakhiwo sesamba ngasinye esingaphelele ngqo emkhawulweni. Umkhawulo awuyona neyodwa yezamba ezingaphelele.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.d: Bobabili balungile: 0.999… incane kuno-1 ngenani elincane ngokuthanda, kodwa ekubaleni iphathwa njengo-1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.d: Usho ukuthi umehluko ophelele nowu-1 uyasala, futhi washo nokuthi ulingana no-1. Phakathi kwezinombolo ezingempela, izinombolo ezimbili ziyafana kuphela uma umehluko wazo ungu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.explain: Isamba sochungechunge singumkhawulo wezamba ezingaphelele S_n. Lapha S_n=1−(1/10)^n futhi umkhawulo ungu-1, ngakho 0.999…=1. Ubufakazi buka-Yuna buyiqiniso, kodwa kusuka ku-"zonke S_n zincane kuno-1" akulandeli ukuthi "lim S_n incane kuno-1" (emkhawulweni iba ≤).
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.prompt: Isitatimende sika-Yuna esithi "noma ungeza kuze kufike ku-n onoma yimuphi, isamba esingaphelele sincane kuno-1" siyiqiniso. Kodwa isiphetho saso siphutha. Chaza isizathu usebenzisa u-1−S_n, inani lika-1 elikhishwe isamba esingaphelele S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala u-S_1, S_2, S_3 bese ubhala umehluko wesinye ngasinye no-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.1: Xhumanisa ukuthi lowo mehluko uziphatha kanjani uma n ikhula nokuthi isamba sochungechunge sinqunywa njengomkhawulo wani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uxhumanise leli nani lisondela ku-0 nesamba esingu-1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi umkhawulo ungaba ngu-1 noma izamba ezingaphelele zingafinyeleli ku-1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.0: 1−S_n=1/10^n ihlala inkulu kuno-0, ngakho kuyiqiniso ukuthi S_n incane kuno-1. Kodwa njengoba n ikhula, 1/10^n isondela ku-0 ngokuthanda, ngakho umkhawulo we-S_n ungu-1, futhi njengoba isamba sochungechunge singumkhawulo owu, 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.1: Akukho samba esingaphelele esikaze sifinyelele ku-1, kodwa 1−S_n=(1/10)^n iyahlangana ibe ngu-0. Isamba sochungechunge singumkhawulo wezamba zaso ezingaphelele, ngakho singu-1. Noma zonke izamba ezingaphelele zincane kuno-1, umkhawulo ungaba ngu-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.2: Yonke S_n incane kuno-1, kodwa umehluko 0.00…01 uba mncane ngokuthanda njengoba n ikhula, ngakho umkhawulo ungu-1, ngakho 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.prompt: Yakha wena uchungechunge olunesakhiwo esifanayo. Faka uchungechunge lwe-geometric olungapheli oluwu-2 a + ar + ar² + … olunegama lokuqala a nesilinganiso esivamile r lapho isamba singu-1 futhi zonke izamba zalo ezingaphelele zincane kuno-1, usebenzisa izilinganiso ezivamile ezihlukile. (Ungafaka amadesimali.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi isibalo sini okufanele sibe khona phakathi kuka-a no-r ukuze isamba sibe ngu-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bala u-S_1 no-S_2 ukuhlola ukuthi r kufanele ibe nophawu luni ukuze zonke izamba ezingaphelele zibe zincane kuno-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Inani eliphelele lesilinganiso esivamile lingaphansi kuka-1, ngakho luyahlangana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c1: |r|<1 ayisebenzi, ngakho akulona uchungechunge oluhlangana olunesamba esingu-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Wonke amagama anhle, ngakho izamba ezingaphelele zincane kuno-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c3: Isilinganiso esivamile asinhle, ngakho isamba esingaphelele singadlula u-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.explain: Uma a=1−r no-0<r<1, isamba esingaphelele S_n=1−r^n sihlala sincane kuno-1 kodwa umkhawulo waso ungu-1. a=0.9, r=0.1 yi-0.999… ngqo. Uma r ingekho kahle, a=1−r>1, ngakho isamba esingaphelele sokuqala sesivele sidlula u-1.

n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sika-Seojin.
n-m-h3-integc-01.title: Ungalithemba Yini Inani Elitholwe Nge-Integration By Parts?
n-m-h3-integc-01.topic: I-Integration: amaphutha e-integration by parts nokuhlola ngophawu lwe-integrand
n-m-h3-integc-01.goal: Thola futhi ulungise umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni se-integration-by-parts, bese uchaza ukuthi ungahlola kanjani uphawu lwe-definite integral usebenzisa uphawu lwe-integrand, nemikhawulo yaleso sihloko sokuhlola.
n-m-h3-integc-01.material: USeojin uxazulule i-∫_0^π x sin x dx usebenzisa i-integration by parts. (∫_0^π ngu-definite integral kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-π. [F]_0^π = F(π) − F(0).)
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.1: Qagela uphawu lwe-definite integral ngophawu lwe-integrand
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.2: Phenya uhla lapho indlela yokuhlola isebenza khona (izikhawu lapho uphawu lushintsha khona)
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Emugqeni ngamunye onikeza umsebenzi osanda kutholwa (u', v), hlola lowo msebenzi ngesimo sokuqala.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Emugqeni lapho v itholakala khona, hlukanisa v wena bese uhlola ukuthi ilingana no-v' yini.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.0: Ku-∫_0^π x sin x dx, vumela u=x no-v'=sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.2: Ngefomula ye-integration by parts, ∫_0^π x sin x dx = [x cos x]_0^π − ∫_0^π 1·cos x dx.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.3: [x cos x]_0^π = π·cos π − 0 = −π, futhi ∫_0^π cos x dx = [sin x]_0^π = 0.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wesi-2 uwokuqala ohamba kabi. I-derivative ye-cos x ngu-−sin x, ngakho i-v enokuthi v'=sin x ngu-−cos x, hhayi cos x. Kusukela emugqeni wesi-3 kuqhubeke, i-v engalungile ifakwa nje efomulani, ngakho ifomula nezibalo zilungile kodwa umphumela awulungile.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa ongalungile bese uthola inani le-∫_0^π x sin x dx. Bese, usebenzisa uphawu lwe-x sin x ku-0≤x≤π, bhala emshweni owodwa noma emibili ukuthi kungani u-−π kaSeojin engeke abe yinani.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Thola kabusha u-v onenzi v'=sin x, uyifake kufomula yomugqa 3, bese ubala emikhawulweni.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ethebuleni ukuthi u-x no-sin x ngamunye okungenani ungu-0 ku-0≤x≤π yini, bese ucabanga ukuthi i-definite integral yomsebenzi okungenani ongu-0 inophawu olunjani.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Uma silungisa u-v, ..., futhi inani ngu-.... Kodwa u-x sin x ...
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ulungise u-v waba ngu-−cos x bese uwubuyisela kufomula?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ucaphune ukuthi u-sin x okungenani ungu-0 ku-0≤x≤π njengesizathu sakho?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uxhumanise isici sokuthi uma i-integrand okungenani ingu-0, i-definite integral okungenani ingu-0?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.0: Uma v'=sin x, khona-ke v=−cos x. [−x cos x]_0^π + ∫_0^π cos x dx = π + 0 = π. Ku-0≤x≤π, x≥0 no-sin x≥0, ngakho x sin x≥0, okusho ukuthi i-definite integral ayinakuba yinegative (−π).
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.1: Uma ulungisa u-v waba ngu-−cos x, inani ngu-π. Esikhawini u-x sin x uhlala okungenani engu-0, ngakho njengendawo ayikwazi ukuphuma ngaphansi kuka-0, futhi u-−π unegative, okuyingxabano.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.prompt: Manje kusetshenziswa umsebenzi ofanayo, kodwa isikhawu sishintshelwe ku-[0,2π]. Khetha isitatimende esilungile mayelana nendlela yokuhlola uphawu lwe-definite integral usebenzisa uphawu lwe-integrand.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Hlola uphawu lwe-sin x ku-[π,2π] bese ucabanga isimo segrafu ye-x sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Uma kukhona izingxenye eziyipositive nezinegative, cabanga ukuthi uphawu lwesamba luncike kuphi.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.a: U-x sin x okungenani ungu-0 ku-[0,2π], ngakho inani nalo kufanele libe yipositive.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.a: Hlola uphawu lwe-sin x ku-[π,2π]. Awuhlolanga ukuthi uphawu lusala lufana yini lapho isikhawu sishintsha.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.b: Nakuba uphawu lushintsha, ingxenye eyipositive iza kuqala, ngakho inani lihlala liyipositive.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.b: Ubheke kuphela ukulandelana ngaphandle kokuqhathanisa osayizi bezingxenye eziyipositive nezinegative. Ingxenye enegative ingaba nkulu.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.c: Uphawu lwe-x sin x lushintsha ngaphakathi kwesikhawu, ngakho uphawu kuphela alukwazi ukunquma uphawu lwenani.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.c: Uqaphele ukuthi ukuhlola uphawu kuyithuluzi elingasetshenziswa esikhawini lapho uphawu luyohlobo olulodwa.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.d: Nakuba isikhawu sandiswa, ingxenye eyengeziwe iyahambisana, ngakho inani lingu-π, linjengelo ku-[0,π].
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi isikhawu esingeziwe [π,2π] sizohambisana ngaphandle kokuhlola i-integral yaso ngqo.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.explain: Ku-[π,2π], sin x≤0, ngakho x sin x≤0. Ngakho uphawu aluhlobo olulodwa kulo lonke isikhawu, futhi ingxenye eyipositive nenegative ziyashayisana. Eqinisweni, [−x cos x + sin x]_0^{2π} = −2π, enegative. Ukuhlola uphawu kukutshela uphawu lwenani kuphela uma uphawu lungashintshi ngaphakathi kwesikhawu.

n-m-h3-integc-08.title: Indawo Yesifunda Esifanayo: Abantu Ababili, Izixazululo Ezimbili Ezihlukile
n-m-h3-integc-08.topic: Ukuhlanganisa: indawo — ukuhlanganisa ngokuya nge-x nangokuya nge-y (ukushintsha ukumelelwa)
n-m-h3-integc-08.goal: Chaza, usebenzisa isimo sesifunda, ukuthi kungani ukuhlanganisa ngokuya nge-x nokuhlanganisa ngokuya nge-y kunika indawo efanayo yesifunda esifanayo, futhi unqume izimo lapho indlela yesibili ingasetshenziswa khona.
n-m-h3-integc-08.material: Abantu ababili bathola indawo yesifunda u-R esibiyelwe yijika u-y=ln x, i-x-axis, nomugqa u-x=e besebenzisa izindlela ezihlukile. UJian wazixazulula u-∫_1^e ln x dx ngokuhlanganisa ngezingxenye futhi wathola u-[x ln x − x]_1^e = (e−e)−(0−1) = 1. USoyul wakhipha u-∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1 endaweni u-e yesikwele sentathu u-0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1, futhi wathola u-e−(e−1)=1. (U-∫_1^e uyi-definite integral kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-e.)
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.1: Hlola ngesithombe ukuthi yisiphi isifunda esikhishwayo
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.2: Nquma izimo lapho indlela isebenza khona (ukuhambisana kwesisodwa nesisodwa)
n-m-h3-integc-08.prereq.1: Imisebenzi ehlukile ne-definite integral yemisebenzi ye-logarithmic ne-exponential
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.prompt: Esithombeni, u-∫_0^1 eʸ dy ayikhipha uSoyul ku-e uyindawo yengxenye iyiphi?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha ubude u-y, udwebe umugqa oyedwa ovundlile ngaphesheya kwesikwele sentathu, bese uthola indawo lapho ijika lisika khona lowo mugqa.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kulowo mugqa, chaza ukuthi u-R uhlangothini luni lwejika, kwesokhohlo noma kwesokunene.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.a: Isifunda u-R uqobo, esifuna indawo yaso
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.a: Indawo ka-R inani elitholwa ngokukhipha lesi sisho ku-e. Uma u-R ubefana nesifunda salesi sisho, kwakungeke kudingeke ukukhipha ku-e.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.b: Insalela yesikwele sentathu u-0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 ngemuva kokususa u-R
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.b: Ubone ukuthi iyingxenye ekwesokhohlo sejika u-x=eʸ, okungukuthi, ingxenye yesikwele sentathu engeyona u-R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.c: Ingxenye engaphansi kwejika u-y=ln x ne-1≤x≤e
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.c: Leyo ngxenye ingu-R ngqo. USoyul akakhipheli u-R ku-e, ukhipha insalela.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.d: Ku-0<x<1 ijika liphansi kwe-x-axis, ngakho alisona ingxenye ka-R, futhi alihlangene nalesi sisho.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.explain: Indawo yesikwele sentathu u-0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 ingu-e. Ebudeni ngabunye u-y, indawo yejika ingu-x=eʸ, ngakho ububanzi bengxenye ekwesokhohlo bungu-eʸ, futhi indawo yaso ingu-∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1. U-R uyingxenye ekwesokunene sejika, ngakho indawo yaso ingu-e−(e−1)=1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.prompt: Ulandela indlela kaSoyul, thola indawo yesifunda esibiyelwe ngu-y=ln x, i-x-axis, nomugqa u-x=e². Bonisa ububanzi nobude besikwele sentathu ne-definite integral ekhishwayo, futhi ubhale umphumela.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Thola ubude bejika ku-x=e², u-y=ln e², ukuze unqume ubude besikwele sentathu.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ebudeni ngabunye u-y, veza i-x-coordinate yejika ngokuya nge-y, bese uhlanganisa lesi sisho kusuka ku-0 kuya ebudeni besikwele sentathu.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Isikwele sentathu sinobubanzi ..., ubude ..., futhi ...
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uqinisekise ukuthi ubude besikwele sentathu bungu-ln e²=2?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Uhlole ukuthi ifana nenani elitholwe ngokuhlanganisa ngezingxenye?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.0: Isikwele sentathu sinobubanzi obungu-e² nobude obungu-ln e²=2, ngakho indawo yaso ingu-2e². Ingxenye ekwesokhohlo sejika ingu-∫_0^2 eʸ dy = e²−1. Ngakho indawo ka-R ingu-2e² − (e²−1) = e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.1: Ku-x=e², u-y usuka ku-0 uye ku-2, ngakho indawo yesikwele sentathu ingu-2e² futhi ingxenye ekhishwayo ingu-∫_0^2 e^y dy=e²−1. Indawo ingu-2e²−e²+1=e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.prompt: Indlela kaSoyul ingasetshenziswa "uma ijika lingabhalwa njengesisho esisodwa sohlobo lwe-x=h(y)." Khetha wonke amajika ngezansi angabhalwa ngaleyo ndlela esikhaweni esinikeziwe.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ejikeni ngalinye, thatha inani elilodwa lika-y futhi ubale ukuthi mangaki ama-x esikhawini anelo nani luka-y.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi igrafu iyenyuka futhi yehle esikhaweni (noma iyenyuka kuphela).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.a: Inani ngalinye luka-y lihambisana namanani amabili ka-x (u-x no-−x). Alikwazi ukubhalwa njengesisho esisodwa sohlobo lwe-x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ubone ukuthi u-y ngamunye uhambisana no-x oyedwa kuphela (x=ln y), ngakho kungabhalwa njengesisho esisodwa sohlobo lwe-x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.c: Inani ngalinye luka-y lihambisana namanani amabili ka-x (u-x no-π−x). Alikwazi ukubhalwa njengesisho esisodwa sohlobo lwe-x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.d: Ubone ukuthi u-y ngamunye uhambisana no-x oyedwa kuphela (x= impande yekhyubhu luka-y), ngakho kungabhalwa njengesisho esisodwa sohlobo lwe-x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.explain: U-y=eˣ (0≤x≤1) no-y=x³ (−1≤x≤1) ayakhula ezikhaweni zawo, ngakho u-y ngamunye uhambisana no-x oyedwa (anemisebenzi eyiphambene). Ku-y=x² noma u-y=sin x, kunama-x amabili ku-y ofanayo, ngakho njengoba injalo ayikwazi ukuba yisisho esisodwa u-x=h(y), futhi isikhawu kufanele sihlukaniswe.

n-m-h3-vec-04.title: Ingabe I-engeli Phakathi Kwemigqa Emibili Ifana Ne-engeli Phakathi Kwama-Direction Vector Awo?
n-m-h3-vec-04.goal: Qonda umehluko phakathi kwe-engeli phakathi kwama-direction vector ne-engeli phakathi kwemigqa ngokubuyekeza isinqumo sakho njengoba ulwazi lwengezwa, bese usebenzisa ifomula elungile ye-engeli phakathi kwemigqa.
n-m-h3-vec-04.material: Ufuna ukuthola i-engeli θ phakathi kwemigqa emibili l no-m endizeni ye-coordinate. Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. (u·v ifundwa "u dot v," |u| i-magnitude ka-u, futhi √5 ifundwa "root 5.")
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.0: Ukubuyekeza isinqumo sakho lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ukuthi inani liyafana yini noma i-direction vector ikhethwa ngendlela ehlukile
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi kungani inani eliphelele lidingeka
n-m-h3-vec-04.prereq.0: I-dot product yama-vector endizeni ne-engeli phakathi kwawo
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Esigabeni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo usebenzisa kuphela lokho okwaziwa kuze kube manje.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, hlola ukuthi isinqumo sangaphambili sisasebenza yini.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kulayini ofanayo, khetha i-direction vector eyiphambene, yenza ukubala okufanayo, bese uqhathanisa imiphumela.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ukhethe u=(1, 2) njenge-direction vector kalayini l no-v=(1, −3) njenge-direction vector kalayini m. Ukubala kunikeza u·v=−5, |u|=√5, |v|=√10.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wahlulela kanjani i-engeli θ phakathi kwemigqa emibili?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.after: I-engeli phakathi kuka-u no-v inecos = −1/√2, okungukuthi, 135°. Kodwa akukaqinisekiswa ukuthi leli nani lingathathwa njenge-engeli phakathi kwemigqa emibili.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Udlulisele i-engeli phakathi kwama-vector amabili ngqo ku-engeli phakathi kwemigqa. Lesi yisinqumo sokuqala esifika engqondweni.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kumele sihlole ngokwengeziwe ukuthi leli nani lichaza ngempela i-engeli phakathi kwemigqa, nokuthi liyafana yini uma ama-direction vector ekhethwa ngendlela ehlukile
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ukhumbule ukuthi i-direction vector akuyona inani elilodwa elinganqamuki kulayini ngamunye.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Njengoba i-dot product iyinegethivu, singasho kuphela ukuthi imigqa emibili ayime ngqo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uthe kuphela ukuthi ayime ngqo. Awuzange unqume usayizi we-engeli.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Noma ithatha −v=(−1, 3) njenge-vector yesiqondiso somugqa m esikhundleni se-v, ukhona umugqa m ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: I-engeli phakathi kuka-u no−v iyini, futhi lokhu kusitshela ini ngo-engeli θ phakathi kwemigqa?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.after: I-engeli phakathi kuka-u no-v ngu-135°, futhi i-engeli phakathi kuka-u no−v ngu-45°. Ngisho nasemigqeni emibili efanayo, inani liyashintsha kuye ngokuthi i-vector yesiqondiso ikhethwa kanjani. Lapho imigqa emibili ihlangana, kwakheka ama-engeli angu-45° no-135°, ngakho sidinga isivumelwano sokuthi ikuphi okufanele kubizwe ngokuthi i-engeli phakathi kwemigqa.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: u·(−v)=5 no-cos=1/√2, ngakho ingu-45°. Emigqeni efanayo, kuphuma ama-engeli amabili, u-135° no-45°, ngakho i-dot product enophawu yodwa ayinquli i-engeli phakathi kwemigqa.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uqinisekise ngokuqondile ukuthi inani liyashintsha kuye ngokuthi i-vector yesiqondiso ikhethwa kanjani.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ukuthola u-45° iwukuphutha kokubala, futhi u-135° uyiwona olungile.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuguqula ku-−v kuphendula uphawu lwe-dot product, ngakho i-cos iba +1/√2; lokhu akuwona umlando wephutha.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: u·(−v)=5 futhi i-engeli ingu-45°, ngakho u-135° wangaphambilini wawungalungile futhi i-engeli phakathi kwemigqa ingu-45°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubulungile ngokuthi kuphuma u-45°, kodwa ushiyelwe ukuthi bobabili u-135° no-45° baqhamuka emigqeni emibili efanayo. Sidinga isivumelwano sokuthi iyiphi okufanele ithathwe njenge-engeli phakathi kwemigqa.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Siyavumelana ukuthi i-engeli θ phakathi kwemigqa emibili iyileyo, phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili zama-engeli akhiwa lapho ihlangana (u-45° no-135°), engeyona enkulu, okungukuthi leyo ene-0°<θ≤90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Iyiphi indlela eyisiqiniseko enikeza θ njalo noma ngabe ama-vector esiqondiso akhethwa kanjani?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |u·v|=5, ngakho cosθ=5/(√5·√10)=1/√2 futhi θ=45°. I-engeli phakathi kwemigqa kumele itholwe ngefomula ethatha inani eliphelele le-dot product, ukuze kuphume inani elifanayo noma ngabe ama-vector esiqondiso akhethwa kanjani.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uphawu luyashintsha kuye ngokukhetha kwe-vector yesiqondiso, ngakho kungenzeka lungavumelani nesivumelwano sokuthi θ iphakathi kuka-0° no-90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukusebenzisa inani eliphelele le-dot product kunikeza inani elifanayo noma i-vector yesiqondiso iphendulwa, futhi cosθ≥0, ngakho θ ingu-90° ubuningi.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lokhu kulungile kuphela uma kusetshenziswa i-−v; uma kukhethwa ngenye indlela uphawu luyahluka, ngakho akuyona ifomula elungile njalo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni udlulisele i-engeli phakathi kwama-vector esiqondiso ngqo ku-engeli phakathi kwemigqa, kodwa isinqumo sakho sashintsha lapho kufakwa ulwazi lokuthi ngisho nomugqaofanayo unama-vector esiqondiso ezinhlangothini ezimbili eziphambene. I-engeli phakathi kwemigqa kumele ibe yinani elingashintshi ngophawu lwe-vector yesiqondiso, ngakho siyitholela ngokuthatha inani eliphelele le-dot product.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.prompt: I-vector yesiqondiso somugqa p ingu-(2, 1) futhi i-vector yesiqondiso somugqa q ingu-(1, −3). Thola inani le-cosθ ye-engeli θ phakathi kwemigqa emibili, bese ubhala ngomusho owodwa ukuthi kungani ifomula idinga inani eliphelele.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.0: Thola inani le-dot product nobukhulu bama-vector womabili, bese uwafaka efomulweni.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.1: Yenza ukubala okufanayo nge-(−1, 3), okuyinguquko ye-vector yesiqondiso (1, −3), bese uqhathanisa imiphumela.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.placeholder: isb., cosθ = ... Inani eliphelele liyadingeka ngoba ...
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale inani le-u·v nobukhulu bama-vector womabili?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhathanisile ukuthi iyiphi i-engeli ephumayo uma usebenzisa i-dot product injalo uma iyinegethivu?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uxhumanise isizathu senani eliphelele ne-"ndlela i-vector yesiqondiso ekhethwa ngayo"?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.0: (2, 1)·(1, −3) = −1 futhi ubukhulu bungu-√5 no-√10, ngakho cosθ = |−1|/(√5·√10) = 1/(5√2) ≈ 0.14. Uma siphendula i-vector yesiqondiso, uphawu lwe-dot product luyashintsha, ngakho sidinga inani eliphelele ukuze i-engeli phakathi kwemigqa inqunywe ngokukodwa.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.1: I-dot product ingu-−1 futhi |p|=√5, |q|=√10, ngakho cosθ=1/√50=√2/10. Sisebenzisa inani eliphelele ngoba savumelana ukuthi i-engeli phakathi kwemigqa emibili ingu-90° ubuningi, futhi sifuna inani elifanayo noma ngabe ama-vector esiqondiso akhethwa kanjani.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.topic: Uchungechunge: izamba ezingaphelele noluchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungenamkhawulo
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.title: Ukuhlola Isixazululo Esithole Igama Elijwayelekile Kusuka Efomulani Yesamba Esingaphelele
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.goal: Funda ukuthi u-a_1 kufanele uthole ngokwehlukana uma uthola igama elijwayelekile kusuka kusamba esingaphelele S_n, lungisa isixazululo esingalungile, bese usihlola usebenzisa isamba lim S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.material: Isamba samagama okuqala angu-n ochungechunge singu-S_n = 4 − 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Funda isixazululo sika-Minjae sokuthola isamba salolu chungechunge. ((1/2)^(n−1) isho ingxenye eyodwa kwezimbili emandleni ka-n−1.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.0: Ukuthola umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni lapho kuphutha khona
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ibanga lapho ifomula isebenza khona (n≥2)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.3: Ukuthola isimo lapho ifomula isebenza nakuk n=1
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sika-Minjae lapho kuphutha khona.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola umugqa ngomugqa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngempela emugqeni wangaphambilini yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isimo (ibanga lika-n) elisetshenziswe ukuthola ifomula lilondolozwa njengoba linjalo emugqeni olandelayo yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.0: Isamba sochungechunge singu-lim S_n, futhi ku-n ≥ 2, a_n = S_n − S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.2: Ngokucabanga ukuthi le fomula ingasetshenziswa nakuk n=1, setha a_n = 3·(1/2)^(n−1) kuyo yonke n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.3: Lolu uchungechunge lwe-geometric olungapheli olunegama lokuqala 3 nesilinganiso esivamile 1/2, ngakho isamba ngu-3/(1−1/2) = 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.explain: Ngumugqa 3. S_n−S_(n−1) ingasetshenziswa kuphela ku-n≥2, ngakho ukuthi ifomula etholiwe isebenza nakuk n=1 kufanele kuhlolwe ngokwehlukana. Lapha a_1=S_1=4−3=1, kodwa ukufaka n=1 efomulani kunika 3, okuhlukile. Ukubala emigqeni 1 no-2 kulungile, futhi umugqa 4 umphumela olandela umugqa 3.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa isixazululo sika-Minjae bese uthola isamba salolu chungechunge. Bese uthola igama lokuqala a_1 ngqo, uliqhathanise nenani luka-Minjae, bese ubhala ukuthi kungani isamba sishintsha.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.0: Thola umkhawulo we-S_n ngqo bese uwuqhathanisa nenani u-Minjae alithole.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.1: Faka efomulani ukuthola a_1 kusuka ku-S_1, bese uliqhathanisa nenani olithola ngokufaka n=1 efomulani yegama elijwayelekile luka-Minjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlolile ukuthi ifomula etholwe ku-n≥2 isebenza nakuk n=1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uhlole kabili isamba ngo-lim S_n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.0: a_1=S_1=4−3=1. Kodwa ukufaka n=1 ku-3·(1/2)^(n−1) kunika 3, ngakho a_1 ihlukile. Ngakho a_1=1, futhi kusukela ku-n≥2 igama ngu-3·(1/2)^(n−1). Isamba ngu-1+(3/2)/(1−1/2)=1+3=4, okulingana no-lim S_n=4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.1: Igama lokuqala ngu-S_1=1, hhayi u-3 osuka efomulani yegama elijwayelekile. Kusukela ku-n=2, igama lokuqala ngu-3/2 nesilinganiso esivamile ngu-1/2, ngakho leyo ngxenye ngu-3/2÷(1/2)=3, futhi ukwengeza u-1 kunika isamba 4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.2: Ukuthatha umkhawulo we-S_n ngqo kunika 4−0=4, futhi u-6 u-Minjae alibhale yinani elinezengeziwe ezi-3 ngoba athathe u-a_1 ukuthi ngu-3 ngephutha. U-a_1 wangempela ngu-S_1=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.3: lim S_n=4. a_1=S_1=1, kodwa u-Minjae uthathe ukuthi ngu-3. Ngakho impendulo elungile ngu-4, hhayi 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.prompt: Kuma-S_n ngalinye angezansi, khetha lelo lapho ifomula yegama elijwayelekile etholwe ku-n≥2 isebenza njengoba injalo nakuk n=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kufomula ngayinye, thola u-S_1 bese uyiqhathanisa nenani olithola ngokufaka n=1 efomulani etholwe ku-S_n−S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kufomula ngayinye, faka amanani ahlukile ka-n ku-S_n bese uqhathanisa, bese ufuna into evamile phakathi kwezifomula lapho u-S_1 obalwe ngqo elingana nenani lefomula ka-a_1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.a: Lolu uchungechunge luka-Minjae. a_1=1 kodwa ifomula inika 3, ngakho ayihambisani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.b: a_1=S_1=1, kodwa ukufaka n=1 efomulani 2·(1/2)^(n−1) ye-n≥2 kunika 2, ngakho ayihambisani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.c: a_1=S_1=3, futhi ukufaka n=1 efomulani 3·(1/2)^(n−1) ye-n≥2 kunika 3 futhi, ngakho iyahambisana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.d: a_1=S_1=7/2, kodwa ukufaka n=1 efomulani 3·(1/2)^n ye-n≥2 kunika 3/2, ngakho ayihambisani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.explain: Uma ukufaka n=0 efomulani ye-S_n kunika S_0=0 (c: 6−6=0), ifomula isebenza nakuk n=1. Kwezinye, S_0 ingu-−2, −1, 2 ngokulandelana, ngakho a_1 kufanele ithole ngokwehlukana.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.topic: Uchungechunge: izamba ezingaphelele noluchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungenamkhawulo
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.prompt: Esiteji ngasinye, khetha isinqumo usebenzisa kuphela lokho okwaziwayo kuze kube manje.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.title: Uma x Ingu-0, Ingabe Isamba Sochungechunge Sinikezwa Yifomula Efanayo?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.goal: Kuchungechunge lwe-geometric olunesilinganiso esivamile esishintsha no-x, phenya ibanga lapho ifomula yesamba isebenza khona, bese uchaza ukuthi ukubala ngokwehlukana ku-x=0 kukhombisa ukuthi isamba sihlukile kuleyo phoyinti.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.material: Kunombolo engempela x, vumela f(x)=x²+x²/(1+x²)+x²/(1+x²)²+x²/(1+x²)³+…. (Luwuchungechunge olunegama lokuqala x² lapho igama ngalinye elilandelayo liphindaphindwa ngo-1/(1+x²).) Ulwazi lwembulwa ucezu ngalunye.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.0: Ukubuyekeza isinqumo sakho njengoba ulwazi lukhula
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo uma kuvela ulwazi olusha, hlola futhi ukuthi ifomula oyisebenzise ngaphambilini isasebenza njengoba injalo yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x=0 ngqo bese ubhala ukuthi amagama ambalwa okuqala ayini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Cabanga ukuthi f(1)=1+1/2+1/4+…=2 uma x=1, futhi f(2)=4+4/5+4/25+…=5 uma x=2.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ulindele ukuthi f(x) ibe yifomula yini kuyo yonke inombolo engempela x?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.after: x²/(1−1/(1+x²))=1+x² yifomula etholwe ngemva kokukhansela. Khumbula ukuthi kukhona u-x lapho u-x² okhanselwe engu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: f(x)=1+x²: ngoba amanani womabili ahambisana no-1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Welule ifomula efanela amaphoyinti amabili kuyo yonke x. Lesi yisinqumo sokuqala esifika engqondweni.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: f(x)=1+x², kodwa u-x lapho isilinganiso esivamile singejwayelekile kufanele ahloliswe ngokwehlukana
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthandabuza ukuthi imiphumela emaphoyintini amabili isebenza yini kuyo yonke x.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: f(x)=x²+1/x²: ngoba enye ifomula nayo ingafanela amanani amabili
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ku-x=1 inika 2 futhi ku-x=2 inika 4.25, ngakho ayihambisani nelinye lamanani amabili. Awufakanga ukuze uhlole ifomula.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Manje cabanga ngecala x=0. Faka x=0 ngqo efomulani echazayo ka-f.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.after: f(0)=0. Noma isilinganiso esivamile singu-1, uma igama lokuqala lingu-0 khona-ke zonke izamba ezingaphelele zingu-0, ngakho luyahlangana lube ngu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Usebenzise ifomula etholakale ku-x≠0 ku-x=0 njengoba injalo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0: ngoba onke amaqembu angu-0, ngakho wonke amasamu angengxenye angu-0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uqale encazelweni futhi wabala amasamu angengxenye ngqo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Akunqunyiwe: ngoba isilinganiso esijwayelekile singu-1, ngakho siyahlukana
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi isilinganiso esijwayelekile esingu-1 sihlala sihlukana. Uphuthelwe icala lapho ikhefu lokuqala lingu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngokufigqiwe, u-f(x)=1+x² uma u-x≠0, futhi u-f(0)=0 uma u-x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yisiphi isitatimende esilungile mayelana nomkhawulo luka-f(x) njengoba u-x→0 nokuqhubeka ku-x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ikhefu ngalinye liyaqhubeka, kodwa isamu u-f liyaphukile ku-x=0. Ngesamu esingapheli, u-"uma ikhefu ngalinye liqhubeka, isamu liyaqhubeka" akusoze kwaba yiqiniso njalo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Umkhawulo ungu-1 futhi u-f(0)=0, ngakho u-f akaqhubeki ku-x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Unqume ukuqhubeka ngokuqhathanisa inani lomkhawulo nenani lomsebenzi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ikhefu ngalinye ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo, ngakho isamu u-f liyaqhubeka kuwo wonke ama-x
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Usebenzise isakhiwo esiyiqiniso ezamu ezipheleyo esamini esingapheli njengoba sinjalo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Umkhawulo no-f(0) bobabili bangu-0, ngakho u-f uyaqhubeka ku-x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Awuhlolanga ukuthi ifomula u-1+x² ye-x≠0 iya kuphi njengoba u-x→0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni wawufuna ukusebenzisa ifomula ehambisana namaphoyinti amabili kuwo wonke ama-x, kodwa isinqumo sakho sashintsha lapho uhlola isimo u-x²≠0 esisetshenziswe ekucisheni. Uma usebenzisa ifomula, kufanele uhlole ngqo kunani lomngcele ukuthi izimo lapho ifomula isebenza khona ziyasebenza yini kuleli cala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.prompt: Ikhefu ngalinye u-x²/(1+x²)^n ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo luka-x. Bhala ukuthi u-f(0) ku-x=0 uyini, nokuthi uhluka kanjani kufomula u-1+x² ye-x≠0, nesizathu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-x=0 ngqo efomulweni echaza u-f futhi ubhale amakhefu okuqala ambalwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.1: Uma usebenzisa ifomula yesamu yochungechunge lwejiyomethri, hlola ukuthi likhona yini icala lapho isihlukanisi siba ngu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ufake ngempela u-x=0 futhi wabhala amakhefu okuqala ambalwa?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ucabange ukuthi ifomula etholakale ku-x≠0 ingasetshenziswa yini ku-x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Usho ukuthi noma ikhefu ngalinye liqhubeka, isamu lingase lingaqhubeki?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.0: Uma u-x=0, ikhefu ngalinye lingu-0²/1^n=0, ngakho u-f(0)=0. Kodwa uma u-x≠0, u-f(x)=1+x², ngakho eduze no-x=0 amanani akhe asondele ku-1. Ngakho umkhawulo u-1 uhluke ku-f(0)=0, futhi u-f akaqhubeki ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.1: Ukufaka u-x=0 kunika isilinganiso esijwayelekile esingu-1, kodwa wonke amakhefu kusukela kokuqala angu-0, ngakho isamu lingu-0. Lokhu kuhlukile ku-1, okutholwa ngokufaka u-0 ku-1+x², futhi u-f uphukile ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.2: Ifomula u-1+x² isetshenziswa kuphela ku-x≠0. Uma u-x=0, onke amakhefu angu-0 ngakho isamu lingu-0, futhi lokho kuhlukile ku-1+0²=1, ngakho umsebenzi awuxhumekile kuleyo phoyinti.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.3: Uma u-x=0, isilinganiso esijwayelekile siba ngu-1 ngakho ifomula ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa, futhi wonke amakhefu angu-0, ngakho u-f(0)=0. Lokho kuhlukile ku-1, okutholwa ngokufaka u-0 ku-1+x².

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.topic: Uchungechunge: izamba ezingaphelele noluchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungenamkhawulo
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.ok.c1: Inani eliphelele lesilinganiso esivamile lingaphansi kuka-1, ngakho luyahlangana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.title: Uchungechunge Lwejiyomethri Olungapheli Onekhefu Lokuqala Elikhulu Kunesamu Laso
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.goal: Yenza isibonelo soluchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungapheli onesamu elingu-6 nekhefu lokuqala elikhulu kuno-6, futhi uchaze ukuthi uphawu lwesilinganiso esijwayelekile lwenza kanjani amasamu angengxenye ahambe ngaphezulu nangaphansi kwesamu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.material: Cabanga ukuthi uchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungapheli u-a + ar + ar² + … nekhefu lokuqala u-a nesilinganiso esijwayelekile u-r lunesamu elingu-6. Kulula ukucabanga, "Isamu lingu-6, ngakho ikhefu lokuqala kumele libe ngaphansi kuka-6."
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.thinking.0: Wenza wena izibonelo ezanelisa izimo ukuze uthole iphethini
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.thinking.1: Ukuqinisekisa ubudlelwano bosayizi phakathi kwesamu namasamu angengxenye ngamacala
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.prompt: Yenza uchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungapheli onesamu elingu-6 nekhefu lokuqala u-a elikhulu kuno-6, futhi ukhethe no-n (inombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-9) lapho isamu elingengxenye u-S_n loluchungechunge likhulu kuno-6. Faka u-a, r, n. Yenza ezintathu ezinama-(r, n) ahlukile. (U-S_n yisamu kusuka ekhefini lokuqala kuya ekhefini lesi-n.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi yiliphi isibalo esiphakathi kuka-a no-r ukuze isamu libe ngu-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ngemuva kokukhetha u-r kuleso sibalo, hlola ukuthi u-a mkhulu kuno-6 yini, uma kungenjalo, shintsha uphawu noma usayizi luka-r.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.2: Ngo-r owakhethile, bala u-S_1, S_2, S_3 ngqo bese ukhetha u-n lapho kukhulu kuno-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Kulo n, u-S_n akakhulu kuno-6. Bala u-S_1, S_2, S_3 ngqo futhi uqhathanise no-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.explain: Njengoba u-a=6(1−r), u-a>6 udinga u-r<0. Bese u-S_n=6(1−r^n), ngakho ukuze u-S_n abe mkhulu kuno-6 sidinga u-r^n<0, okungukuthi u-n kumele abe ngu-odd. Isibonelo, uma u-a=9 no-r=−1/2, u-S_1=9 no-S_3=6(1+1/8)=6.75 bakhulu kuno-6, futhi u-S_2=4.5 mncane. U-r=−1 akavunyelwe ngoba u-|r|<1 uyehluleka, futhi u-a=8, r=−1/2 unesamu elingu-8/1.5≈5.33.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.prompt: Khetha konke okumele kube yiqiniso koluchungechunge lwejiyomethri olungapheli onesamu elingu-6 nekhefu lokuqala elikhulu kuno-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.0: Hlela ithebula lalokho izibonelo ozenzile esinyathelweni esedlule ezifana ngakho.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bala u-S_1, S_2, S_3 ezibonelweni zakho futhi uqhathanise ukuthi ngamunye mkhulu noma mncane kuno-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.a: U-S_1 mkhulu kuno-6, kodwa ikhefu lesibili alivumelekile, ngakho u-S_2 uba mncane kuno-S_1. Esibonelweni u-a=9, r=−1/2, u-S_2=4.5.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.b: Wonke amakhefu aphozithivu futhi aqhubeka encipha
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.b: Ukuze ikhefu lokuqala lidlule isamu, elinye ikhefu kumele libe negethivu. Uma wonke amakhefu aphozithivu, isamu alikwazi ukuba lincane kunekhefu lokuqala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.c: Isilinganiso esijwayelekile sinegethivu futhi ikhefu lokuqala liphozithivu, ngakho ikhefu lesibili u-ar linegethivu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.d: Amasamu angengxenye amakhulu kuno-6 namasamu angengxenye amancane kuno-6 ayashintshana

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.goal: Hlela izinhlanganisela lapho ukuhlangana kuka-Σ(a_n+b_n) kunqunywa ukuthi u-Σa_n no-Σb_n bayahlangana yini nalezo lapho kungenqunywa, futhi wakhe isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.material: Kunochungechunge olungapheli oluyizimbili u-Σa_n no-Σb_n, futhi ufuna ukwazi ukuthi uchungechunge u-Σ(a_n+b_n), olwakhiwe ngokuqoqa ikhefu nekhefu, luyahlangana noma luyahlukana. Kuye ngalokho owaziyo, kwesinye isikhathi kuyanqunywa futhi kwesinye akunqunywa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.thinking.2: Ukusho izimo lapho umthetho wokusebenza usebenza khona
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke amaqembu olwazi anquma, njengempendulo eyodwa, ukuthi u-Σ(a_n+b_n) uyahlangana noma uyahlukana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ngolwazi ngalunye, cabanga ngamapheya amabili ahlukile u-a_n, b_n afanelana nalo futhi ubone ukuthi uchungechunge lwesamu lunika umphumela ofanayo yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ukuhlanganisa noma ukususa uchungechunge oluhlangana kungenza uchungechunge oluhlukanayo luhlangane yini.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.a: Isamu soluchungechunge oluhlangana oluyizimbili liyahlangana, ngakho linqunyiwe njengempendulo eyodwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.b: Uma u-a_n=b_n=1 uyahlukana, kodwa uma u-a_n=1, b_n=−1 uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlangana, ngakho akunqunyiwe.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.c: Ukukhipha u-Σa_n ohlangana kushiya u-Σb_n, ngakho uma uchungechunge lwesamu lwahlangana, u-Σb_n kwakuzofanele ahlangane naye; ngakho uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlukana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.d: Uma u-a_n=b_n=1/n uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlukana, futhi uma u-a_n=1/n², b_n=1/n² luyahlangana. Akunqunyiwe.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.explain: Uma bobabili bahlangana, uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlangana, futhi uma kuhlangana oyedwa kuphela, uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlukana (ngoba uma lwahlangana, u-Σb_n=Σ(a_n+b_n)−Σa_n kwakuzofanele ahlangane). Uma bobabili behlukana, noma uma amakhefu eya ku-0, lokho kuphela akunquli.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.prompt: Khombisa icala lapho ulwazi lungenele. Ake u-a_n=p·r^n, b_n=q·r^n (p≠0, q≠0, |r|≥1); bese u-Σa_n no-Σb_n bobabili bayahlukana. Faka u-p, q, r kabili, ngama-r ahlukile, ukuze u-Σ(a_n+b_n) ahlangane.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala u-a_n+b_n uhlanganisiwe ngokuya nge-r^n, bese ucabanga ukuthi i-coefficient kumele ibe yini ukuze loluchungechunge luhlangane.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.1: Thola indlela yokwenza i-coefficient ibe ngu-0 ngenkathi ugcina isimo sokuthi u-p no-q abekho ababa ngu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Amakhefu ajwayelekile ka-Σa_n no-Σb_n awasiwo u-0, ngakho ngamunye uyahlukana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c1: U-p noma u-q ungu-0, ngakho loluchungechunge aluhlukani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c2: U-|r|≥1, ngakho ikhefu elijwayelekile aliyi ku-0, futhi ngamunye uyahlukana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c3: U-(p+q)r^n akasiwo u-0, ngakho uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlukana nalo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.explain: Njengoba u-a_n+b_n=(p+q)r^n, uma u-p+q=0 wonke amakhefu angu-0, ngakho uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlangana ku-0. Kodwa uma u-p≠0 no-|r|≥1, u-a_n no-b_n abaye ku-0, ngakho ngamunye uyahlukana. Ngo-p=q=1 uchungechunge lwesamu luyahlukana nalo, futhi ngo-|r|<1 uchungechunge ngalunye luyahlangana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani isitatimende esithi "uma u-Σa_n no-Σb_n bobabili bahlukana, bese u-Σ(a_n+b_n) uyahlukana nawo" siphosile. Sebenzisa isibonelo sesinyathelo esedlule, futhi ubhale nesimo esidingekayo lapho uhlukanisa uchungechunge lwamasamu libe yisamu seziyizimbili.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ingxenye ngayinye kumele ibe nenani yini lapho isamu lihlukaniswa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubale wena u-a_n+b_n wesibonelo sesinyathelo esedlule?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Usho ukuthi kungenzeka ini uma kuhlanganiswa uchungechunge oluhlukanayo oluyizimbili?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.0: Noma bobabili behlukana, njengo-Σa_n ngo-p·r^n no-Σb_n ngo-−p·r^n, ukubahlanganisa kwenza ikhefu ngalinye libe ngu-0, ngakho kuyahlangana.
