n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uxhumanise nesizathu sokuthi kungani u-B ethembeke (ithuba elifanayo)?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.0: Inhlolovo yewebhusayithi ifaka kuphela abafundi abaphendula bazenzela, ngakho abanye abafundi, abanjengalabo abanentshisekelo enkulu ekufundeni, bangase babe baningi ngokweqile. Lokhu kuthambekela kusala kunjalo noma kunabaphendulile abangu-900 noma abangu-9000, ngakho kunzima ukukwethemba nakuba isampula inkulu.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.1: U-A uyisampula eyenziwe kuphela ngabantu abaphendule ngokuzithandela, ngakho ayimeli bonke abafundi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bangaki esampulini, uma indlela yokukhetha ithambekele ohlangothini olulodwa, isilinganiso sisala sihlukile esilinganisweni sesibalo sabantu.

n-m-h3-conic-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo mayelana nendawo ye-triangle PF₁F₂
n-m-h3-conic-01.topic: Ama-conic section: izincazelo nolayini abathintayo be-parabola, ama-ellipse, nama-hyperbola; ukuhambisana phakathi kwezibalo nezibalo
n-m-h3-conic-01.goal: Qonda ukuthi ngisho nesixazululo esinezibalo zonke ezilungile singenza isiphetho singabi nalutho uma ungahlolanga ukuthi isimo senkinga singenzeka yini ngempela, bese uthola uhla lapho isimo senzeka khona.
n-m-h3-conic-01.material: Incwadi yokusebenzela inale nkinga nempendulo: "Vumela i-F₁ ne-F₂ zibe yizindawo ezimbili zokugxila ze-ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1. Ku-point P ku-ellipse onokuthi ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, thola indawo ye-triangle PF₁F₂. (Impendulo: 16)" Ngezansi isixazululo esithola le mpendulo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo ungukubala noma ukwamukela isimo
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.1: Hlola ukuthi isimo esinikeziwe singenzeka ngempela yini ngokulinga indawo ekhethekile
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.2: Thola uhla lwe-parameter lapho isimo senzeka khona
n-m-h3-conic-01.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-ellipse nama-coordinate ezindawo zayo zokugxila
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.prompt: Umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo esingezansi ulungile njengokubala. Kodwa impendulo engu-16 kule nkinga kunzima ukukholwa. Khetha umugqa wokuqala owenza impendulo ibe nzima ukukholwa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uvela kumugqa ongaphambi kwawo ngokubala noma wamukela nje isimo esithathwe enkingeni.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlanganisa umphumela womugqa wamukela isimo nomphumela womunye umugqa osutholakele ngaphambili, bese ufaka izinombolo ukubona ukuthi zombili zingenzeka ngasikhathi sinye yini.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.0: Ku-ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1, a=5 no-b=4, ngakho c²=a²−b²=9, c=3, futhi F₁(−3, 0), F₂(3, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.1: Ngencazelo ye-ellipse, PF₁ + PF₂ = 2a = 10, futhi F₁F₂ = 6.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.2: Njengoba ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, nge-Pythagorean theorem PF₁² + PF₂² = F₁F₂² = 36.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.3: Njengoba (PF₁ + PF₂)² = PF₁² + PF₂² + 2·PF₁·PF₂, sithola 100 = 36 + 2·PF₁·PF₂, ngakho PF₁·PF₂ = 32.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.explain: Ngumugqa wesi-3. Lo mugqa uthathe i-"∠F₁PF₂=90°" ebhalwe enkingeni njengokunikeziwe futhi wasetha isibalo. Kodwa njengoba PF₁+PF₂=10 emugqeni wesi-2, i-PF₁²+PF₂² incane kakhulu uma ubude obubili bulingana, ngakho kumele ibe okungenani 5²+5²=50. Ayikwazi ukuba ngu-36, ngakho akukho phoyinti elinjalo P ku-ellipse. Imigqa 4 no-5 ukubala okulandela umphumela womugqa wesi-3, ngakho nakuba ukubala kulungile, akunamsebenzi.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.prompt: Chaza, usebenzisa izinombolo ezivela esixazululweni, ukuthi kungani ungakholwa impendulo engu-16. Bhala futhi ukuthi yini okufanele isho kule nkinga.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngenani elincane kakhulu i-PF₁²+PF₂² engalithatha uma i-PF₁+PF₂ ilungisiwe ku-10.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba umfanekiso ukuze uqagele ukuthi ∠F₁PF₂ inkulu kakhulu kuphi njengoba P ihamba ku-ellipse, bese uqagela i-engeli lapho.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usebenzise izinombolo ezivela esixazululweni (36, 10, 50, njll.) ngqo encazelweni yakho?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho isiphetho sakho ngesimo esithi "isimo asikwazi ukwenzeka" kunokuthi "ukubala kunephutha"?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uqonde ukuthi lokhu kungahlolwa nangomfanekiso noma indawo ekhethekile (isiphetho se-minor axis)?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.0: Uma PF₁+PF₂=10, isamba sezikwele sincane kakhulu uma ubude obubili bulingana, ngakho siwumthamo okungenani 5²+5²=50. Kodwa umugqa wesi-3 uthe 36, ngakho lokho kuyaphikisana. Iphoyinti elinjalo P alikho, futhi 16 inani elingenanjongo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.1: Esiphethweni se-minor axis (0, 4), PF₁=PF₂=5 no-F₁F₂=6, ngakho 25+25>36, okusho ukuthi ∠F₁PF₂ incane kuno-90° kule ndawo. Le engeli inkulu kakhulu lapho ku-ellipse, ngakho akukho phoyinti lapho iyi-90°. Ngakho indawo ayikwazi ukutholakala.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.2: Impendulo engu-16 ayilungile. Uma isamba singu-10, isamba sezikwele okungenani singu-50, kodwa singu-36, ngakho akufaneleki. Akukho phoyinti elinjalo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.3: 16 akulungile. Uma isamba sobude obubili singu-10, isamba sezikwele asikwazi ukuba ngu-36, ngakho P enjalo ayikho.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.prompt: Manje shintsha i-ellipse ibe x²/25 + y²/b² = 1 (0 < b < 5). Thola futhi ufake amanani amathathu ahlukene ka-b lapho iphoyinti P elinokuthi ∠F₁PF₂ = 90° likhona ngempela ku-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubheke ukuthi ibanga phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila ezimbili lishintsha kanjani njengoba b iba nkulu.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kunani ngalinye ka-b, linganisela ukuthi i-engeli endaweni ku-ellipse lapho ∠F₁PF₂ inkulu kakhulu ifinyelela ku-90° yini.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Kule b, iphoyinti elinokuthi ∠F₁PF₂=90° likhona ku-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Kule b, ∠F₁PF₂ ayifinyeleli ku-90° noma kuphi ku-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.explain: Ukuze izindawo zokugxila zibone iphoyinti P ku-ellipse ku-90°, ∠F₁PF₂ kumele ibe okungenani ngu-90° esiphethweni se-minor axis, lapho i-engeli inkulu kakhulu. Lokhu kwenzeka uma c ≥ b, okungukuthi, uma 25−b² ≥ b². Ngakho b² ≤ 12.5, futhi ku-0<b<5, iphoyinti P likhona uma b ingu-3.54 ngobukhulu. b=3.5 iyasebenza, kodwa 3.6 ayisebenzi.

n-m-h3-conic-02.topic: Ama-conic section: izincazelo nolayini abathintayo be-parabola, ama-ellipse, nama-hyperbola; ukuhambisana phakathi kwezibalo nezibalo
n-m-h3-conic-02.title: Yini enye esiyidingayo ukuze sinqume isibalo se-hyperbola?
n-m-h3-conic-02.goal: Nquma ukuthi ulwazi lunele yini ukunquma isibalo sejika ngokuqhathanisa inani lezinto ezingaziwa nenani lezibalo ezizimele.
n-m-h3-conic-02.material: Incwadi yokusebenzela iqukethe inkinga "Thola isibalo se-hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 (a>0, b>0) enezindawo zokugxila (5, 0) no-(−5, 0)." Uthisha uthe, "Le nkinga ilahlekelwe yisimo esisodwa." Ufuna ukuqedela inkinga ngokufaka isimo esilahlekile.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.1: Hlukanisa lokho osekuvele ukwazi nolwazi olusha
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.2: Khombisa ukuthi ulwazi alwanele ngesibonelo esiphikisayo (ijika elihlukile elinezindawo zokugxila ezifanayo)
n-m-h3-conic-02.prereq.0: Isimo esijwayelekile x²/a²−y²/b²=1 se-hyperbola, nezincazelo zezindawo zokugxila, ama-vertex, nama-asymptote
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izingcezu zolwazi, lapho zengezwa kulwazi lokuthi izindawo zokugxila ziyi-(5, 0) no-(−5, 0) njengokuphela kokungeziwe, zinquma u-a no-b ngokuhlukile. (a>0, b>0)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ngamunye ukuthi ucezu ngalunye lolwazi lunikeza yini isibalo esisha esihlobanisa u-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qala uthole ukuthi yisiphi isibalo esihlobanisa u-a no-b esivele siyiqiniso uma kuphela izindawo zokugxila ezaziwayo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.b: Ibanga phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila ezimbili ngu-10.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu sekuvele kwaziwa ngama-coordinate ezindawo zokugxila (±5, 0), ngakho akuyona ulwazi olusha. Kusekhona isibalo esisodwa kuphela kuzo ezidingekayo ezihlobanisa u-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kuhlala kuyiqiniso kunoma yiliphi ijika lesimo x²/a²−y²/b²=1. Akuyona ulwazi olusha ngo-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.e: Ukufaka x=0 kunikeza −y²/b²=1, ngakho i-hyperbola yalesi simo ayihlangani ne-y-axis. Akuyona ulwazi olusha ngo-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.explain: Ulwazi lwezindawo zokugxila lunikeza isibalo esisodwa kuphela, a²+b²=25. I-vertex (3, 0) inikeza a=3, ngakho b=4 iyanqunywa, futhi i-slope ye-asymptote 4/3 inikeza b/a=4/3, ngakho a=3 no-b=4 bayanqunywa. Ibanga phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila elingu-10, ukulingana nge-origin, nokungahlangani ne-y-axis sekuvele kwaziwa noma kuhlale kuyiqiniso, ngakho akwengezi sibalo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ama-hyperbola amabili anezimo ezihlukile anezindawo zokugxila (5, 0) no-(−5, 0) futhi esimweni x²/a² − y²/b² = 1, bese ufaka (a, b). (Uma ubhala amadesimali, sebenzisa izindawo ezimbili zedesimali.)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faka inani le-c esibalweni esikhona phakathi kuka-a, b no-c ku-hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha inani elilodwa lika-a elifeza lesi sibalo bese uhlola ukuthi b iba yini.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.explain: Uma izindawo zokugxila zifana, c=5, ngakho a²+b²=25. Hhayi kuphela (3, 4) no-(4, 3) kodwa namapheya anjenge-(2, cishe 4.58) konke kungenzeka, ngakho kunama-hyperbola angenamkhawulo anezimo ezihlukile.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani kuvela ama-hyperbola ahlukene noma izindawo zokugxila zifana.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bala ukuthi zingaki izibalo ezihlobanisa u-a no-b nokuthi zingaki izinto ezingaziwa.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala u-a²+b² kupheya ngalinye lamabili owenzile bese uwaqhathanisa.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uthe kukhona isibalo esisodwa kuphela phakathi kuka-a no-b?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe unikeze izibonelo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ze-(a, b) ezifeza lesi sibalo?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma izindawo zokugxila ziyi-(±5, 0), bese c=5, futhi ku-hyperbola kuvela isibalo esisodwa kuphela: a²+b²=c²=25. Kunezinto ezimbili ezingaziwa, a no-b, ngakho b ishintsha kuye ngokuthi a ikhethwa kanjani, futhi kunamajika angenamkhawulo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Sinikezwe kuphela a²+b²=25, ngakho (3, 4) iyasebenza, (4, 3) iyasebenza, futhi nama-ayinye amaningi. Ngakho izindawo zokugxila zodwa azinquni ngokuhlukile.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu, khetha indlela engasetshenziswa namajika ngaphandle kwama-hyperbola. Uma uthola ulwazi olusha, iyiphi indlela eqinisekile kakhulu yokunquma ukuthi lolo lwazi lodwa lunquma ijika ngokuhlukile?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.0: Beka eceleni komunye nomunye inani lezibalo ezitholakala ezingcezwini ezimbili zolwazi ezisetshenziswe kuze kube manje nenani lezinto ezingaziwa.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ucezu olulodwa olusha lolwazi lushintsha kanjani lezo zinombolo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.a: Nquma ngokubheka ukuthi ulwazi olusha luqukethe izinombolo ezithile yini.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.a: Noma kunezinombolo, zingase zivuselele nje okuvele kwaziwa (isibonelo, ibanga phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila). Ukuba khona kwezinombolo akunakuba yisilinganiso.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.b: Hlola ukuthi inikeza yini esinye isibalo esihlobanisa u-a no-b esihlukile esimeni sezindawo zokugxila.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.c: Hlola ukuthi ijika lingadwetshwa yini ngokusebenzisa ulwazi olusha.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.c: Ukukwazi ukudweba umfanekiso akusho ukuthi izinombolo zinqunyiwe. Kufanele unqume ukuthi zinqunyiwe yini usebenzisa izibalo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.d: Nquma ngokubheka ukuthi ulwazi olusha luvezwa ngendlela efanayo nezindawo zokugxila yini.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.d: Indlela into eveziwe ngayo ayinasixhumanisi nenani lolwazi. Okubalulekile ukuthi yisiphi isibalo esikungezayo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.explain: Ukunqunywa ngokuhlukile, udinga izibalo ezizimele eziningi njengezinto ezingaziwa. Izindawo zokugxila zinikeze isibalo esisodwa futhi a no-b bayizinto ezimbili ezingaziwa, ngakho kufanele uhlole ukuthi ulwazi olusha lunikeza yini esinye isibalo esihlukile kulokho okuvele kwaziwa. Kodwa, ngisho nangezibalo ezimbili isixazululo singase singabi ngokuhlukile, ngakho ekugcineni xazulula ukuze uqinisekise.

n-m-h3-conic-04.topic: Ama-conic section: izincazelo nolayini abathintayo be-parabola, ama-ellipse, nama-hyperbola; ukuhambisana phakathi kwezibalo nezibalo
n-m-h3-conic-04.title: Ukwakha imigqa ethinta i-hyperbola wena
n-m-h3-conic-04.goal: Yakha izithinteli eziningana wena, thola ukuthi kunebanga lama-slope lapho isithinteli sikhona khona, bese uchaza lokhu usebenzisa i-discriminant.
n-m-h3-conic-04.material: Kukhona i-hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1. Uzothola mayelana nemigqa y = mx + k ethinta leli jika ngokuyakha wena.
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.1: Yakha izithinteli wena bese uthola iphethini
n-m-h3-conic-04.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano bendawo phakathi komugqa ne-conic (izibalo ezihlangene)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.prompt: Yakha imigqa emithathu ehlukile y = mx + k ethinta i-hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 bese ufaka (m, k). (Sebenzisa amadesimali ezindaweni ezintathu zedesimali.)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka isibalo somugqa esibalweni se-hyperbola ukwenza isibalo ku-x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi leso sibalo kufanele sibe sisimo sini ukuze umugqa uthinte ijika endaweni eyodwa ngqo.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Ukufaka umugqa kunika isibalo se-quadratic ku-x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Ngale slope, ukufaka umugqa akunikezi isibalo se-quadratic.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka y=mx+k ku-9x²−4y²=36 kunika (9−4m²)x²−8mkx−4k²−36=0. I-discriminant ingu-144(k²+9−4m²), ngakho ukuze kuthinte, k²=4m²−9. Isibonelo, uma m=2.5, khona-ke k²=16, ngakho k=±4.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.prompt: Khumbula imigqa oyakhe ngaphambilini. Khetha onke ama-slope lapho umugqa y = mx + k othinta le hyperbola ukhona khona.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala isimo sokuthi i-discriminant yesibalo osisethe ngaphambilini ibe ngu-0 njengesibalo ku-k².
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kuma-slope m ngamunye, nquma ukuthi k² yayiyoba ngekho kahle yini.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.a: Umugqa ovundlile y=k unqamula igatsha ngalinye lamagatsha amabili e-hyperbola kanye noma ungahlangani nanoma yiliphi. Awukwazi ukuthinta.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.d: Kubonakala sengathi ucabange ukuthi i-slope encane inesithinteli. Uma udlulisela ifomula yesithinteli se-ellipse k²=a²m²+b² njengoba injalo, uthola k=±√13, kodwa lo mugqa uhlangana ne-hyperbola ezindaweni ezimbili.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuthinta, k²=4m²−9≥0 iyadingeka, futhi ngokukhipha icala elihambisana ne-asymptote (slope ±3/2), 4m²>9, okungukuthi, |m|>3/2. Ama-slope 2 no-−3 ayasebenza; ku-0 no-1, k² ayinhle, ngakho ayasebenzi.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.prompt: Umugqa one-slope 1 awukwazi ukuthinta le hyperbola. Chaza ukuthi kungani, futhi uchaze ibanga lama-slope m lapho isithinteli sikhona khona.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka m=1 bese uthola u-k owenza i-discriminant ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.1: Cubungula ukuthi m kufanele ibe kuliphi ibanga ukuze k² ingabi ngekho kahle.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uchaze isizathu usebenzisa i-discriminant (noma uphawu luka-k²)?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi umkhawulo webanga uxhumene ne-slope yama-asymptote?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.0: Ukufaka y=x+k kunika i-discriminant 144(k²+5), engeke ibe ngu-0. Ukuze ube isithinteli, k²=4m²−9≥0 iyadingeka, ngakho inani eliphelele lika-m kufanele libe likhulu kuno-3/2.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.1: Nge-slope 1, k²=−5, ngakho akukho k engempela futhi ngakho akukho sithinteli. Ama-slope ezithinteli adinga ukuthi 4m²−9 ibe ngu-0 noma ngaphezulu, kodwa ±1.5, ahambisana nama-asymptote, kufanele asuswe, ngakho |m|>1.5.

n-m-h3-conic-05.topic: Ama-conic section: izincazelo nolayini abathintayo be-parabola, ama-ellipse, nama-hyperbola; ukuhambisana phakathi kwezibalo nezibalo
n-m-h3-conic-05.title: Uma k ishintsha, uhlobo lwejika nalo luyashintsha?
n-m-h3-conic-05.goal: Esibalweni se-conic esinelẹta, thola futhi uqinisekise ngqo amabanga lapho uhlobo lwesibalo lushintsha khona kuye ngophawu lwezihlukanisi.
n-m-h3-conic-05.material: Kuk engempela, phenya ukuthi isibalo x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 simela isibalo sishintsha kanjani no-k. Uma ufaka k=2, iba ngu-x²/7 + y²/2 = 1, okuyi-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.2: Hlola ukuthi isibalo singase singamele isibalo nhlobo
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.prompt: Uma ufaka k=6, uthola x²/3 + y²/(−2) = 1. Lesi sibalo simela isibalo siphi?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kabusha igama elinesihlukanisi esingekho kahle ngefomu lokukhipha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa isibalo esibhalwe kabusha nefomu elijwayelekile bese uhlola ukuthi liyiphi igama elinhle.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.a: Iyi-ellipse, ngoba isibalo sibhalwe njengesamba samagama amabili.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.a: Ushiye ukuthi uphawu lwesihlukanisi lungashintsha uma ufaka k. Ubheke kuphela ukubukeka kwangaphandle kwesibalo.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.b: Iyi-hyperbola ene-transverse axis ohlangothini lwe-y-axis, ngoba ongekho kahle ungohlangothini lwe-y².
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.b: Uma isihlukanisi esingekho kahle sisohlangothini lwe-y², igama le-x² linhle, ngakho livuleka ohlangothini lwe-x-axis. Hlola ukuthi liyiphi igama elinhle.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.c: Akusona isibalo nhlobo, ngoba isihlukanisi esisodwa singekho kahle.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.c: Uma isihlukanisi esisodwa singekho kahle, isibalo siphenduka sibe ukukhipha. Akukhona ukuthi awekho amaphoyinti; uhlobo lwejika luyashintsha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.d: Iyi-hyperbola, ngoba isihlukanisi esisodwa siba ngekho kahle futhi isibalo sithatha ifomu lokukhipha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.explain: y²/(−2) ngu-−y²/2, ngakho isibalo ngu-x²/3 − y²/2 = 1. Igama le-x² linhle, ngakho iyi-hyperbola evuleka ohlangothini lwe-x-axis.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake amanani amathathu ahlukile ka-k lapho isibalo x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 siba yi-hyperbola yefomu x²/A − y²/B = 1 (A>0, B>0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi izimpawu zezihlukanisi ezimbili kufanele zibe yini ukuze isibalo sithathe ifomu lokukhipha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.1: Guqula leso simo sophawu sibe ukungalingani ku-k bese uthola ibanga.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Igama le-y² aliguquki libe ifomu lokukhipha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.explain: Uma isihlukanisi 9−k segama le-x² sinhle futhi isihlukanisi 4−k segama le-y² singekho kahle, isibalo sithatha ifomu x²/(9−k) − y²/(k−4) = 1. Okungukuthi, wonke u-k onge-4<k<9 uyasebenza (k=4 no-9 abasebenzi ngoba isihlukanisi singu-0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Uma k=2 kwakuyi-ellipse, kodwa uma k=6 yaba yi-hyperbola. Chaza ukuthi yiyiphi ingxenye yesibalo eshintshile nokuthi kanjani.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala izimpawu zezihlukanisi ezimbili ku-k=2 nasekuk=6 bese uziqhathanisa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thola ukuthi yisiphi isihlukanisi esishintshe uphawu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqhathanise izinguquko zophawu zezihlukanisi ezimbili ku-k=2 nasekuk=6?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlonze ngqo ukuthi yisiphi isihlukanisi esishintshe uphawu?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma k=2, izihlukanisi ezimbili ziyi-7 ne-2, zombili zinhle, ngakho zinefomu lesamba (i-ellipse). Uma k=6, isihlukanisi 4−k ohlangothini lwe-y² siba ngu-−2, esingekho kahle, ngakho isibalo siguquka sibe ifomu lokukhipha (i-hyperbola).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma k idlula u-4, 4−k iba ngekho kahle. Khona-ke uphawu ngaphambi kwegama le-y² luyashintsha, ngakho i-ellipse iba yi-hyperbola. 9−k ihlala inhle.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.prompt: Uma ufaka k=10, isibalo siba ngu-x²/(−1) + y²/(−6) = 1. Yisiphi isitatimende esilungile mayelana nesibalo lesi sibalo esimelayo?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala kabusha uhlangothi lwesobunxele ngokususa izihlukanisi.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ibanga lamanani uhlangothi lwesobunxele olungawathatha nohlangothi lwesokudla, 1.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.a: Akukho phoyinti (x, y) ligculisa lesi sibalo.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.b: Iyi-ellipse, ngoba noma izihlukanisi zombili zishintshile, isesefomini lesamba.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.b: Noma izihlukanisi zombili zingekho kahle, isesefomini lesamba, kodwa awuhlolanga ukuthi uhlangothi lwesobunxele alukwazi ukuba lukhulu kuno-0, ngakho alukwazi ukulingana no-1 ohlangothini lwesokudla.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.c: Iyi-hyperbola evuleka ohlangothini lwe-x-axis, ngoba 9−k ayinhle.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.c: Izihlukanisi zombili azinhle, ngakho akusesefomini lokukhipha. Bheka izimpawu futhi.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.d: Siyisiyingi, ngoba amagama amabili abukeka afana.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.d: Izihlukanisi zinamanani ahlukile, ngakho ayikwazi ukuba yisiyingi, futhi awuhlolanga nezimpawu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.explain: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele ngu-−x²−y²/6, olungu-0 noma ngaphansi. Alukwazi ukulingana no-1 ohlangothini lwesokudla, ngakho akukho (x, y) engempela egculisa lesi sibalo. Kuye ngokuthi izihlukanisi zinhle noma azinhle, siyahlukana sibe i-ellipse, i-hyperbola, noma akukho lutho nhlobo.

n-m-h3-conic-07.topic: Ama-conic section: izincazelo nolayini abathintayo be-parabola, ama-ellipse, nama-hyperbola; ukuhambisana phakathi kwezibalo nezibalo
n-m-h3-conic-07.title: Isamba sezindlela ezimbili ezidlula ephoyintini ku-parabola
n-m-h3-conic-07.goal: Usebenzisa indawo yamaphoyinti, bona ukuthi umkhawulo ophansi kusukela ku-triangle inequality akuhlali kungenani elifinyelelwayo, bese uthola i-minimum kabusha usebenzisa incazelo ye-parabola (ibanga elisuka ku-focus = ibanga elisuka ku-directrix).
n-m-h3-conic-07.material: I-parabola y² = 8x inayo i-focus F(2, 0) ne-directrix x = −2. U-Seoyun uthi, "Kuphoyinti P elisejikeni nanoma yiliphi iphoyinti A, i-minimum ye-PA + PF ihlala ingu-AF nge-triangle inequality."
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.1: Bhala kabusha ngefomu elihlukile usebenzisa incazelo
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.prompt: Ku-parabola u-y² = 8x ene-focus u-F(2, 0) neliphoyinti u-A(4, 2), wahambisa iphoyinti u-P ekhebulini ukuthola inani elincane kakhulu luka-PA+PF. Yiliphi inani nesizathu esifanelana kangcono?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha amaphoyinti amaningana u-P ekhebulini, bala u-PA+PF ngqo, futhi wenze ithebula.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Khumbula incazelo futhi uhlole ukuthi ungakwazi yini ukubhala kabusha u-PF njengobunye ubude ephoyinteni elise-parabola.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.a: 6, ngoba kulingana nebanga elisuka ku-A liya ku-directrix.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.b: 2√2, ngoba PA+PF ≥ AF futhi kukhona u-P lapho ukulingana kusebenza khona.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.b: Ukulingana ekungalinganini kukanxantathu kusebenza kuphela uma u-P esengxenyeni u-AF. Awuhlolanga ukuthi u-P onjalo useqhelweni yini.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.c: Ubheke kuphela amakhodi ephoyinti u-A. Akukho ncazelo yokuthi leli nani yisamba samabanga angaphi.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.d: Uthole kuphela inani endaweni e-1 futhi awuhlolanga ukuthi liyinani elincane kakhulu yini.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.explain: Ephoyinteni elise-parabola, u-PF ulingana nebanga elisuka ku-P liya ku-directrix u-x=−2. Ngakho u-PA+PF yisamba sika-PA no-"ibanga elisuka ku-P liya ku-directrix," elingu-6 okungenani, ibanga elisuka ku-A liya ku-directrix. Lilingana no-6 ephoyinteni elisekhebulini ekuphakameni okufanayo no-A, njengo-P=(0.5, 2). U-2√2 ngu-AF, kodwa u-A no-F bobabili basengaphakathi kwekhebula, ngakho ingxenye u-AF ayinqamuli ikhebula futhi ayikwazi ukufinyelelwa.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu khetha iphoyinti u-A(x, y) elinamakhodi ezinombolo ezigcwele (−10 kuya ku-10), futhi uthole futhi ufake amaphoyinti amathathu ahlukile u-A lapho inani elincane kakhulu luka-PA+PF lilingana no-AF njengoba u-P ehamba ekhebulini.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokusho ukuthi u-P kufanele abe kuphi ukuze ukulingana ekungalinganini kukanxantathu kusebenze.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa amacala lapho u-A esengaphakathi nangaphandle kwekhebula, futhi udwebe ukuthi ingxenye u-AF ihlangana nekhebula yini.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Lawa makhodi ezinombolo ezigcwele ngaphakathi kohla.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Amakhodi kufanele abe yizinombolo ezigcwele kusuka ku-−10 kuya ku-10 kuhlanganisiwe.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ingxenye u-AF ihlangana nekhebula, ngakho kukhona u-P onu-PA+PF=AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kule phoyinti, akukho u-P ekhebulini lapho lilingana no-AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.explain: PA+PF ≥ AF, futhi ukulingana kusebenza kuphela uma u-P esengxenyeni u-AF. U-F usengaphakathi kwekhebula, ngakho uma u-A esekhebulini noma ngaphandle kwalo (y² ≥ 8x), ingxenye u-AF ihlangana nekhebula. Uma u-A esengaphakathi (y² < 8x), ingxenye ayihlangani nekhebula, ngakho inani elincane kakhulu likhulu kuno-AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.prompt: Ku-A(4, 2), inani elincane kakhulu laphuma likhulu kuno-AF. Chaza ukuthi kungani isisho sikaSeoyun "inani elincane kakhulu luka-PA+PF lihlala lingu-AF" siphosile.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.0: Sho ukuthi u-P kufanele abe kuphi ukuze ukulingana kusebenze ekungalinganini uSeoyun asisebenzisile.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi lowo mmandla uhlangatshezwa ku-A(4, 2) usebenzisa izindawo zengxenye u-AF nekhebula.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Usho ukuthi umphumela uhluka kuye ngendawo yephoyinti u-A (ngaphakathi/ngaphandle kwekhebula)?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.0: U-PF ulingana nebanga elisuka ku-P liya ku-directrix, ngakho u-PA+PF ungu-6 okungenani, ibanga elisuka ku-A liya ku-directrix. Lo-6 mkhulu kakhulu kuno-AF=2√2. Isisho sikaSeoyun asiyiso njalo, njengoba kukhona amacala lapho u-AF eyinani elincane kakhulu.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.1: Ukulingana ekungalinganini kukanxantathu u-PA+PF≥AF kusebenza kuphela uma u-P esengxenyeni u-AF. Uma u-A no-F bobabili besengaphakathi kwekhebula, ingxenye u-AF ayihlangani nekhebula, ngakho akukho u-P onjalo. Ngakho inani elincane kakhulu likhulu kuno-AF.

n-m-h3-diffc-05.title: Uma umsebenzi wangaphakathi unekhoneni, ingabe umsebenzi oyinhlanganisela unalo futhi?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.goal: Hlola isimangalo esithi "uma umsebenzi wangaphakathi ungahlukaniseki, umsebenzi oyinhlanganisela nawo awuhlukaniseki" ngezibonelo, bese uqinisekisa imigomo lapho umsebenzi oyinhlanganisela uba nokuhlukaniseka ngezibonelo ozakhe wena.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.material: g(x)=|x| akahlukaniseki ku-x=0. (I-slope esobunxeleni bika-x=0 ingu-−1, futhi eseningizimu yesokudla ingu-1.) UMinseo uthi, "Uma umsebenzi wangaphakathi u-g ungahlukaniseki ku-x=0, khona-ke kunoma yimuphi umsebenzi ohlukanisekayo u-f, umsebenzi oyinhlanganisela u-h(x)=f(g(x))=f(|x|) awuhlukaniseki ku-x=0."
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.1: Yakha futhi uhlole isibonelo esanelisa imigomo
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.2: Chaza umphumela esimeni lapho umthetho wochungechunge ungeke usetshenziswe
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha bonke u-f lapho u-h(x)=f(|x|) uba nokuhlukaniseka ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kuma-f ngamunye, bhala u-h(x)=f(|x|) ngqo ngo-|x|.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.1: Eduze kuka-x=0, sebenzisa |x|=x ku-x>0 no-|x|=−x ku-x<0 ukuqhathanisa isimo sika-h kwesobunxele nakwesokudla.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.a: h(x)=x²+|x|, futhi u-x² akakwazi ukufihla ikhoneni lika-|x|. Kulo f, i-slope ku-x=0 ayingu-0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.b: h(x)=|x|³, ngakho ama-slope ezinhlangothini zombili ze-x=0 asondela ku-0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.e: h(x)=(|x|−1)²=x²−2|x|+1, futhi ngenxa ka-−2|x| linekhoneni ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.explain: I-derivative yesokudla ka-h ku-x=0 ngu-f′(0) futhi eyesobunxele ngu-−f′(0). Ukuze zilingane, f′(0)=0 iyadingeka. U-x³ no-x²+3 banayo f′(0)=0, ngakho bahlukanisekile, futhi abanye banayo f′(0) elingana no-1, 3, no-−2 ngokulandelana, ngakho banamakhoneni.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.prompt: Vumela f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx. Faka amathrayiphu amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlukile (a, b, c) enza u-h(x)=f(|x|) ahlukaniseke ku-x=0. Lapha u-a no-b abayona u-0, futhi konke kuyizinombolo ezifelele kusuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9 kufakiwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala u-f(|x|) njengesisho bese uhlukanisa amathemu lapho u-|x| asala njenge-power engaphindwayo namathemu ane-power ephindwayo, lapho u-|x| elahleka.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ithemu elishiya u-|x| njengoba injalo futhi linikeza ikhoneni ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Wonke ama-coefficient amathathu ayizinombolo ezifelele ngaphakathi kobubanzi.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, no-c kufanele kube yizinombolo ezifelele kusuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9 kufakiwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Uma i-coefficient ka-x ingeyona u-0, u-h unekhoneni ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.explain: Ku-h(x)=a|x|³+bx²+c|x|, a|x|³ no-bx² bahlukaniseka ku-x=0, futhi c|x| inekhoneni uma c≠0. Ngakho c kufanele ibe ngu-0. Okusho ukuthi, f′(0)=c=0. (1, 2, 1) inayo c≠0, ngakho inekhoneni; (0, 2, 0) no-(1, 0, −2) banayo a=0 no-b=0 ngokulandelana, ngakho baphula umgomo c2, futhi owokugcina uphula no-c3.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ukuthi isimangalo sikaMinseo asilungile usebenzisa izibonelo ezingenhla, bese ubhala ukuthi yimuphi umgomo okufanele u-f awanelise ukuze u-f(|x|) ahlukaniseke ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Beka eceleni kwenye ama-f ahlukaniseke esinyathelweni esedlule nalawo angahlukanisekanga, bese uqhathanisa i-slope ka-f ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Chaza i-slope yesokudla ne-slope yesobunxele ka-h ku-x=0 ngokwe-slope ka-f.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unikeze u-f oyedwa othile bese ubonisa ukuthi u-h(x) uhlukaniseka ku-x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi i-slope yesobunxele ne-slope yesokudla ziba lingana kanjani?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.0: Uma f(x)=x²+3, khona-ke h(x)=x²+3, ohlukaniseka ku-x=0. Nakuba u-|x| enekhoneni, uhlanganisela akanalo. I-slope yesokudla ka-h ngu-f′(0) futhi i-slope yesobunxele ngu-−f′(0), ngakho uma f′(0)=0 ama-slope amabili alingana futhi uyahlukaniseka. Ngakho isimangalo sikaMinseo asilungile.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.1: Isibonelo esiphikisayo ngu-f(x)=x³. h(x)=|x|³ une-slope engu-0 ku-x=0. Ngokujwayelekile, uma f′(0)=0, ama-derivative esobunxele nesokudla angu-0 no-0, ngakho uyahlukaniseka, futhi uma f′(0) ingeyona u-0, unekhoneni.

n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu o-1 ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo ngokususelwa kuphela kulokho owaziyo kuze kube manje.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.title: Kwenzekani uma i-slope ingu-0 futhi inani lokugoba nalo lingu-0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.topic: Ukuhlukanisa: ukuhumusha amagrafu, amanani anqamulayo, ne-derivative yesibili
n-m-h3-diffc-04.goal: Njengoba ulwazi lungezwa kancane kancane, buyekeza izinqumo mayelana namanani anqamulayo, bese uqonda ukuthi lapho inani le-derivative yesibili lingu-0, kufanele ubheke ngqo ushintsho lophawu lwe-derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.material: Umsebenzi we-polynomial u-f unelisa f′(0)=0 ku-x=0. Njalo lapho kwembulwa ucezu lolwazi, hlola isinqumo sakho mayelana nokuthi igrafu inesimo esinjani ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.0: Buyekeza isinqumo sakho ngokuya ngolwazi olusha
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.2: Hlola amanani anqamulayo ngoshintsho lophawu lwe-derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.0: Ubuhlobo phakathi kwamanani anqamulayo noshintsho lophawu lwe-derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.2: Incazelo yephoyinti lokugoba (iphoyinti lapho ukugoba kushintsha khona)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, nquma ukuthi lusetshenziselwa yiluphi uhlolo nokuthi imigomo ilungile yini ukuze uhlolo lunikeze isiphetho.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi amaqiniso okuthi u-f′ no-f″ ngamunye ungu-0 asho into efanayo nezimpawu zesobunxele nezesokudla salelo phoyinti yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Singasho yini ukuthi u-f unenani elinqamulayo ku-x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: f′(x)=0 ikutshela kuphela umkhethwa wenani elinqamulayo. Udinga ukwazi okwengeziwe ngophawu lwe-f′ ngaphambi nje nangemva nje kwe-x=0, noma uphawu lwe-f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Liyinani eliphansi lendawo: uma umugqa othintayo uvundlile, igrafu iwuhlangabeza kusuka ngaphansi
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthathe wonke amaphoyinti anomugqa othintayo ovundlile njengamanani aphansi endawo. Umugqa othintayo ovundlile ungenzeka enanini eliphakeme lendawo, enanini eliphansi lendawo, noma ephoyintini lokugoba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Liyinani eliphakeme lendawo: uma umugqa othintayo uvundlile, kuyisiqongo segrafu
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthathe wonke amaphoyinti anomugqa othintayo ovundlile njengamanani aphakeme endawo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asikazi okwamanje: lingaba noma lingabi yinani elinqamulayo, ngakho sidinga ukwazi okwengeziwe
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi umugqa othintayo ovundlile kuphela awukwazi ukunquma ukuthi liyinani elinqamulayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ubona lolu lwazi, isinqumo sakho siyini manje?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Uhlolo lokuthi f″(0)>0 linikeza inani eliphansi lendawo futhi f″(0)<0 linikeza inani eliphakeme lendawo alikutsheli lutho uma f″(0)=0. f(x)=x⁴, −x⁴, no-x³ bonke banayo f′(0)=f″(0)=0, kodwa izimo zabo ziyahluka.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akulona inani elinqamulayo: uma u-f″(0) engu-0, akulona inani elinqamulayo
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ufunde f″(0)=0 njengobufakazi bokuthi akulona inani elinqamulayo. Konke okushoyo ukuthi uhlolo oluthi "i-derivative yesibili eyipositive isho inani eliphansi lendawo, eyinegative isho inani eliphakeme lendawo" alikwazi ukusetshenziswa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Akunakunqunywa ngalolu lwazi: uhlolo olusebenzisa i-derivative yesibili luyayeka ukusebenza
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uqaphele ukuthi uma f″(0)=0, u-f″ awukwazi ukusetshenziswa ukunquma ukuthi liyinani eliphakeme noma eliphansi lendawo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Liyinani eliphansi lendawo: i-slope ingu-0 futhi ukugoba kungu-0, ngakho kuyisicaba kakhulu
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uqinisekise inani eliphansi lendawo ngenxa yemizwa "yokuba yisicaba." Iphoyinti eliyisicaba alikhona ngempela iphoyinti eliphansi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: f′(x)=4x³ iyinegative ku-x<0 futhi iyipositive ku-x>0, ngakho u-f unenani eliphansi lendawo ku-x=0. Futhi f″(x)=12x²≥0, ngakho ukugoba akushintshi, futhi akulona iphoyinti lokugoba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Linenani eliphansi lendawo, futhi leli phoyinti akulona iphoyinti lokugoba
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ufunde ndawonye ukuthi uphawu lwe-f′ lushintsha lusuka kunegative luye kupositive nokuthi u-f″ okungenani ungu-0 futhi akashintshi uphawu.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Alinalo inani elinqamulayo, futhi leli phoyinti liyiphoyinti lokugoba
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Unqume ukuthi liyiphoyinti lokugoba ngoba kuphela f″(0)=0. Ukuze libe yiphoyinti lokugoba, uphawu lwe-f″ kufanele lushintshe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Linenani eliphansi lendawo, futhi leli phoyinti nalo liyiphoyinti lokugoba
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi f″(0)=0 isho iphoyinti lokugoba. f″(x)=12x² okungenani ngu-0, ngakho uphawu lwayo alushintshi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, f′(0)=0 kuphela kwenza kwabonakala njengenani elinqamulayo, futhi lapho kuvela f″(0)=0, uhlolo lwayeka ukusebenza. Nokho, ungafinyelela esiphethweni ngokuhlola ngqo ukuthi uphawu lwe-f′ lushintsha yini. Inani elingu-0 lihlukile ekushintsheni kophawu.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umsebenzi one-f′(0)=0 ne-f″(0)=0 ongenalo inani elinqamulayo ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Thola i-derivative yomsebenzi ngamunye bese uqhathanisa uphawu lwayo kwesobunxele nakwesokudla ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Wahlukanise abe yimisebenzi lapho uphawu lwe-f′ lushintsha nemisebenzi lapho lungashintshi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.a: U-x⁴ unayo f′(0)=f″(0)=0 kodwa unenani eliphansi lendawo ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.b: U-−x⁶ unayo f′(0)=f″(0)=0 kodwa unenani eliphakeme lendawo ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.c: U-x⁶ naye unenani eliphansi lendawo ku-x=0. Bheka ukuthi i-exponent iyaphindwa yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.d: Ku-x³, f′(x)=3x² ayishintshi uphawu, ngakho akukho nani elinqamulayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.explain: Ku-x³, f′(x)=3x²≥0, ngakho u-f′ unophawu olufanayo ngaphambi nangemva kwe-x=0, futhi akukho nani elinqamulayo. Kwemisebenzi emithathu esele, uphawu lwe-f′ luyashintsha, ngakho inamanani anqamulayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi f′(0)=f″(0)=0 kuphela akunakukutshela ukuthi liyiphi icala.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.prompt: Uma f′(0)=0 no-f″(0)=0, bhala ukuthi yini okufanele uyihlole, nokuthi kanjani, ukunquma ukuthi kukhona yini inani elinqamulayo ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi kubukeka kanjani ukusho ukuthi kunenani elinqamulayo ngokuphathelene nophawu lwe-f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ngokuhlukile indlela engasasetshenziswa uma f″(0)=0 neyindlela ezosasetshenziswa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Uma f″(0)=0, khona-ke ... esikhundleni salokho ...
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi uqhathanisa uphawu lwe-f′ kwesobunxele nakwesokudla ku-x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi f″(0)=0 akusho ukuthi akukho nani elinqamulayo?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.0: Uma f″(0)=0, i-derivative yesibili ayikwazi ukukutshela ukuthi liyinani eliphakeme noma eliphansi lendawo. Ngakho kufanele ubheke ngqo ukuthi uphawu lwe-f′ lushintsha yini kwesobunxele nakwesokudla ku-x=0. Uma lushintsha, kunenani elinqamulayo, futhi uma lungashintshi, alikho.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.1: Uma inani le-derivative yesibili lingu-0, uhlolo luyayeka ukusebenza, ngakho dweba ishadi lezimpawu lika-f′(x). Uma u-f′ eshintsha esuka kunegative eya kupositive (inani eliphansi) noma esuka kupositive eya kunegative (inani eliphakeme) eduze kuka-0, linenani elinqamulayo, futhi uma uphawu lusala lunjalo, alinalo.

n-m-h3-diffc-08.title: Ingabe ulayini othinta ihlangana nejika kuphela endaweni yokuthinta?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b bayizinombolo eziphelele ngaphakathi kohla.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.topic: I-differentiation: izibalo zolayini abathintayo, ulayini othintayo wamajika e-cubic
n-m-h3-diffc-08.goal: Zakhele wena isibonelo solayini othintayo wejika le-cubic ohlangana nejika futhi endaweni engeyona indawo yokuthinta, bese uhlukanisa izindawo zokuthinta lapho lokhu kungenzeki.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.material: Ulayini othintayo wejika y=x³−3x endaweni A(1, −2) uyi-y=−2. Kugrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic, ubonile ukuthi ulayini othintayo uhlangana nejika kuphela endaweni eyodwa yokuthinta. Kunjalo yini nakulelijika?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.1: Ukuhlukanisa izibalo ze-cubic ngezinto (impande ephindwe kabili)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.prompt: Uma uthola wonke ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti lapho ulayini othintayo y=−2 uhlangana khona nejika y=x³−3x, uthola ini?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Amaphoyinti lapho ulayini othintayo nejika kuhlangana khona ayizixazululo zesibalo esilinganisa izisho ezimbili. Setha isibalo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi x=1 isixazululo ukuze uhlukanise uhlangothi lwesobunxele ngezinto.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi njengoba kungulayini othintayo, uhlangana nejika kuphela endaweni yokuthinta. Xazulula isibalo x³−3x=−2 ngqo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.b: Uthathe u-x=1 no-−1 njengepheya. Faka u-x=−1 esibalweni ukuze uhlole.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kuwumphumela wokuhlukanisa i-x³−3x+2=0 ngezinto njenge-(x−1)²(x+2)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.d: Uphutha impande ephindwe kabili x=1. x=1 yindawo yokuthinta, ngakho ilele kulayini othintayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.explain: x³−3x+2=(x−1)²(x+2), ngakho izixazululo ngu-x=1 (impande ephindwe kabili, indawo yokuthinta) no-x=−2. Endaweni (−2, −2), ulayini othintayo uphinda uhlangane nejika.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.prompt: Faka amapheya amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlukene (a, b) lapho ulayini othintayo wejika y=x³−3x endaweni (a, a³−3a) uphinda uhlangane nejika endaweni (b, b³−3b) engeyona indawo yokuthinta. (a no-b bayizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-−6 kuya ku-6 kufakwe, futhi b≠a)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha inani le-x-coordinate a yendawo yokuthinta, thola isibalo solayini othintayo, bese ubhala isibalo esitholwa ngokusilinganisa nejika.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa isixazululo osivele usazi kuleso sibalo (indawo yokuthinta) ukuze uthole izixazululo ezisele.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.var.b: i-x-coordinate b yephoyinti lapho kuhlangana futhi
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kumele bayizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-−6 kuya ku-6 kufakwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.explain: Ukulinganisa isibalo solayini othintayo endaweni (a, a³−3a) nejika kunikeza (x−a)²(x+2a)=0, ngakho i-x-coordinate yephoyinti lapho kuhlangana futhi ngu-b=−2a. (1, −2), (2, −4), no-(−3, 6) yizibonelo; (1, 1) yindawo yokuthinta uqobo, futhi (1, −1) akuyona indawo kulayini othintayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Ubheka amapheya (a, b) owatholile, bhala ubudlelwano obuveza b ngo-a, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani lobo budlelwano buyiqiniso.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Beka amanani ka-a no-b ezibonelweni zakho eceleni kuthebula bese uqhathanisa ukuthi inani b lingakhulu kangaki ngezikhathi ezingaka a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isibalo esihlanganisiwe siyi-cubic nokuthi i-x=a iyiluphi uhlobo lwempande (impande eyodwa noma ephindwe kabili), bese ubhala izimpande ezintathu.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.placeholder: isb. Ukulinganisa ulayini othintayo nejika kunikeza ...
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi isibalo se-cubic esenziwe ulayini othintayo nejika sinempande ephindwe kabili endaweni yokuthinta?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthole u-b usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi isamba sezimpande ezintathu singu-0, noma usebenzisa ukuhlukanisa ngezinto?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.0: b=−2a. Ukulinganisa ulayini othintayo nejika kunikeza isibalo se-cubic sesimo x³−3x=m(x−a)+a³−3a, futhi indawo yokuthinta x=a iyimpande ephindwe kabili, ngakho ingabhalwa njenge-(x−a)²(x−b). I-coefficient ye-x² iyi-0, ngakho isamba sezimpande ezintathu singu-a+a+b=0, okunikeza b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngihloliile ukuthi iba yi-(x−a)²(x+2a)=0. Indawo yokuthinta iyimpande ephindwe kabili, ngakho kunento (x−a)², futhi akukho ithemu ye-x², ngakho impande esele ngu-−2a, okungukuthi, b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwamaphoyinti ejikeni y=x³−3x, kwiphi i-x-coordinate lapho ulayini othintayo kuleyo ndawo ungahlangani nejika noma kuphi ngaphandle kwendawo yokuthinta?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa ubudlelwano obutholile esinyathelweni esedlule, thola i-x-coordinate yephoyinti lapho kuhlangana futhi kwindawo yokuthinta ekukhetheni ngakunye.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani uma iphoyinti lapho kuhlangana futhi liba yilona elifanayo nendawo yokuthinta.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.a: Uma a=−1, ulayini othintayo uphinda uhlangane nejika ku-x=2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ucabangele icala lapho i-x-coordinate yephoyinti lapho kuhlangana futhi iba yilona elifanayo nendawo yokuthinta.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.c: Uma a=1, ulayini othintayo uphinda uhlangane nejika ku-x=−2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.d: Uma a=2, ulayini othintayo uphinda uhlangane nejika ku-x=−4.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.explain: I-x-coordinate yephoyinti lapho kuhlangana futhi ngu-−2a, ngakho lokhu kulingana nendawo yokuthinta kuphela uma −2a=a, okungukuthi, a=0. Ulayini othintayo y=−3x uhlangana nejika endaweni eyodwa x=0, kusukela ku-x³=0. Le ndawo iphinda ibe yi-inflection point yejika.

n-m-h3-diffc-06.title: Kufanele utshele kanjani umfundi omncane ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukuthi i-derivative yesibili iyipositive?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.topic: Ukuhlukanisa: ukuhumusha amagrafu, i-derivative yesibili nokuvuleka
n-m-h3-diffc-06.goal: Thola umusho ongalungile encazelweni yomfundi omkhulu, uyihlole ngesibonelo esiphikisayo, bese uyibhala kabusha njengomusho olungile umfundi omncane angawuqonda.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.material: Umfundi wakho omncane uHaeun ubuze, "Uma f″(x)>0, igrafu iyenyuka yini njengoba iya kwesokudla?" Umfundi wakho omkhulu uJihu waphendula njengoba kuboniswe ngezansi. Hlola lokhu kubhalwe beseukubhala kabusha ukuze uHaeun akuqonde. (f″ yi-derivative ye-derivative ka-f.)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.2: Incazelo yokuvuleka ngezansi (concave up) nokuvuleka ngaphezulu (concave down)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umusho owodwa ongalungile empendulweni kaJihu.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Landela ukuthi umusho ngamunye uqhubeka kanjani kusuka kowedlule, oyedwa ngesikhathi.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi uphawu lomsebenzi muphi odinga ukulwazi ukuze usho ukuthi "inani liyakhula."
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.1: U-f′(x) ukhula kusho ukuthi i-slope yomugqa othintayo iqhubeka ikhula.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.2: Ngakho esikhawini lapho f″(x)>0, inani lika-f(x) nalo likhula njengoba uya kwesokudla.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.explain: Umusho 3 awulungile. Ukuthi inani lika-f(x) likhula noma liyehla kunqunywa uphawu lwe-f′(x). f″>0 ikutshela kuphela ukuthi u-f′ uyakhula, ngakho esikhawini lapho u-f′ eyinegative, u-f(x) angaba uyehla futhi abe nayo f″>0.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.prompt: Yimuphi umsebenzi nesikhawu ezibonisa ngokucacile kakhulu ukuthi umusho 3 awulungile?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Isibonelo esiphikisayo yicala lapho "umgomo wokuqala uyiqiniso kodwa isiphetho singamanga." Kumsebenzi ngamunye, hlola ngokuhlukile uphawu lwe-f″ nokuthi u-f ukhula yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kukhetha ngakunye, thola futhi uphawu lwe-f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.a: Kulesi sikhala f″=2>0 futhi i-f iyakhula, ngakho ayiphikisani nomusho wesi-3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.b: f″=2>0 kodwa f′=2x<0, ngakho i-f iyehla. Lesi yisibonelo esiphikisana nomusho wesi-3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.d: f″=6x>0 futhi i-f iyakhula, ngakho ayiphikisani nomusho wesi-3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.explain: Ku-f(x)=x² no-x<0, f″(x)=2>0 kodwa f′(x)=2x<0, ngakho i-f(x) iyehla. Igrafu ivulekile ngaphezulu kodwa iyehla.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umusho wesi-3 ukuze uHaeun akwazi ukuwuqonda. Kumele ufake lokho i-f″(x)>0 ekutshela kona, nokuthi yini enquma ukuthi i-f(x) iyakhula noma iyehla.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngamakholomu amabili lokho i-f″>0 ekutshela kona nalokho engakutsheli kona.
