n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala onephutha esixazululweni sikaSeoyeon.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.title: I-derivative yesibili yejika elinikezwe nge-parameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.topic: I-differentiation: i-derivative yesibili yomsebenzi onikezwe nge-parameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.goal: Kujika elinikezwe nge-parameter, thola futhi ulungise iphutha esixazululweni esiphinda sihlukanisa i-dy/dx, bese ukhetha ifomula elungile.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaSeoyeon sokuthola i-derivative yesibili d²y/dx² ku-t=2 kujika x=t², y=t³−3t (t>0). (t² ngu-t isikwele futhi t³ ngu-t we-cube.)
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.0: Thola umugqa wokuqala ohamba kabi esixazululweni
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.2: Qhathanisa ukwakheka kwezisho ukuze ukhethe ifomula elungile
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qinisekisa ukuthi i-dy/dx emugqeni wesi-2 isisho ku-t, bese ucabanga ukuthi ungabhala kanjani inqubo yokuyihlukanisa ngokuhlobene no-x usebenzisa i-chain rule.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chaza ngamagama ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uthola iyiphi i-derivative, bese uhlola ukuthi ulandela ngokufanele emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo ngesibonelo esilula njenge-x=t², y=t³.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wesi-3 ungumugqa wokuqala onephutha. I-dy/dx isisho ku-t, ngakho ukuyihlukanisa ngokuhlobene no-x, kumele uqale uyihlukanise ngokuhlobene no-t bese wehlukanisa nge-dx/dt. Ukuhlukanisa u-y no-x kabili ngamunye bese wehlukanisa akuyona leyo ndlela yokubala. Umugqa wesi-4 usebenzisa nje umphumela womugqa wesi-3.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.prompt: Thola inani le-d²y/dx² ku-t=2 usebenzisa indlela elungile, bese ubhala ukuthi uyitholile kanjani.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza lula i-dy/dx njengesisho ku-t, bese uhlukanisa lesisho ngokuhlobene no-t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuhlukanisa ngokuhlobene no-x, sebenzisa i-dx/dt ukucabanga ukuthi i-derivative ngokuhlobene no-t kumele wehlukaniswe ngani.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqale wenza lula i-dy/dx njengesisho ku-t?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise lesisho ngokuhlobene no-t bese wehlukanisa nge-dx/dt?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.0: dy/dx=(3t²−3)/(2t)=(3/2)(t−1/t), futhi ukuyihlukanisa ngokuhlobene no-t kunikeza (3/2)(1+1/t²). Ukukwehlukanisa nge-dx/dt=2t kunikeza d²y/dx². Ku-t=2, (3/2)(5/4)=15/8, kwehlukaniswe nga-4, kunikeza 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.1: d²y/dx²=(d/dt(dy/dx))÷(dx/dt). Ukufaka t=2 ku-d/dt{(3/2)(t−1/t)}=(3/2)(1+1/t²) kunikeza 15/8, futhi ukwehlukanisa nge-dx/dt=4 kunikeza 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.prompt: Khetha ifomula elungile yokuthola i-d²y/dx² kujika elinikezwe nge-parameter.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi i-d²y/dx² ingafundwa kanjani "ukuhlukanisa yini ngokuhlobene nani."
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa i-chain rule ukucabanga ukuthi kumele uphindaphinde noma wehlukanise ngani ukuze ushintshe i-differentiation ngokuhlobene no-t ibe ngokuhlobene no-x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.a: Hlukanisa u-y ohlukanisiwe kabili ngokuhlobene no-t nge-x ehlukanisiwe kabili ngokuhlobene no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.a: Le yindlela esetshenziswe nguSeoyeon. Isilinganiso samanani ahlukaniswe kabili ngokuhlobene no-t sihlukile ku-dy/dx ehlukaniswe ngokuhlobene no-x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.b: Hlukanisa i-dy/dx ehlukaniswe kanye ngokuhlobene no-t nge-x ehlukaniswe kanye ngokuhlobene no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.b: Lokhu kuveza inqubo yokuhlukanisa i-dy/dx ngokuhlobene no-x usebenzisa i-chain rule.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.c: Hlukanisa i-dy/dx ehlukaniswe kanye ngokuhlobene no-t nge-x ehlukaniswe kabili ngokuhlobene no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.c: Ubeke i-derivative yesibili ka-x esihlukanisini. Ukushintshela ku-differentiation ngokuhlobene no-x, wehlukanisa nge-dx/dt kanye.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.d: Hlukanisa i-dy/dx ehlukaniswe kanye ngokuhlobene no-t nge-square ye-x ehlukaniswe kanye ngokuhlobene no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.d: Usikwele isihlukanisi. Ku-chain rule, okuwukuphela kwento owehlukanisa ngayo ukuze ushintshe i-differentiation ngokuhlobene no-t ibe ngokuhlobene no-x yi-dx/dt, kanye.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.explain: d²y/dx²=d/dx(dy/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]·(dt/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]÷(dx/dt). Ku-t=2, amafomula angenhla anikeza 6, 15/16, no-15/128 ngokulandelana, ahluka kunani elilungile 15/32.

n-m-h3-conic-03.topic: Ama-conic section: izincazelo nolayini abathintayo be-parabola, ama-ellipse, nama-hyperbola; ukuhambisana phakathi kwezibalo nezibalo
n-m-h3-conic-03.title: I-locus yephoyinti P ishintsha kanjani uma iphoyinti F lihamba?
n-m-h3-conic-03.goal: Qinisekisa ezincazelweni ukuthi ekwakhiweni okufanayo, ukushintsha indawo yephoyinti F kushintsha i-locus ibe yisiyingi, i-ellipse, noma i-hyperbola, bese wakha umkhuba wokungathwali isiphetho secala elilodwa ukusiyisa kwelinye ngaphandle kokusishintsha.
n-m-h3-conic-03.material: Endizeni kunesiyingi esinesikhungo O nobubanzi obungu-6, nephoyinti F. Kuphoyinti Q elihamba esiyingini, vumela P libe yiphoyinti lapho i-perpendicular bisector ye-segment FQ ihlangana khona nolayini O Q. Sizophenya isibalo esidwetshwa ngu-P njengoba Q ihamba esiyingini, sishintsha indawo ka-F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.0: Buyekeza isinqumo sakho njalo lapho isimo sishintsha
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.1: Thola i-locus usebenzisa isamba nomehluko wamabanga
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.2: Qaphela ingozi yokwenza isiphetho esivamile ngecala elikhethekile (F=O)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.0: Izincazelo zama-ellipse nama-hyperbola (isamba samabanga, umehluko wamabanga)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.1: Isici sokuthi iphoyinti ku-perpendicular bisector ye-segment lilingana ibanga nemiphetho emibili
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi njengoba indawo yephoyinti F ishintsha. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo esisekelwe kulokho okwaziwa kuze kube manje kuphela.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, dweba umfanekiso okhombisa ukuthi iphoyinti P lime kuphi ku-segment OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa i-PF=PQ ukuhlola ukuthi isamba noma umehluko we-PO ne-PF wenza lula ube yinani elingashintshi yini.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Qala ucabangele icala lapho i-F iyiphoyinti elifanayo nesikhungo O. Iphoyinti ku-perpendicular bisector ye-segment FQ lilingana ibanga ne-F ne-Q, ngakho PF=PQ. Iphoyinti P lilele kulayini OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Njengoba Q ijikeleza isiyingi kanye, P idweba siphi isibalo?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Uma F=O, bese PO=PQ no-PO+PQ=OQ=6, ngakho PO=3. P iphoyinti elingu-3 ukusuka ku-O, ngakho idweba isiyingi esinobubanzi obungu-3.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uvele wavuselela isiyingi esidwetshwa ngu-Q. P akuyona i-Q; liyiphoyinti ku-perpendicular bisector ye-FQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ubone ukuthi P ihlala ibanga elingashintshi ukusuka ku-O.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I-ellipse ene-O neminye indawo njengezindawo zayo zokugxila
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Asikho esimweni sezindawo zokugxila ezimbili okwamanje. F no-O liyiphoyinti elifanayo.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uma Q ihamba, P nayo iyahamba.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.info: F ihanjiswe yaya ephoyintini ngaphakathi kwesiyingi, elingu-4 ukusuka ku-O. Kusengiqiniso ukuthi PF=PQ. Uma udweba umfanekiso, P ilele ku-segment OQ (phakathi kuka-O no-Q).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Njengoba P ise-segment OQ, PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ=6. Isamba samabanga ukusuka emaphoyinti amabili O no-F siyi-6 engashintshi, ngakho yi-ellipse enezindawo zokugxila O no-F ne-major axis yobude obungu-6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Isiyingi esinesikhungo O: ngoba Q isesiyingini
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uma F isuka ku-O, PO ayisaguquki. Uthwale isiphetho sesinyathelo esedlule wasishintsha ngaphandle kwenguquko.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: I-hyperbola enomehluko ongashintshi wamabanga asuka ku-O no-F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I-hyperbola enomehluko ongashintshi wamabanga asuka ku-O no-F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Awuhlolanga ukuthi i-PO ne-PF iyangezwa noma iyakhishwa. Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi P ise-segment OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: I-ellipse enesamba esingashintshi samabanga asuka ku-O no-F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi isamba asishintshi, ngoba PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: I-parabola enamaphoyinti alingana ibanga no-F nolayini
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Amabanga alinganayo ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-F no-Q (PF=PQ), futhi libanga eliya ephoyintini Q, hhayi kulayini.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Kulokhu F ihanjiswe yaya ephoyintini ngaphandle kwesiyingi, elingu-9 ukusuka ku-O. Uma udweba umfanekiso, P ayise-segment OQ kodwa ise-extension kalayini OQ (ohlangothini luka-Q noma luka-O). Kusengiqiniso ukuthi PF=PQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ekunweleni ohlangothini lwe-Q, PO=OQ+PQ, ngakho PO−PF=6, futhi ekunweleni ohlangothini lwe-O, PF−PO=6. Kunoma ikuphi, |PO−PF|=6 ingaguquki, ngakho i-hyperbola enama-focus O no-F ne-transverse axis ende ngu-6 (OF=9>6).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Udlulisele umphumela wecala langaphakathi njengoba unjalo. Uma u-P engekho kucezu OQ, PO+PQ akulona OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hlola ukuthi PO ingaguquki yini. Uma u-F ekude no-O, ayiguquki.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Umugqa wokuhlukanisa ngesigamu o-perpendicular nomugqa OQ kuhlangana cishe kuwo wonke u-Q.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.reflect: Njengoba indawo ka-F ishintsha, ukwakha okufanayo kwanika isiyingi, i-ellipse, ne-hyperbola ngokulandelana. Ukudlulisela umphumela wangaphakathi ngaphandle njengoba unjalo kuyiphutha. Kuye ngokuthi iphoyinti P liku-segment OQ noma ekunweleni kwalo, kwashintsha ukuthi isamba noma umehluko we-PO ne-PF uyaguquki.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani i-locus ka-P ihluka uma u-F ungaphakathi kwesiyingi nalapho u-F engaphandle kwesiyingi, usebenzisa PO, PF, nerediyasi 6 yesiyingi.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sho ukuthi u-P uphi emgqeni OQ ecaleni langaphakathi nasecaleni langaphandle.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kucala ngalinye, xhumanisa ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-PO no-PQ nobude obungu-6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi PO+PF=6 ngaphakathi futhi |PO−PF|=6 ngaphandle?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze ukuthi isamba nomehluko kuyahlukana ngoba indawo ka-P (ku-segment noma ekunweleni) ihlukile?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.0: Uma u-F ungaphakathi, u-P uku-segment OQ, ngakho PO+PF=PO+PQ=6, isamba singaguquki, futhi iyi-ellipse. Uma u-F engaphandle, u-P usekunweleni, ngakho umehluko wa-PO no-PQ ungu-6, umehluko wa-PO no-PF ungaguquki ku-6, futhi iyi-hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.1: Uma u-F ungaphakathi kwesiyingi, isamba samabanga asuka ku-O no-F singu-6, ngakho iyi-ellipse, futhi uma u-F engaphandle kwesiyingi, inani eliphelele lomehluko wamabanga lingu-6 ongaguquki, ngakho iyi-hyperbola. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ukuthi u-P uku-segment noma ekunweleni kuyashintsha.

n-m-h3-conic-06.topic: Ama-conic section: izincazelo nolayini abathintayo be-parabola, ama-ellipse, nama-hyperbola; ukuhambisana phakathi kwezibalo nezibalo
n-m-h3-conic-06.title: I-focus ne-directrix ziya kuphi uma i-parabola ihanjiswa?
n-m-h3-conic-06.goal: Funda ngokulungile isiqondiso sokuhumusha kusuka esibalweni, hambisa i-focus ne-directrix ngokuhumusha okufanayo, bese ubhala incazelo yomfundi osemncane.
n-m-h3-conic-06.material: Umfundi wakho omncane u-Haeun ukuthumele inothi ngenkathi ezama ukuthola i-focus ne-directrix ye-parabola (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.0: Ukufunda ukuthi izimpawu esibalweni zihambisana kanjani nesiqondiso sokuhamba
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha incazelo ukuze ifanele umuntu omchazelayo
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.prompt: Lokhu yinothi elithunyelwe umfundi wakho omncane u-Haeun. Khetha umugqa wokuqala lapho kuphutha khona.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uthole iphoyinti esibalweni esisha lapho izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0. Liqhathanise nalapho leyo ndima ibidlalwa khona esibalweni esidala.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa ukuthi ukubala komugqa ngamunye kulandela emugqeni ongaphambilini noma kuwuhlulelo olusha.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.0: Ku-y² = −8x, 4p = −8, ngakho p = −2, i-focus ngu-(−2, 0), futhi i-directrix ngu-x = 2.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.1: (y−1)² = −8(x+2) inayo x+2 no-y−1, ngakho ngu-y² = −8x ohunyushwe ngo-+2 ohlangothini lwe-x no-−1 ohlangothini lwe-y.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.3: Ukuhambisa i-directrix ngendlela efanayo kunika x = 2+2 = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho i-focus ngu-(0, −1) futhi i-directrix ngu-x = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.explain: Ngumugqa 2. Ukubeka u-x+2 endaweni ka-x kuhambisa ngo-−2 ohlangothini lwe-x, futhi ukubeka u-y−1 endaweni ka-y kuhambisa ngo-+1 ohlangothini lwe-y. Izimpawu ziphambene. Konke kusuka emugqeni 3 kuyokubala okulandela isiqondiso emugqeni 2, ngakho uma isiqondiso siphutha, konke kuyiphutha. Umugqa 1 ulungile.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.prompt: Khetha indlela ethembekile kakhulu yokuhlola ukuthi isiqondiso sokuhumusha sika-Haeun silungile yini.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi iphoyinti elihambisana ne-vertex endala linaluphi uphawu esibalweni esisha sesibalo esihanjisiwe.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ukhumbule ukuthi i-focus ne-directrix zisejikeni yini.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.a: Faka i-focus etholiwe, (0, −1), ubone ukuthi igculisa isibalo esisha (y−1)² = −8(x+2) yini.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.a: I-focus akuyona iphoyinti elisejikeni, ngakho akudingeki ukuthi igculise isibalo uma kufakwa. Ngakho lolu hlolo alukwazi ukukutshela isiqondiso sokuhumusha.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.b: Qhathanisa ukuthi i-coefficient −8 esibalweni esisha ifana ne-coefficient esibalweni sokuqala yini.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.b: I-coefficient ikutshela kuphela isimo (isiqondiso sokuvuleka nobubanzi). Ayikutsheli ukuthi indawo yahanjiswa ngakuphi.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.c: Thola iphoyinti lapho izinhlangothi zombili zesibalo esisha zingu-0 ubone ukuthi yilapho i-vertex endala (0, 0) ihambele khona yini.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.d: Dweba igrafu ngokuyisilinganiso ubone ukuthi isiqondiso sokuvuleka sifana nangaphambili yini.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.d: Ukuhumusha akushintshi isiqondiso sokuvuleka, ngakho kubukeka kufana noma isiqondiso sokuhumusha siphutha.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.explain: I-vertex bekuyiphoyinti (0, 0) lapho izinhlangothi zombili zesibalo esidala zingu-0, ngakho iphoyinti (−2, 1) lapho izinhlangothi zombili zesibalo esisha zingu-0 yilapho i-vertex ihambele khona. Ngakho ukuhumusha ngu-−2 ngokuya ku-x-axis no-+1 ngokuya ku-y-axis. I-focus ne-directrix akuyona amaphoyinti asejikeni, ngakho awukwazi ukuzihlola ngokuzifaka esibalweni.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.prompt: U-Haeun ungumfundi wonyaka wokuqala wesikole esiphakeme osanda kufunda ukuhumusha. Bhala impendulo ozoyithumela ku-Haeun. Kufanele ihlanganise lapho kuphutha khona, isiqondiso esilungile sokuhumusha, i-focus ne-directrix elungile, nokuthi ungahlola kanjani.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nquma ukulandelana kwempendulo: lapho kuphutha khona, ukuhumusha okulungisiwe, i-focus ne-directrix, ukuthi ungahlola kanjani.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.1: Usebenzisa ukuhumusha okulungisiwe, hambisa i-vertex, i-focus, ne-directrix yesibalo sokuqala.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ukhombe lapho kuphutha khona ngamagama u-Haeun angawaqonda?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhombise ukuthi i-focus ne-directrix zihambe kanjani zisuka ezindaweni zazo zakudala?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, isiqondiso siphenduliwe emugqeni 2. Uma u-x+2 ubekwa endaweni ka-x, igrafu ihanjiswa ngo-−2 ohlangothini lwe-x, futhi ngo-y−1 ihanjiswa ngo-+1 ohlangothini lwe-y. Iphoyinti esibalweni esisha lapho izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0 ngu-(−2, 1), ngakho ungasho ukuthi i-vertex ihambele lapho isuka ku-(0, 0). Ngakho i-focus (−2, 0) iya ku-(−4, 1), futhi i-directrix x=2 iya ku-x=0.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.1: Haeun, isiqondiso sokuhumusha emugqeni 2 siphutha. (x+2) kuhambisa ngo-2 ngakwesobunxele, futhi (y−1) kuhambisa ngo-1 phezulu. Ungahlola ngokufaka ukuthi i-vertex ngu-(−2, 1). Ngakho i-focus ngu-(−4, 1) futhi i-directrix ngu-x = 0.

n-m-h3-diffc-01.title: Kufanele sifunde kanjani i-slope enesihlukanisi esingu-0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.topic: Ukuhlukanisa: ukuhlukanisa okungacacisiwe nemigqa ye-tangent ezindaweni lapho i-slope ingachazwanga khona
n-m-h3-diffc-01.goal: Hlola ukuthi umugqa we-tangent ukhona yini endaweni lapho isihlukanisi se-slope etholwe ngokuhlukanisa okungacacisiwe singu-0, futhi uthole futhi ulungise isiphetho esingalungile esixazululweni.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaHayoon sokuthola umugqa we-tangent ephoyinteni u-P(2, −1) ekhebulini u-C: x²+xy+y²=3. (U-x² no-y² basho u-x isikwele no-y isikwele. Ukuthi leli phoyinti u-P lise-C kwahlolwa ngo-4−2+1=3.)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.1: Humusha umugqa we-tangent lapho i-slope ingachazwanga njengesimo segrafu
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.2: Khetha izimo okufanele zihlolwe ngaphambi kokuphetha
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.0: Ukuhlukanisa okungacacisiwe (phatha u-y njengomsebenzi ka-x futhi uhlukanise izinhlangothi zombili maqondana no-x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.1: Ukuthola isibalo somugqa we-tangent ephoyinteni ekhebulini
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophosile esixazululweni sikaHayoon.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umugqa ngamunye kusukela phezulu futhi uhlole ngokubala ngqo ukuthi ulandela emgqeni ngaphambi kwawo yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isiphetho emgqeni wokugcina sisho into efanayo neqiniso elitholwe emgqeni wangaphambilini (okungachazwanga).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili maqondana no-x kunika u-2x + (y + x·y′) + 2y·y′ = 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.2: Ukufaka u-P(2, −1), isihlukanisi u-x+2y singu-2+2·(−1)=0, ngakho i-slope ayichazwanga.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho akukho mugqa we-tangent ephoyinteni u-P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 uphosile. Ukubala emigqeni 1 kuya ku-3 kulungile. Kodwa u-"inkulumo ye-slope ayichazwanga" kusho u-"akukho nani elibizwa nge-slope," hhayi ukuthi akukho mugqa we-tangent. Inombolo engaphezulu u-2x+y=3 ayingu-0, ngakho i-slope ingakhula ngokungapheli, okungukuthi, umugqa we-tangent ohambisana ne-y-axis ungenzeka.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.prompt: Uma kukhona umugqa we-tangent ekhebulini u-C ephoyinteni u-P, bhala isibalo sawo, futhi ubhale isizathu sokuthi wahlulele kanjalo.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bala ukuthi inombolo engaphezulu ithatha inani liphi ngenkathi isihlukanisi singu-0, futhi ucabange ukuthi i-slope iba likhulu kangakanani.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba ukuthi umugqa one-slope ekhula ngokungapheli ubukeka kanjani epulaneni lamakhodi, futhi ubhale isibalo salowo mugqa odlula ephoyinteni u-P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uhlole ukuthi isihlukanisi singu-0 kodwa inombolo engaphezulu ayingu-0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ufake u-x=2 esibalweni sekhebula futhi wabheka ukuthi ikhebula nomugqa zihlangana kanjani?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho umehluko phakathi kwe-"akukho slope" ne-"akukho mugqa we-tangent"?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.0: Isihlukanisi singu-0 futhi inombolo engaphezulu ingu-3, ngakho i-slope ikhula ngokungapheli. Ngakho umugqa we-tangent ngumugqa u-x=2, ohambisana ne-y-axis. Ukufaka u-x=2 ekhebulini kunika u-y²+2y+1=0, ngakho u-y=−1 uwukuphela kwesixazululo, okusho ukuthi umugqa uthinta nje ikhebula ephoyinteni u-P, okuyafanelana nakho.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.1: Kunomugqa we-tangent. I-slope ayichazwanga ngoba umugqa we-tangent uqonde, futhi isibalo sawo ngu-x=2. Ngihlolile nokuthi inombolo engaphezulu u-2x+y ingu-3, hhayi u-0, ngakho akunayo ifomu u-0/0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kwanele ukuhlola inombolo engaphezulu, noma ungasebenzisi indlela yokufaka u-x=2 ekhebulini.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.prompt: Yini okufanele uyihlole ngaphambi kokuphetha u-"kunomugqa we-tangent oqondile" endaweni lapho isihlukanisi senkulumo ye-slope singu-0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Efomini u-y′ = (inombolo engaphezulu)/(isihlukanisi), qhathanisa ukuthi ingxenye ibukeka kanjani ngokuhlukile uma isihlukanisi singu-0 futhi inani lenombolo engaphezulu lihlukile.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ingabe amafomu u-0/0 no-3/0 ayisimo esifanayo? Cabanga ukuthi ngamunye usho ini.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.a: Ukuthi, uma isihlukanisi singu-0, inombolo engaphezulu nayo ayingu-0 (okungukuthi, ayinayo ifomu u-0/0)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.b: Ukuthi, uma iphoyinti lise-curve, inani luka-y alinegethivu
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.b: Uphawu luka-y alunamsebenzi nokuthi umugqa we-tangent ukhona yini. Kungenzeka uxubanise uphawu lwekhodi nesiqondiso somugqa we-tangent.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.c: Ukuthi inani elihlukaniswe kabili u-y″ alingu-0
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.c: I-derivative yesibili isitshela kuphela isiqondiso lapho ikhebula ligoba khona; ayinquli ukuthi umugqa we-tangent ukhona yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.d: Ukuthi ikhebula lingabhalwa ngefomu u-y = (inkulumo ku-x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.d: Umugqa we-tangent ukhona noma umsebenzi ongacacisiwe ungabhalwa ngefomu u-y=f(x). Lesi simo asidingeki.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.explain: Noma isihlukanisi singu-0, uma inombolo engaphezulu ingeyona u-0, i-slope ikhula ngokungapheli futhi kuvela umugqa we-tangent oqondile. Uma inombolo engaphezulu nayo ingu-0, ingefomu u-0/0, ngakho le nkulumo yodwa ayikwazi ukunquma, futhi kufanele ubheke isimo sekhebula kuleso sikhathi ngenye indlela.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.title: Ngesikhathi isivinini singu-0, ingabe iphoyinti liyajika?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.topic: Ukuhlukanisa: isivinini nokusheshisa, izimo zokushintsha isiqondiso
n-m-h3-diffc-02.goal: Qonda, ngoshintsho lophawu lwesivinini, umehluko phakathi kwesikhathi lapho isivinini singu-0 nesikhathi lapho isiqondiso sokunyakaza sishintsha, futhi wakhe futhi uhlole izinkulumo zesivinini ezanelisa izimo wena.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.material: Isivinini sephoyinti u-P elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo ngesikhathi u-t (t≥0) singu-v(t), futhi v(1)=0. UMinsu uthe, "Ngesikhathi isivinini singu-0, iphoyinti ngokuqinisekile lishintsha isiqondiso." (Ukushintsha isiqondiso kusho ukuhamba kusuka ekuhambeni kwesokudla kuya ekuhambeni kwesokunxele, noma kusuka ekuhambeni kwesokunxele kuya ekuhambeni kwesokudla. Uma isivinini siphozithivu, lihamba kwesokudla; uma sinegethivu, kwesokunxele.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.1: Akha futhi uqinisekise izinkulumo zesivinini ezanelisa izimo
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.2: Hlunga lokho okungahlulelwa ngamanani esivinini nokusheshisa kuphela
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.0: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwendawo, isivinini, nokusheshisa (isivinini yi-derivative yendawo, ukusheshisa yi-derivative yesivinini)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kophawu lwesivinini nesiqondiso sokunyakaza
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isitatimende esisho into efanayo no-"iphoyinti u-P lishintsha isiqondiso ngesikhathi u-t₀."
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi iphoyinti lihamba ngasiphi isiqondiso uma isivinini siphozithivu nalapho sinegethivu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi uphawu lwesivinini kufanele lwenzeni ukuze isiqondiso sishintshe, futhi uqhathanise nelicala lapho siba ngu-0 bese sibuyela ophawini olufanayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.a: Noma ukusheshisa kungeyona u-0, uma isivinini singeyona u-0 isiqondiso sihlala sinjalo. Kungenzeka uxube isivinini nokusheshisa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.b: Indawo ku-t₀ inkulu kunezindawo zazo zonke izikhathi ngaphambi nangemuva kwayo ngokushesha
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga kuphela uma indawo ikhulu kakhulu (isiphetho sesokudla). Kushiya icala lokubuyela emuva esiphethweni sesokunxele.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.c: v(t₀)=0 sici esisodwa nje sesikhathi sokushintsha isiqondiso, hhayi isitatimende esifanayo. Cabanga ngelicala lapho v=0 kodwa uphawu lusala lunjalo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.d: Izimpawu zesivinini ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t₀ ngokushesha ziyahluka
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.d: Ubone ushintsho lwesiqondiso ngoshintsho lophawu lwesivinini.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.explain: Isiqondiso sishintsha uma uphawu lwesivinini lushintsha lusuka kuphozithivu lufika kunegethivu noma lusuka kunegethivu lufika kuphozithivu. Isivinini ukuba ngu-0 isimo esidingekayo esenzeka ngesikhathi uphawu lushintsha, kodwa asinele.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.prompt: Uma isivinini sinikezwa ngu-v(t)=(t−1)^m (t−p)^n, faka onxantathu abangu-2 noma ngaphezulu abahlukile (m, n, p) abanelisa konke okulandelayo: iphoyinti u-P alishintshi isiqondiso ku-t=1, futhi lishintsha isiqondiso ku-t=p. (U-m no-n bayizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-6, futhi u-p uyinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-2 kuya ku-9.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zama amanani amaningana ka-m no-n futhi wenze ithebula lezimpawu zika-(t−1)^m no-(t−p)^n ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=1 no-t=p ngokushesha.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa amacala lapho i-exponent ingu-even nalapho ingu-odd, futhi uqhathanise ukuthi uphawu lufana noma luhlukile ngaphambi nangemuva kwaleso sikhathi ngokushesha.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: U-m, n, no-p bayizinombolo zemvelo ezisohleni.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Uphawu lwesivinini luyafana ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=1 ngokushesha.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Uphawu lwesivinini luyashintsha ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=1 ngokushesha, ngakho iphoyinti lishintsha isiqondiso.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Uphawu lwesivinini luhlukile ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=p ngokushesha.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Uphawu lwesivinini luyafana ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=p ngokushesha, ngakho iphoyinti alishintshi isiqondiso.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.explain: Uma i-exponent ka-(t−1) ingu-even, lesi sici sinophawu olufanayo ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=1 ngokushesha, futhi uma i-exponent ka-(t−p) ingu-odd, uphawu luhlukile ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=p ngokushesha. Ezinye izici azishintshi uphawu eduze kwaleso sikhathi (p≥2). Ku-(1, 1, 3), uphawu luyashintsha nasezikhathini ku-t=1, futhi ku-(2, 2, 3), alushintshi ku-t=3.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha esinye sezibonelo ozitholile futhi ubhale ukuthi kungani iphoyinti lingashintshi isiqondiso ku-t=1 noma v(1)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala u-v(t) ngo-(m, n, p) owukhethile, futhi uqhathanise izimpawu uma ufaka inani elincane kancane kuno-1 nenani elikhulu kancane kuno-1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Xhumanisa ukuthi u-(t−1)^m uphozithivu noma unegethivu ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=1 ngokushesha nokuthi u-m ungu-odd noma u-even.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: isb. Ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=1 ngokushesha, uphawu lwe-(t−1)^m lu-...
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Esibonelweni sakho owasikhetha, usebenze ngempela uphawu lwesivinini ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-t=1?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ngikhethe (2, 1, 3). Ku-v=(t−1)²(t−3), u-(t−1)² ungu-0 noma ngaphezulu ezinhlangothini zombili zika-t=1, ngakho uphawu lwawo alushintshi, futhi u-(t−3) uhlala enegethivu. Ngakho u-v ungu-0 ku-t=1 kodwa uphawu lwawo lusala lunjalo, ngakho isiqondiso asishintshi.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: I-exponent u-m ingu-even, ngakho u-(t−1)^m akaba ngaphansi kuka-0 uma u-t edlula u-1. Isivinini sithinta u-0 futhi sibuya noma ngophawu olufanayo, ngakho isiqondiso sisala sinjalo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ihlanganisa kokubili i-exponent ene-even neqiniso lokuthi uphawu alushintshi.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.prompt: Uma isivinini u-v singumsebenzi ohlukanisekayo futhi ukusheshisa ngu-a(t)=v′(t), khetha zonke izitatimende ezilungile.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Misa izinkulumo zesivinini ezilula wena, njengo-v=(t−1)² no-v=(t−1)³, bala u-v′(1) ngakunye, futhi uqhathanise nokuthi isiqondiso siyashintsha yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ngesitatimende ngasinye, thola isibonelo esiphikisayo e-1 ukuhlola ukuthi sisebenza u-"njalo" yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.a: Uma v(t₀)=0 futhi a(t₀)≠0, iphoyinti lishintsha isiqondiso ku-t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi uma ukusheshisa kungeyona u-0, igrafu yesivinini idlula ku-0 futhi uphawu luyashintsha.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.b: Uma v(t₀)=0 futhi a(t₀)=0, iphoyinti alishintshi isiqondiso ku-t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.b: Noma a(t₀)=0, emacaleni anjengo-v=(t−1)³ isiqondiso siyashintsha. Uphuthelwe ukuthi uma ukusheshisa kungu-0, lokhu kuphela akukwazi ukunquma.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.c: Uma v(t₀)=0 futhi a(t₀)=0, iphoyinti ngokuqinisekile lishintsha isiqondiso ku-t₀
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.c: Noma a(t₀)=0, emacaleni anjengo-v=(t−1)² isiqondiso sisala sinjalo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.d: Uma iphoyinti lishintsha isiqondiso ku-t₀, bese v(t₀)=0 ngokudingekile
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi ukuze isiqondiso sishintshe, isivinini kufanele sishintshe ngokuqhubekayo futhi sidlule ku-0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.explain: Uma v(t₀)=0 futhi v′(t₀)=a(t₀)≠0, bese u-v udlula ku-0 futhi ushintsha uphawu. Ngokuphambene, uma a(t₀)=0, uphawu lungase lungashintshi, njengo-(t−1)², noma lushintshe, njengo-(t−1)³, ngakho kufanele ubheke uphawu lwesivinini ngqo. Ukuze isiqondiso sishintshe, u-v oqhubekayo kufanele ashintshe uphawu, ngakho v=0 ngaleso sikhathi.

n-m-h3-diffc-03.title: Singayithola i-slope yomsebenzi oyinhlanganisela ngamanani asethebuleni?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.topic: Ukuhlukanisa: i-derivative yomsebenzi oyinhlanganisela namathebula wamanani omsebenzi namanani e-derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-03.goal: Uma uthola i-derivative yomsebenzi oyinhlanganisela, nquma ukuthi ephoyinteni muphi i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphandle kufanele ifundwe, futhi uhlele lokho okungatholwa ngamanani asethebuleni kuphela.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.material:
'Amanani emisebenzi emibili ehlukanisekayo u-f no-g injengethebula elingezansi. Amanani angekho ethebuleni awaziwa. U-(f∘g)(x) usho u-f(g(x)), futhi u-(g∘f)(x) usho u-g(f(x)).
 x=1: f(1)=3, f′(1)=4, g(1)=2, g′(1)=−3
 x=2: f(2)=5, f′(2)=7, g(2)=1, g′(2)=6'
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke amanani asetshenziselwa ukuthola u-(f∘g)′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala i-derivative yomsebenzi oyinhlanganisela u-f(g(x)) njengomphumela wengxenye yangaphandle nengxenye yangaphakathi, futhi ubheke ukuthi ingxenye yangaphandle ithatha inani liphi njengokufakwayo kwayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi uma x=1, umphumela wokufaka u-1 ku-g uba ngukufakwayo ku-f ukunquma ukuthi yiziphi izinto zethebula okufanele zifundwe.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde i-slope ka-f ku-x=1. Umsebenzi wangaphandle u-f kufanele usebenzise i-slope yawo enanini lomsebenzi wangaphakathi, u-g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.b: Ufunde i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphandle enanini lomsebenzi wangaphakathi, u-g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.c: U-g(1) uyadingeka ukunquma ukuthi umsebenzi wangaphandle uhlukaniswa kuliphi iphoyinti.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.d: Ucabange ngengxenye lapho i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphakathi iphindaphindwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.e: U-g′(2) iyi-slope ku-x=2, ngakho ayisetshenziswa enanini elifunwayo ku-x=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.f: Inani lomsebenzi u-f(2) liyisiqongo, hhayi i-slope, ngakho alisetshenziswa ekubaleni i-derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.explain: (f∘g)′(1)=f′(g(1))·g′(1). Njengoba g(1)=2, funda u-f′(2)=7 bese uphindaphinda ngo-g′(1)=−3 ukuze uthole u-−21. Iphuzu elibalulekile ukusebenzisa u-f′(g(1)), hhayi u-f′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.acc.0: U-g(1)=2 liyinani elisetshenziselwa ukunquma ukuthi u-f′ ufundwa kuliphi iphoyinti, ngakho alivelli ngqo ekuphindaphindeni, kodwa ukuphindaphinda u-f′(2) no-g′(1) kuphela kuyikubala okufanayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.prompt: Khetha wonke amanani anqunywa amanani asethebuleni kuphela.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kumsebenzi ngamunye oyinhlanganisela, qala uthole ubhale inani lomsebenzi wangaphakathi.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphandle kuleyo ngeniso isethebuleni yini.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.a: Sidinga i-slope g′(3) ku-g(f(1))=g(3), kodwa ayikho ethebuleni. Ukusebenzisa u-g′(1) osethebuleni kusebenzisa iphoyinti lokungena elihlukile.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.b: I-slope f′(2) engenisweni yomsebenzi wangaphandle g(1)=2 isethebuleni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.c: Sidinga i-slope g′(5) ku-g(f(2))=g(5), kodwa ayikho ethebuleni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.d: I-slope f′(1) engenisweni yomsebenzi wangaphandle g(2)=1 isethebuleni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.explain: I-derivative yomsebenzi oyinhlanganisela ingatholakala kuphela uma ithebula linayo i-slope yomsebenzi wangaphandle efundwa enanini lomsebenzi wangaphakathi. Ku-(f∘g)′, amanani ka-g, 2 no-1, womabili angamanani ka-x asethebuleni, ngakho kuyenzeka, futhi ku-(g∘f)′, amanani ka-f, 3 no-5, angamanani ka-x angekho ethebuleni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.prompt: Thola inani lika-(f∘g)′(2). Bhala futhi ukuthi kungani kungalungile ukubala u-f′(2)·g′(2)=42.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ufunde inani lika-g(2) ethebuleni bese unquma ukuthi umsebenzi wangaphandle uhlukaniswa kuliphi iphoyinti.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ekubaleni okunikeze u-42, qhathanisa iphoyinti lapho ufunde khona i-derivative ye-f nenani elingena ngempela ku-f.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqale wathola u-g(2) bese unquma ukuthi yiliphi iphoyinti lokufunda kumsebenzi wangaphandle?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi i-slope yaliphi iphoyinti exubene enanini lika-42?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.0: g(2)=1, ngakho u-f′ kufanele ufundwe ku-1, unikeze (f∘g)′(2)=f′(1)·g′(2)=4×6=24. U-f′(2)·g′(2) ufunda i-slope ka-f ku-x=2, kodwa inani elingena ku-f alingu-2 kodwa u-g(2)=1, ngakho akulungile.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.1: I-derivative yomsebenzi oyinhlanganisela ngu-f′(g(2))g′(2). Njengoba g(2)=1, f′(1)=4 no-g′(2)=6, futhi umphumela wokuphindaphinda ngu-24. U-42 akalungile ngoba kusetshenziswe u-f′(2)=7.

n-m-h3-dist-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo sikaGayoung se-variance
n-m-h3-dist-01.topic: Ukusatshalaliswa kwamathuba: inani elilindelekile ne-variance ye-discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-01.goal: Thola umugqa wokuqala ohamba kabi esixazululweni se-variance, thola inani elilungile, bese uhlola ukuthi umphumela unengqondo yini.
n-m-h3-dist-01.material: I-random variable X ithatha amanani 0, 1, 2, 3 anamathuba 0.1, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2 ngokulandelana. UGayoung uxazulule njengoba kungezansi ukuthola i-variance V(X). (I-E(X²) "yinani elilindelekile lika-X isikwele," futhi {E(X)}² "yisikwele senani elilindelekile.")
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.0: Landela imigqa yesixazululo eyodwa ngayinye bese uthola umugqa onephutha
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.1: Hlola ukuthi umphumela uyahambisana nesimo sokusatshalaliswa
n-m-h3-dist-01.prereq.0: Inani elilindelekile E(X) le-discrete random variable
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala onephutha esixazululweni sikaGayoung.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ngokulandelana kusuka phezulu ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngokufanele emugqeni oqonde ngaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala izincazelo ze-E(X) ne-E(X²) ngamagama, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ubalwe ngokuya ngalezo zincazelo yini.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.line.2: I-E(X²) yi-E(X) nje esikwele, ngakho E(X²)=1.6²=2.56
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wesi-3 awulungile. I-E(X²) akuyona "isikwele senani elilindelekile"; yinani elitholwa ngokuqala ngokusikwela inani ngalinye lika-X, bese ukuphindaphinda ngamathuba bese ukwengeza. Imigqa 4 no-5 iqhubeka kusukela emphumeleni womugqa wesi-3, ngakho lokho kubala kuqobo kulungile, kodwa isiphetho asilungile.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa onephutha bese uthola amanani e-E(X²) ne-V(X). Bhala futhi ngomusho owodwa ukuthi kungani umphumela kaGayoung V(X)=0 ungenangqondo kulokhu kusatshalaliswa.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sikwela inani ngalinye ku-0, 1, 2, 3 lika-X bese uliphindaphinda ngamathuba afanayo.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.1: Beka emagameni ukuthi i-variance engu-0 isho ini mayelana namanani ka-X.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.placeholder: isb. I-E(X²) ngu-... futhi i-V(X) ngu-...
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale i-E(X²) ngqo usebenzisa isikwele senani ngalinye?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungasho ukuthi i-E(X²) ne-{E(X)}² zinombolo ezihlukile?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi i-variance engu-0 ingenzeka kusatshalaliswa olunjani?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.0: E(X²)=0²×0.1+1²×0.4+2²×0.3+3²×0.2=0.4+1.2+1.8=3.4. V(X)=3.4−1.6²=3.4−2.56=0.84, futhi njengoba u-X ethatha amanani ahlukene 0, 1, 2, 3, i-variance ayikwazi ukuba ngu-0.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.1: Kumele usikwele inani ngalinye, uliphindaphinde ngethuba, bese wengeza, ngakho E(X²)=3.4 (=17/5) no-V(X)=0.84. I-variance engu-0 yayizokusho ukuthi u-X uhlala ethatha inani elilodwa kuphela, kodwa akunjalo lapha.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.2: E(X²)=3.4 futhi i-variance ngu-0.84. I-variance engu-0 isho ukuthi wonke amanani afanayo, okungenjalo lapha.

n-m-h3-dist-02.title: Singayibiza nini ngokuthi i-binomial distribution uma sidweba amabhola amathathu?
n-m-h3-dist-02.topic: Ukusatshalaliswa kwamathuba: izimo zokuba i-binomial distribution isebenze
n-m-h3-dist-02.goal: Khetha ulwazi olubalulekile ngokuphelele ukuze unqume ukuthi lingaphathwa njenge-binomial distribution yini, bese ukhombisa ngezinombolo ukuthi ithuba lishintsha kanjani uma lolo lwazi lushintsha.
n-m-h3-dist-02.material: Ibhokisi liqukethe amabhola amhlophe angu-3 namabhola amnyama angu-2. USeoyun uthe, "Inombolo X yamabhola amhlophe uma kudwetshwa amabhola angu-3 ilandela i-binomial distribution B(3, 3/5)." Ukuthi uSeoyun ulungile yini akwaziwa ngalokho okubhalwe kuze kube manje.
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.0: Hlukanisa ulwazi olubalulekile esinqumweni nolwazi olungabalulekile
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.1: Hlola ngokubala umehluko ovelayo uma isimo siphuka
n-m-h3-dist-02.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-binomial distribution B(n,p): yenza ukulinga okuzimele okungu-n, ngalinye linethuba elifanayo lokuphumelela p
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.prompt: Kumele wazi ini ukuze unqume ukuthi uSeoyun ulungile yini?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ukhumbule ukuthi ukulinga kumele kube neziphi izici ukuze kusetshenziswe i-binomial distribution.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nquma ngakunye ukuthi ukukhetha ngakunye kuhlola leso sici noma kubuza nje ngento esivele iyaziwa.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.a: Bala futhi ukuze uhlole ukuthi ibhokisi linamabhola amhlophe angu-3 namabhola amnyama angu-2 ngempela
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.a: Inani lamabhola selivele linikeziwe. Lisetshenziselwa ukuthola ithuba elingu-3/5, kodwa alikutsheli ukuthi ithuba elifanayo lihlala lihleli njalo yini.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.b: Hlola ukuthi ukudweba amabhola angu-3 kuyinani elikhulu elanele lokulinga yini
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.b: I-binomial distribution ayisebenzi ngenxa yokuthi inani lokulinga likhulu. Noma lincane, njenge-n=3, iyi-binomial distribution uma izimo zifezwe.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.c: Hlola ukuthi ibhola ngalinye eledwetshiwe lifakwa yini emuva ebhokisini ngaphambi kokuthi kudwetshwe elilandelayo
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.c: Uhlola ukuthi okuqukethwe ebhokisini kuhlala kunjalo yini njalo. Lesi yisimo esiyinhloko se-binomial distribution.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.d: Hlola ukuthi ukulandelana kokuphuma kwamabhola amhlophe kunqunyelwe kusenesikhathi yini
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.d: Ukulandelana akunandaba ekusabalaliseni kwenani X lamabhola amhlophe. Okunquma ukuthi i-binomial distribution yini ukuthi imizamo iyathintana yini.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.explain: Ku-B(3, 3/5), ithuba lebhola elimhlophe kufanele libe ngu-3/5 njalo uma kudwetshwa ibhola, ngaphandle kokuthinteka phakathi kokudweba. Uma ibhola ngalinye eledwetshwe libuyiswa, lokho kuyasebenza, kodwa uma kungenjalo, imiphumela yangaphambilini ishintsha amathuba alandelayo. Inani lamabhola selivele laziwa, futhi inani lemizamo akudingeki libe likhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi kudwetshwa amabhola angu-3 ngaphandle kokuwabuyisela. Uma ibhola lokuqala lingumhlophe, thola ithuba lokuthi ibhola lesibili libe mhlophe, bese usebenzisa lokhu ukubhala ukuthi kungani u-X engeke abe ngu-B(3, 3/5) kulokhu.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala inani lamabhola asele ebhokisini nenani lamabhola amhlophe ngemva kokudweba ibhola lokuqala.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.1: Beka leli thuba eceleni kwethuba lokudweba kokuqala bese uliqhathanisa.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Uma ibhola lokuqala lingumhlophe, amabhola asele angu-...
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale wena inani lamabhola asele (4) namabhola amhlophe (2)?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungasho yini ukuthi ithuba eliguquguqukayo lixhumana kanjani no-"akuzimele"?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungachaza yini ukuthi kwenzekani uma amabhola ebuyiswa?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.0: Uma ibhola lokuqala lingumhlophe, amabhola asele angama-2 amhlophe kwangu-4, ngakho ithuba ngu-2/4=1/2. Lihluke kokuqala 3/5, ngakho isimo sokuthi ithuba lifana njalo siyaphuka, futhi akusona i-B(3, 3/5).
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.1: Uma amabhola engabuyiswa, umphumela wokudweba kwangaphambilini ushintsha ithuba elilandelayo. Uma ibhola elimhlophe lidwetshwa kuqala, ithuba lokuthi elilandelayo libe mhlophe ngu-2 kwangu-4 (0.5), okuhlukile ku-3/5, ngakho imizamo ayizimele futhi ayikwazi ukuba yi-binomial distribution.

n-m-h3-dist-03.title: Imidlalo emibili enesilinganiso esifanayo: ingabe ukusabalala nakho kuyafana?
n-m-h3-dist-03.topic: Ukusabalaliswa kwamathuba: i-variance yesamba nenani eliphindaphindiwe lezinguquko ezingahleliwe
n-m-h3-dist-03.goal: Hlulela ngokuqhathanisa ukusabalaliswa ngqo ukuthi ukuba nesilinganiso esifanayo kusho ukuthi ukusabalala nakho kufana yini, bese uchaza isizathu usebenzisa i-variance.
n-m-h3-dist-03.material: Vumela u-X abe yinombolo ebonisiwe uma kujikijelwa idayisi elijwayelekile elinezinhlangothi eziyisithupha. Kunemidlalo emibili. Emdlalweni A, ujikijela idayisi kanye futhi amaphuzu akho aphindwe kabili inombolo ebonisiwe (2X), futhi Emdlalweni B, ujikijela idayisi kabili futhi amaphuzu akho yisamba sezinombolo ezimbili (X₁+X₂). Kuyo yomibili imidlalo isilinganiso samaphuzu singu-7. U-Youngsu wathi, "Njengoba izilinganiso zifana, ukusabalala kwamaphuzu nakho kufanele kufane."
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.1: Yakha ubufakazi besibonelo esiphikisayo usebenzisa amathuba athile
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.2: Vamisa usebenzisa imithetho yokuthi i-variance ishintsha kanjani
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.0: Inani elilindelekile ne-variance yenguquko engahleliwe ehlukene
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.1: I-variance yesamba sezinguquko ezimbili ezingahleliwe ezizimele V(X+Y)=V(X)+V(Y)
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela yokuqhathanisa efanele kakhulu ukuhlola isitatimende sika-Youngsu?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isitatimende sika-Youngsu simayelana "nokusabalala," hhayi isilinganiso. Iyiphi idatha ebizokukhombisa lokho?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, cabanga ukuthi lungakwazi yini ukudalula umehluko phakathi kwemidlalo emibili.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.a: Bala kabusha ukuhlola ukuthi izilinganiso zemidlalo emibili zifana ngempela, ngu-7 amaphuzu
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.a: Sekunikeziwe ukuthi izilinganiso ziyafana. Ukuhlola inani elifanayo futhi akusayikukutshela ngokusabalala.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.b: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi isilinganiso sokujikijela idayisi kanye singu-3.5 ukuqhathanisa imidlalo emibili
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kukutshela kuphela ukuthi isilinganiso samaphuzu angu-7 kuyo yomibili imidlalo siphuma kuleli nani. Akudalula ukusabalala.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.c: Beka eceleni komunye nomunye amaphuzu angenzeka emidlalweni emibili nethuba lephuzu ngalinye
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.c: Uqhathanisa wonke ukusabalaliswa kwamaphuzu. Le yindlela yokubona ngqo ukuthi isimo sokusabalaliswa singahluka yini noma izilinganiso zifana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.d: Jikijela idayisi izikhathi eziningi ubone ukuthi izilinganiso zamaphuzu emidlalo emibili ziyasondela ku-7 amaphuzu yini
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.d: Ikhombisa ukuthi isilinganiso siqoqana eduze kuka-7 yini, kodwa ayikutsheli lutho ngokusabalala.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.explain: Isilinganiso siyisifinyezo esisodwa nje sokusabalaliswa. Uma ubeka amaphuzu namathuba eceleni komunye nomunye, ungabona ngokushesha ukuthi isimo sokusabalaliswa singahluka yini noma ngesilinganiso esifanayo. Ukubala kabusha isilinganiso noma ukuhlola kuphela ukuthi siqoqana eduze kwesilinganiso akukwazi ukuhlola isitatimende sika-Youngsu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola ithuba lokuthi amaphuzu abe ngu-2 noma 12 emdlalweni ngamunye (ithuba elihlanganisiwe lamacala amabili), bese uchaza ukuthi isitatimende sika-Youngsu asilungile.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo zedayisi ezinika amaphuzu angu-2 nawu-12 Emdlalweni A.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.1: Emdlalweni B, bala wonke amapheya ahleliwe ezinombolo ezimbili anika amaphuzu angu-2 nawu-12, bese uthola ukuthi angamangaki kwemiphumela engu-36.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Emdlalweni A, ukuthola amaphuzu angu-2 ...
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale wena izindlela zokuthola amaphuzu angu-2 nawu-12 Emdlalweni B njengamapheya ahleliwe?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungasho yini ukuthi isimo sokusabalaliswa singahluka noma izilinganiso zifana?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho yini ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwamathuba amabili ukhombisa kanjani umehluko ekusabalaleni?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.0: Emdlalweni A, ukujikijela u-1 noma u-6 kunika amaphuzu angu-2 noma 12, ngakho ngu-2/6=1/3. Emdlalweni B, kunemiphumela emibili kuphela, (1,1) no-(6,6), ngakho ngu-2/36=1/18. Ngesilinganiso esifanayo, amathuba amaphuzu aqedwa ayahluka kakhulu, ngakho ukusabalala akunakubizwa ngokufana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.1: Ithuba lokuthola amaphuzu angu-2 noma 12 liyingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu ku-A futhi ingxenye eyodwa kwezingu-18 ku-B. Noma isilinganiso singu-7 kuyo yomibili, u-A unikeza amaphuzu aqedwa kaningi kakhulu, ngakho ama-variance ayahluka.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.prompt: Vumela V ibe yi-variance yenombolo X ebonisiwe ekujikijeleni kanye idayisi. Yiziphi ama-variance wamaphuzu Omdlalo A 2X nawamaphuzu Omdlalo B X₁+X₂ (ukujikijela okubili akuthintani)?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.0: 2X umphumela owodwa ophindaphindwe kabili, futhi X₁+X₂ yimiphumela emibili ehlukile ehlangene. Cabanga ngezimbili ngokwehlukana.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.1: Faka inombolo elula endaweni ka-V (isibonelo V=1), thola ama-variance amabili kukhetho ngalunye, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ahambisana yini nokusabalala kwemidlalo emibili oyibonile esinyathelweni sangaphambilini.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.a: I-variance ye-2X ngu-2V, futhi i-variance ye-X₁+X₂ ngu-2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.a: Uphathe u-2X njengo-"X owengezwe kabili." Ukwengeza inani elifanayo kabili kuhlukile ekwengezeni imiphumela yezijikijelo ezimbili ezihlukile.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.b: I-variance ye-2X ngu-4V, futhi i-variance ye-X₁+X₂ ngu-2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.b: Ku-2X, wonke amanani aphindaphindwa kabili, ngakho i-variance iba izikhathi ezingu-2² ngobukhulu; kusamba semiphumela emibili ezimele, ama-variance ayengezwa, ngakho iba izikhathi ezi-2.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.c: I-variance ye-2X ngu-4V, futhi i-variance ye-X₁+X₂ ngu-4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.c: Usebenzise umthetho wokuthi ukuphindaphinda ngokungaguquki kwenza isikwele sesici ku-variance nasesambeni sezijikijelo ezimbili. Kusamba esizimele, ama-variance ayengezwa nje.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.d: I-variance ye-2X ngu-2V, futhi i-variance ye-X₁+X₂ ngu-4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.d: Ushintshe i-variance yenani eliphindaphindiwe ne-variance yesamba.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.explain: V(2X)=2²V=4V, futhi kusamba sezinguquko ezimbili ezingahleliwe ezizimele, V(X₁+X₂)=V+V=2V. Izilinganiso zombili zingu-7, kodwa ama-variance ayahluka: 4V no-2V. (I-variance yokujikijela idayisi ngu-V=35/12, ngakho ngu-35/3 no-35/6.)

n-m-h3-dist-04.title: Ingabe inani elilindelekile yinani eliphuma kaningi kakhulu?
n-m-h3-dist-04.goal: Hlunga incazelo nencazelo yenani elilindelekile, bese wakha futhi uhlola ukusabalaliswa lapho inani elilindelekile lingelona inani elingenzeka futhi lingelona inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.material: Kukhona inguquko engahleliwe X ethatha amanani 0, 1, 2. Uma unquma amathuba amanani amathathu ethebuleni lokusabalaliswa kwamathuba, inani elilindelekile E(X) liyanqunyelwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.0: Hlunga izitatimende mayelana nenani elilindelekile zibe yiqiniso namanga
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.1: Yakha ukusabalaliswa okuhlangabezana nezimo bese usisebenzisa njengesibonelo esiphikisayo
n-m-h3-dist-04.prereq.0: Ithebula lokusabalaliswa kwamathuba kwenguquko engahleliwe ehlukene
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izitatimende ezilungile mayelana nenani elilindelekile E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kusitatimende ngasinye, cabanga ukuthi ungasihlola yini ngokwenza ithebula lokusabalaliswa kwamathuba.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ngokuhlola ngokusabalaliswa okulula lapho amanani engu-0 no-1 kuphela futhi amathuba amabili alingana.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.a: Noma u-X engathatha kuphela amanani aphelele, E(X) ingaba idesimali. Isibonelo, isilinganiso senani lamakhanda ekujikijeleni uhlamvu lwemali singaba yinani elifana no-0.5.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.b: E(X) yisamba senani ngalinye eliphindaphindwe ngethuba lalo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.c: E(X) yinani lika-X elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.c: Uphathe inani elilindelekile "nenani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu" njenento efanayo. Inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu ngumbono ohlukile, futhi lamabili avamise ukuhluka.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.d: Uma isivivinyo siphindwa kaningi, isilinganiso samanani abonwe siqoqana eduze kuka-E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.d: Uchaze ngokulungile lapho isilinganiso sizinza khona njengoba isivivinyo siphindwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.explain: E(X) yisamba senani × ithuba, futhi liyinani isilinganiso esizinza kulo uma isivivinyo siphindwa kaningi. Alukho isiqinisekiso sokuthi liyinani u-X angalithatha ngempela, futhi alukho isiqinisekiso sokuthi liyinani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi u-X uthatha amanani 0, 1, 2. Khetha amathuba abo njengamaphesenti aphelele (p0, p1, p2). Izimo: ① ngalinye lamathuba amathathu okungenani ngu-1% futhi angeza abe ngu-100% ② inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu ngu-2 kuphela ③ E(X)≤1.2 (inani elilindelekile liphansi okungenani ngo-0.8 kuno-2, inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu). Yenza izibonelo ezi-3 ezihlukile (ngamanani ahlukile ka-p2).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe p0, p1, p2 ukuze zengeze zibe ngu-100, bese wenza p2 ibe nkulu kunazo zonke.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bala E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100 bese uhlola ukuthi ingu-1.2 noma ngaphansi. Uma inkulu kakhulu, zama ukwandisa p0 noma p1.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.2: Shintsha p2 ibe amanani ahlukile afana no-45 no-39, bese ukhetha p0 no-p1 futhi njalo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Amathuba ayizinombolo eziphelele ezingu-1% noma ngaphezulu futhi angeza abe ngu-100%.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Amathuba amathathu kufanele abe yizinombolo eziphelele ezingu-1% noma ngaphezulu futhi kufanele angeze abe ngu-100.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c2: P(X=2) kufanele ibe nkulu kunawo womabili amanye amathuba (akufanele ilingane nanoma yiliphi).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.explain: E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100. Isibonelo, ku-(40, 15, 45), E(X)=1.05, futhi inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu ngu-2. E(X)=1.05 akulona inani u-X angalithatha, futhi lihluke ku-2, inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu. Izibonelo ezilungisa kabusha kuphela (p0, p1, p2) azidingeki ukuthi zibalwe njengesibonelo esifanayo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha esinye sezibonelo zakho bese, usebenzisa izinombolo zaso, uchaza ukuthi kungani kuyiphutha ukufunda u-E(X) njengo-"inani eliphuma kaningi kakhulu" noma u-"inani eliphuma ngempela."
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.0: Thola u-E(X) wesibonelo osikhethile bese uliqhathanisa namanani u-X angawathatha: 0, 1, 2.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu lihlobene kanjani nenani lika-E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale u-E(X) wena esibonelweni osikhethile?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani u-E(X) eyinani elingeke lenzeke ngempela?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu lihluke kanjani ku-E(X)?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.0: Isibonelo, ku-(40, 15, 45), E(X)=0.15 + 0.9 = 1.05. Lokhu akulona inani u-X angalithatha, futhi inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu ngu-2. Ngakho E(X) akulona inani eliphuma kaningi kakhulu noma inani elingaphuma.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.1: Ku-(37, 24, 39), E(X)=1.02, kodwa u-X angaba ngu-0, 1, noma 2 kuphela, ngakho 1.02 ayikaze yenzeke. Inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu ngu-2, ku-39%, ngakho lihluke kunenani elilindelekile.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.2: Ku-(25, 36, 39), E(X)=1.14 akulona inani u-X angalithatha, futhi lihluke no-2, inani elinethuba elikhulu kakhulu.

n-m-h3-dist-05.title: Uma Ithuba Lingu-0, Ingabe Kungeke Kwenzeke Ngempela?
n-m-h3-dist-05.topic: Ukusabalaliswa kwamathuba: ithuba lephoyinti elilodwa lenguquko engahleliwe eqhubekayo
n-m-h3-dist-05.goal: Nquma ukuthi inani lingenzeka yini uma ithuba laso ephoyintini elilodwa lenguquko engahleliwe eqhubekayo lingu-0, bese uchaza lokho kunquma, nomphumela wokufaka noma ukungafaki iziphetho, ngamagama umngane angawaqonda.
n-m-h3-dist-05.material: Ibhasi ifika ngokulinganayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi kuka-0 nemizuzu engu-10 kusukela manje. Isikhathi sokulinda X (imizuzu) singaba yinani lanoma yini kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-10 kuhlanganise. Ithuba lebanga lilingana nobude balo: P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10. U-Jia ubhale lokhu okulandelayo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.1: Chaza umqondo onzima usebenzisa amagama alula nezibonelo
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.2: Nquma ukuthi ukufaka noma ukungafaki isiphetho kushintsha ithuba yini
n-m-h3-dist-05.prereq.0: Incazelo yenguquko engahleliwe eqhubekayo nomsebenzi wobuningi bamathuba (ithuba yindawo ngaphezu kwebanga)
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ngokulandelana ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngokufanele yini emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.1: Thola imigqa ethi "ithuba lingu-0" no-"akunakwenzeka," bese uhlola ukuthi ukucabanga okuxhumanisa lokho kuvumelekile yini ngokucabanga ngebhasi efika ngempela.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.0: X ingathatha wonke amanani kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-10, futhi P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.1: P(X=4) ithuba lebanga elinobude obungu-0, ngakho ngu-(4−4)/10=0.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.2: Njengoba ithuba lingu-0, ibhasi ifika ngqo emizuzwini engu-4 yinto engenakwenzeka.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uphutha. Enguqukweni engahleliwe eqhubekayo, noma ithuba ephoyintini elilodwa lingu-0, leli nani akudingeki ukuthi alinakwenzeka. Kunamanani amaningi angapheli phakathi kuka-0 no-10, ngakho ngalinye linethuba elingu-0, kodwa elinye inani liyenzeka. Imigqa 4 no-5 ilandela ngokulungile.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umyalezo wombhalo ochaza ku-Jia. Sho ukuthi yiyiphi ingxenye yokucabanga kwakhe edinga ukulungiswa, nokuthi P(X≤4) no-P(X<4) ziqhathaniswa kanjani ngosayizi, usebenzisa amagama alula nesibonelo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi liyincane kangakanani ithuba lokukhetha inani elilodwa ngqo phakathi kuka-0 no-10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.1: Phinda umbono ofanayo ngokwendawo: yini indawo yomugqa owodwa ongenabubanzi?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Ithuba lemizuzu engu-4 ngqo ngu-...
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usebenzise amagama nesibonelo umngane wesikole esiphakeme angabuqonda?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani ithuba lifana noma isiphetho sifakiwe noma singafakiwe?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.0: Kunamanani amaningi angapheli phakathi kwemizuzu engu-0 no-10, ngakho ithuba lokuthinta imizuzu engu-4 ngqo lincane kakhulu, lisondele ku-0, kangangokuthi liba ngu-0. Kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi ibhasi ayifiki emizuzwini engu-4, ngoba ifika ngesinye isikhathi. Noma imizuzu engu-4 ifakiwe noma ayifakiwe, ithuba elikwengeza lingu-0, ngakho P(X≤4) no-P(X<4) kuyalingana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.1: Ngoba iqhubeka, noma iphoyinti elilodwa linethuba elingu-0, ibhasi isengafika ngaleso sikhathi. Kunjengephoyinti elilodwa emgqeni linendawo engu-0 kuyilapho umugqa usunamaphoyinti kuwo. Ukwengeza noma ukususa iphoyinti elilodwa akushintshi ithuba, ngakho P(X≤4)=P(X<4)=0.4.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.2: P(X=4)=0, kodwa isikhathi sokufika siyinani elilodwa elinqunyiwe, ngakho akukona okungenakwenzeka ukuthi lelo nani livele. Iphoyinti elilodwa alinabubanzi, ngakho ukulengeza noma ukulisusa akushintshi ithuba, futhi amathuba amabili ayalingana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi isitatimende ngasinye sincike kanjani enanini lika-P(X=a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kuma-die roll X (ahlukene), thola P(X≤3) no-P(X<3) bese uziqhathanisa.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.a: Noma kunguquko engahleliwe eqhubekayo, P(X≤a) ihlala inkulu kune-P(X<a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi "≤" ifaka amacala amaningi, ngakho ithuba laso kufanele libe likhulu. Enguqukweni engahleliwe eqhubekayo, ithuba ephoyintini elilodwa lingu-0, ngakho zombili ziyalingana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.b: Enguqukweni engahleliwe eqhubekayo, uma P(X=a)=0, khona-ke u-X akakwazi ukulingana no-a.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.b: Uphathe ithuba 0 njengokufanayo nokungenzeki. Enguqukweni engahleliwe eqhubekayo, inani elinethuba 0 lingenzeka ngempela.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.c: Enguqukweni engahleliwe eqhubekayo, ithuba lifana noma iziphetho zebanga zifakiwe noma azifakiwe.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.c: Ithuba ephoyintini elilodwa lingu-0, ngakho ukufaka noma ukungafaki isiphetho akushintshi ithuba.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.d: Enguqukweni engahleliwe ehlukene nayo, P(X≤a)=P(X<a) ihlala isebenza.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.d: Enguqukweni engahleliwe ehlukene, P(X=a) ingaba ngeyi-nonzero, ngakho izimbili zingase zingalingani.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.explain: Enguqukweni engahleliwe eqhubekayo, P(X=a)=0, ngakho P(a≤X≤b)=P(a<X<b)=P(a≤X<b)=P(a<X≤b). Enguqukweni engahleliwe ehlukene, P(X=a)>0 iyenzeka, ngakho ukufaka noma ukungafaki isiphetho kungashintsha ithuba.

n-m-h3-dist-07.title: Ukwakha Ukusabalaliswa Kwe-Binomial Kusukela Esilinganisweni Nenhlawulo
n-m-h3-dist-07.topic: Ukusabalaliswa kwethuba: isilinganiso ne-variance yokusabalaliswa kwe-binomial
n-m-h3-dist-07.goal: Sebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwesilinganiso ne-variance yokusabalaliswa kwe-binomial ukukhipha izinhlanganisela ezingenakwenzeka, futhi wakhe ukusabalaliswa kwe-binomial okufinyelela izimo ezinikeziwe ukuthola umthetho.
n-m-h3-dist-07.material: Ufuna ukuchaza idatha ethile ngokusabalaliswa kwe-binomial u-B(n,p). Lapha u-n uyinombolo yemvelo futhi u-p uyinombolo phakathi kuka-0 no-1. Isilinganiso sokusabalaliswa kwe-binomial singu-np futhi i-variance ingu-np(1−p).
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.1: Akha izibonelo zakho ezifinyelela izimo futhi uthole umthetho
n-m-h3-dist-07.prereq.0: Isilinganiso u-np ne-variance u-np(1−p) yokusabalaliswa kwe-binomial u-B(n, p)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.prompt: Yiliphi kwamapheya alandelayo esilinganiso ne-variance elingenzeka empeleni ekusabalaliseni kwe-binomial u-B(n, p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.0: Misa isilinganiso silingane no-np ne-variance ilingane no-np(1−p), bese ubheka ukuthi kusalani uma uhlukanisa i-variance ngesilinganiso.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ngenketho ngayinye ukuthi u-p oyithola uphakathi kuka-0 no-1 futhi u-n uyinombolo yemvelo yini.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.a: Lapha i-variance inkulu kunesilinganiso. Njengoba i-variance ingu-np(1−p), ayikwazi ukuba nkulu kunesilinganiso u-np.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.b: Uma uthola u-p bese n=np÷p, u-n akayona inombolo yemvelo. Uphuthelwe isimo sokuthi u-n uyinombolo yemvelo.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.c: Uma i-variance ilingana nesilinganiso, bese 1−p=1, ngakho p=0. Bese isilinganiso sasingaba ngu-0, okungafaneli.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.d: I-variance ÷ isilinganiso = 1−p inquma u-p, futhi u-n naye uphuma njengenombolo yemvelo, ngakho lokhu kuyenzeka.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.explain: I-variance ÷ isilinganiso = 1−p. Ku-(8, 6), 1−p=3/4, p=1/4, futhi n=8÷(1/4)=32, ngakho kuyenzeka. Ku-(10, 12), 1−p>1 ngakho p<0; ku-(8, 5), p=3/8 futhi n=64/3, okungeyona inombolo yemvelo; futhi ku-(6, 6), p=0.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.prompt: Akha ukusabalaliswa kwe-binomial okungu-3 okuhlukile u-B(n, p) onesilinganiso esingu-12 ne-variance engu-8 ubuningi. Bhala u-n njengenombolo yemvelo no-p njengephesenti elinenombolo egcwele (p%). (isb. ku-p=25%, bhala u-25)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala amapheya ka-n no-p anelisa isilinganiso u-np=12 (u-p njengephesenti elinenombolo egcwele).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ngepheya ngalinye, bala i-variance u-12(1−p) futhi uhlole ukuthi ingu-8 ubuningi yini.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c1: U-n uyinombolo yemvelo futhi u-p uphakathi kuka-1% no-99%.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.fail.c1: U-n kufanele abe yinombolo yemvelo futhi u-p kufanele abe yiphesenti elinenombolo egcwele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-99.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.explain: Kusuka ku-np=12, p=q/100. Ukuze i-variance u-np(1−p)=12(1−p) ibe ngu-8 ubuningi, u-p kufanele abe ngu-1/3 okungenani. Izibonelo lapho kokubili u-n no-p befanelana nezimo ngu-(30, 40%), (25, 48%), (24, 50%), (20, 60%), (16, 75%), no-(15, 80%).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.prompt: Ukubheka ukusabalaliswa kwakho okuthathu, bhala ukuthi ubudlelwano obuphi bukhona phakathi kuka-p ne-variance uma izilinganiso zilingana.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala u-p ne-variance yokusabalaliswa okuthathu eceleni komunye nomunye, njengethebula.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bona ukuthi i-variance iba likhulu noma incane uma u-p eba mkhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Uma isilinganiso sifana, u-12, njengoba u-p eba mkhulu i-variance ...
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Usho ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-p ne-variance kanye nesimo sokuthi izilinganiso zilingana?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi i-variance ingabhalwa njengo-12(1−p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.0: Uma isilinganiso u-np sifana, u-12, i-variance ingu-12(1−p), ngakho uma u-p emkhulu, i-variance incane. Isibonelo, p=40% inika u-7.2 futhi p=75% inika u-3.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.1: Konke ukusabalaliswa okuthathu kunesilinganiso esingu-12, kodwa i-variance yanciphe njengoba u-p ekhula. Isibonelo, 6 uma p=50% no-2.4 uma p=80%: uma ithuba lempumelelo liphezulu, lisabalala kancane.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.2: Uma izilinganiso zilingana, uma u-p emkhulu, i-variance u-12(1-p) iba incane.

n-m-h3-dist-08.title: Isixazululo Esinikeze Ithuba u-2: Yimuphi Umugqa Ophosile?
n-m-h3-dist-08.topic: Ukusabalaliswa kwethuba: i-domain yomsebenzi wokuminyana kwethuba
n-m-h3-dist-08.goal: Qaphela ukuthi awukwazi ukuhlanganisa ngaphandle kwesikhawu lapho umsebenzi wokuminyana kwethuba ungeyona u-0, thola umugqa ophosile, futhi uthole ithuba elilungile.
n-m-h3-dist-08.material: Okuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe okuqhubekayo u-X kunomsebenzi wokuminyana kwethuba u-f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2), futhi u-f(x)=0 kuwo wonke ama-x angekho. Nanku isixazululo sikaMinjun sokuthola i-constant u-k no-P(1≤X≤3).
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.1: Hlola ukuthi umphumela uphakathi kohla olungenzeka ngethuba yini
n-m-h3-dist-08.prereq.0: Izakhiwo zomsebenzi wokuminyana kwethuba (indawo iyonke u-1)
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaMinjun.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola kusukela phezulu ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngokuvumelekile yini emgqeni ngaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ngomugqa ngamunye, qhathanisa igrafu esetshenziswe kuleso sikhawu luka-x no-f(x) onikezwe enkingeni.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.0: f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2) no-f(x)=0 kwenye indawo, futhi indawo iyonke ingu-1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.2: U-P(1≤X≤3) yindawo phakathi kwegrafu ka-y=x/2 ne-x-axis kusukela ku-x=1 kuya ku-x=3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uphosile. Kumsebenzi wokuminyana kwethuba, u-f(x)=0 uma u-x emkhulu kuno-2, ngakho igrafu ka-y=x/2 isetshenziswa kuphela kuze kufike ku-x=2. Ngakho indawo kusuka ku-x=2 kuya ku-3 akufanele yengezwe. Imigqa 4 no-5 ithatha nje isikhawu esiphosile somugqa 3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa ophosile futhi uthole inani luka-P(1≤X≤3). Bhala nokuthi kungani impendulo kaMinjun engu-2 ingeke ibe ngethuba.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokudweba ukuthi igrafu ingeyona u-0 kuphi.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ngohla lwamanani ithuba elingaba nalo.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.placeholder: isb. U-f(x) ungeyona u-0 kuphela uma u-x ... , ngakho ...
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uhlole isikhawu lapho u-f(x) engeyona u-0 ngaphambi kokuxazulula?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Uhlole impendulo yakho usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi ithuba alikwazi ukudlula u-1?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.0: Uma u-x emkhulu kuno-2, u-f(x)=0, ngakho udinga ukubala kuphela kusuka ku-x=1 kuya ku-2, futhi indawo ingu-(1/2)×(1/2+1)×1=3/4. Impendulo kaMinjun engu-2 ayinakwenzeka ngoba ithuba alikwazi ukuba likhulu kuno-1, nokho lidlula u-1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.1: P(1≤X≤3)=P(1≤X≤2)=∫₁² x/2 dx=3/4. Njengoba indawo iyonke ingu-1, indawo yesikhawu ayikwazi ukuba ngu-2.

n-m-h3-prob-01.title: Okungenani Oyedwa Yindodakazi: Ithuba Lini Lokuthi Bobabili Bangamadodakazi?
n-m-h3-prob-01.topic: Ithuba: ithuba elinemibandela, ukuzimela nokuncika, ukucabanga kwesitayela sika-Bayes, ukusetha isikhala sesampuli
n-m-h3-prob-01.goal: Esixazululweni sethuba elinemibandela, thola futhi ulungise lapho amacala ayengalingani ethubeni abalwe njengalingana, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amacala asalayo ashintsha ngokuya ngendlela umbandela ofundwa ngayo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.material: Konke esikwaziyo ukuthi umndeni unezingane ezimbili. Ingane ngayinye iyindodakazi ngethuba elingu-1/2, futhi sicabanga ukuthi ubulili bezingane ezimbili abuthinteki komunye nomunye. USeungwoo wazixazulula "ithuba lokuthi zombili izingane ziyamadodakazi, uma okungenani eyodwa iyindodakazi" ngezansi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.1: Akha kabusha isikhala sesampuli ngamacala ahlukanisekayo
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.2: Qhathanisa amathuba ashintsha ngokuya ngokufundwa komandla womibandela
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.0: Incazelo yethuba elinemibandela (isilinganiso samacala athile phakathi kwamacala afanele umbandela)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaSeungwoo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola kusukela phezulu, umugqa ngamunye, ukuthi ulandela ngokulungile yini emgqeni ongaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala wena amacala abizwa ngokuthi "alingana ngokwethuba," uhlukanise ingane yokuqala neyesibili, futhi uqhathanise ukuthi alingana ngempela ngosayizi yini.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.0: Ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi okungenani eyodwa kwezingane ezimbili iyindodakazi, thola ithuba lokuthi zombili izingane ziyamadodakazi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukwakheka kwezingane ezimbili kungenye yezinhlobo ezintathu, "amadodakazi angu-2," "indodakazi engu-1 nendodana engu-1," "namadodana angu-2," futhi izinhlobo ezintathu zilingana ngokwethuba.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.2: Ukususa u-"amadodana angu-2," angahambisani nomibandela wokuthi okungenani eyodwa iyindodakazi, kusala izinhlobo ezimbili.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.3: Phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili ezisele, kunohlobo olulodwa lapho zombili izingane ziyamadodakazi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 yindawo yokuqala lapho kuphosa khona. U-"indodakazi engu-1 nendodana engu-1" ukhona kokubili icala lapho ingane yokuqala iyindodakazi nalapho ingane yesibili iyindodakazi, ngakho uma eyokuqala neyesibili ihlukaniswa, ayilingani ngokwethuba no-"amadodakazi angu-2" noma u-"amadodana angu-2." Imigqa 3 kuya ku-5 ilandela izinhlobo ezintathu zomugqa 2 ngokwethemba, ngakho izibalo ezikuwo ziyalungile kodwa umphumela uphosile.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa isixazululo esilungisiwe, thola ithuba lokuthi zombili izingane ziyamadodakazi, futhi ubhale ukuthi kungani inani lihluka kwelikaSeungwoo. (Ingane ngayinye iyindodakazi ngethuba elingu-1/2, futhi zombili kucatshangwa ukuthi azithintani.)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hlukanisa izingane njengeyokuqala neyesibili, futhi ubhale zonke izinhlanganisela zobulili. Zingaki, futhi zilingana ngokwethuba yini?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bala kuphela amacala afanele umbandela, futhi uqhathanise ukuthi mangaki kuwo anamadodakazi womabili.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Uma sihlukanisa ingane yokuqala neyesibili, ...
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ulande wonke amacala angenzeka, uhlukanise ingane yokuqala neyesibili?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ugcine kuphela amacala afanele umbandela futhi wathola isilinganiso samacala amadodakazi womabili phakathi kwawo?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Usho ukuthi u-"indodakazi engu-1 nendodana engu-1" akulona icala elilodwa?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.0: Uma sihlukanisa ingane yokuqala neyesibili, u-(indodakazi, indodakazi), (indodakazi, indodana), (indodana, indodakazi), no-(indodana, indodana) konke kulingana ngokwethuba. Emacaleni angu-3 lapho okungenani eyodwa iyindodakazi, elingu-1 linamadodakazi womabili, ngakho ithuba lingu-1/3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.1: Indodakazi engu-1 nendodana engu-1 ihlukana emacaleni amabili, u-(eyokuqala indodakazi, eyesibili indodana) no-(eyokuqala indodana, eyesibili indodakazi), ngakho akumele kubalwe njengecala elilodwa. Ngakho kunamacala angu-3 afanele umbandela, futhi elilodwa kuphela kuwo linamadodakazi womabili, ngakho ithuba lingeyodwa kwezintathu.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.prompt: Uma umbandela ubungeyona u-"okungenani eyodwa iyindodakazi" kodwa u-"ingane yokuqala iyindodakazi," ithuba lokuthi zombili izingane ziyamadodakazi lingaba yini?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala amacala asalayo ngaphansi kwalo mbandela, uhlukanise ingane yokuqala neyesibili.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.1: Beka uhlu lwamacala asele enkingeni edlule eceleni kwalolu hlu futhi uthole ukuthi kushintshe ini.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.a: Ubale ngokungalungile amacala afanele umbandela, noma uxubanise u-"okungenani eyodwa iyindodakazi" no-"amadodakazi womabili."
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.b: Unikeze ithuba phezu kwesiyonke sokuqala ngaphandle kokusebenzisa umbandela. Uma kunombandela, amacala asalayo ayashintsha.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.c: Uthathe umbandela wenkinga edlule nalona njengofanayo. Kulokhu kuphela ubulili bengane yesibili obusele bukhululekile.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.explain: Uma ingane yokuqala iyindodakazi, amacala asalayo angu-(indodakazi, indodakazi) no-(indodakazi, indodana), alingana ngokwethuba. Kuwo, elilodwa linamadodakazi womabili, ngakho ithuba lingu-1/2. U-"okungenani eyodwa iyindodakazi" uphinde avumele u-(indodana, indodakazi), ngakho kunamacala asele angu-3 futhi ithuba lingu-1/3. Isikhala sesampuli esisalayo sincike ekutheni umbandela ufundwa kanjani.

n-m-h3-est-01.title: Ukuhlola Isixazululo Sethuba Lokuthi Amabhodlela Angu-9 Alinganisa Okungenani U-503 mL
n-m-h3-est-01.goal: Qhathanisa isilinganiso nokuphambuka okujwayelekile kokusabalaliswa kwesilinganiso sesampuli namanani abantu, thola futhi ulungise umugqa ophosile esixazululweni, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani ithuba lesilinganiso sesampuli lihluka kuthuba lenani ngalinye.
n-m-h3-est-01.material: Efemini yeziphuzo, umthamo webhodlela elilodwa ulandela ukusabalaliswa okujwayelekile onesilinganiso esingu-500 mL nokuphambuka okujwayelekile okungu-6 mL. UHaeun, osebenza ekulawuleni ikhwalithi, wathatha isampuli yamabhodlela angu-9 ngokungahleliwe futhi wathola ithuba lokuthi isilinganiso somthamo u-X̄ singu-503 mL okungenani. Ingxenye yethebula elijwayelekile elijwayelekile: P(0≤Z≤0.5)=0.1915, P(0≤Z≤1.5)=0.4332, P(0≤Z≤3)=0.4987. (U-Z uyi-random variable elandela ukusabalaliswa okujwayelekile okunesilinganiso esingu-0 nokuphambuka okujwayelekile okungu-1.)
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.0: Funda ngokucophelela ukuze uhlukanise inani elilodwa nesilinganiso sesampuli
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.1: Qhathanisa isilinganiso nokuphambuka okujwayelekile kwesilinganiso sesampuli namanani abantu
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.2: Chaza ukuthi ithuba elilungisiwe lihluka kanjani, futhi ngasiphi isiqondiso, kuthuba lenani ngalinye

Ingxenye yethebula lokusabalalisa okujwayelekile okujwayelekile: P(0≤Z≤1)=0.3413, P(0≤Z≤1.2)=0.3849.

Vumela a ibe inombolo yokuqala edwetshiwe no-b yesibili, bese ubiza (a, b) ngokuthi isampula elilodwa; isilinganiso sesampula siyi-X̄=(a+b)/2. Ekudwebeni ngakunye, wonke amabhola angu-4 anethuba elilinganayo.

(3, 5) inesilinganiso 4, ngakho ayisebenzi, futhi (5, 5) ishiywe kule mibandela ngoba izinombolo zayo ezimbili zifana.
n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.prompt: Kufakwe amacala lapho a no-b befana, khetha ithuba lokuthi isilinganiso sesampula X̄ singu-5 noma ngaphezulu.

n-m-h3-est-02.title: Udinga Ukwazi Ini Ukuthola Ubude Besikhawu Sokuzethemba?
n-m-h3-est-02.topic: Ukulinganisa kwezibalo: isikhawu sokuzethemba sesilinganiso sabantu
n-m-h3-est-02.goal: Hlukanisa lokho okunquma ubude besikhawu sokuzethemba sesilinganiso sabantu nalokho okunquma indawo yaso, futhi wakhe uhlelo lwakho locwaningo oluqonda isimo sobude.
n-m-h3-est-02.material: Ufuna ukulinganisela isilinganiso sesibalo sabantu m sesikhathi sansuku zonke sokufunda sentsha (ngamahora). Isibalo sabantu silandela ukusabalalisa okujwayelekile futhi i-standard deviation yesibalo sabantu σ iyaziwa. Uma usayizi wesampula ungu-n futhi isilinganiso sesampula singu-x̄, isikhawu sokuzethemba esingu-95% singu-x̄−1.96×σ/√n ≤ m ≤ x̄+1.96×σ/√n. Iqembu locwaningo alikaqali inhlolovo, futhi liqala ngokufuna ukubala "ubude besikhawu sokuzethemba" kuphela.

n-m-h3-est-08.title: Ukuhlola Inani le-z Esixazululweni Sesikhawu Sokuzethemba se-90%
n-m-h3-est-08.goal: Hlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinga lokuzethemba namathuba ethebuleni le-standard normal, thola futhi ulungise umugqa onephutha esixazululweni, bese uqinisekisa iphutha ngokubala ukuthi inani le-z elingalungile lihambisana ngempela nalo yiliphi izinga lokuzethemba.
n-m-h3-est-08.material: Kusibalo sabantu esinokusatshalaliswa okujwayelekile esine-population standard deviation σ=8, isampula elingahleliwe elingu-64 linesilinganiso sesampula x̄=50. UJiho uthole isikhawu sokuzethemba se-90% sesilinganiso sesibalo sabantu m. Ingxenye yethebula le-standard normal: P(0≤Z≤1.28)=0.3997, P(0≤Z≤1.645)=0.4500, P(0≤Z≤1.96)=0.4750, P(0≤Z≤2.58)=0.4950. (Z i-random variable elandela ukusatshalaliswa okujwayelekile okunesilinganiso esingu-0 ne-standard deviation engu-1.)

Imigqa 3, 4, no-5 ilandela umugqa wesi-2, ngakho imiphumela yayo ayilungile. Isikhawu esilungile siyi-50±1.645×1, okungukuthi, 48.355 ≤ m ≤ 51.645.

n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale inani le-P(0≤Z≤z) ukuze P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, bese uthola z ethebuleni.
