n-m-h3-integc-04.title: Ama-Definite Integral Angenayo I-Antiderivative
n-m-h3-integc-04.topic: Ukuhlanganisa: ama-definite integral asebenzisa ukushintshwa nokulingana kwesikhawu (ukuthola inani ngaphandle kwe-antiderivative)
n-m-h3-integc-04.goal: Ukubuyekeza isinqumo sakho njengoba ulwazi lukhula, qinisekisa ukuthi ubudlelwano bokulingana obutholwe ngokushintshwa bunquma inani le-definite integral ngaphandle kokuthola i-antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.material: Landela, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, inqubo yokuthola inani le-definite integral I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. (∫_0^{π/2} iyi-definite integral kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-π/2.)
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.3: Yahlulela imigomo lapho indlela efanayo isebenza khona
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, bala "izingaziwa ezingakanani nezibalo ezingakanani."
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi ukulinganisela kwakho kokuqala nenani elitholwe kamuva akuhlukile kakhulu yini.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ufuna ukuthola u-I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Kunzima ukuthola i-antiderivative yalesi sisho ngqo. Amanani e-integrand h(x)=sin x/(sin x+cos x) angu-h(0)=0, h(π/4)=1/2, h(π/2)=1, futhi ubude besikhawu bungu-π/2 (cishe 1.57).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yiliphi ilinganiselo losayizi ku-I elifanele kakhulu?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ubude buyakhuphuka kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-1 nenani eliphakathi elingu-1/2, ngakho indawo ingaba cishe (1/2)×1.57≈0.8. Leli linganiselo lingasetshenziswa kamuva ukuhlola ukuthi inani olithole lilungile yini.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: U-I ungu-1.57 cishe: ngoba uthatha ubude njengo-1 bese uphindaphinda ngobude obungu-1.57
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ubude bungu-1 kuphela ekupheleni kwesikhawu. Leli linganiselo lithatha ubude njengo-1 kuso sonke isikhawu.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: U-I ungu-0.8 cishe: ngoba ubude buyahluka kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-1, isilinganiso singu-1/2 cishe
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ulinganisele ushintsho lobude ngesilinganiso. Akulona inani eliqondile, kodwa lingasetshenziswa ukulinganisa usayizi.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: U-I ungu-0: ngoba h(0)=0 endaweni yokuqala
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukuthi inani lingu-0 ephoyintini elilodwa akwenzi i-definite integral ibe ngu-0. Bheka amanani kuso sonke isikhawu.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Bheka futhi u-J=∫_0^{π/2} cos x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Ukungeza izingxenyenyana ezimbili kwenza inani eliphezulu lilingane nesihlukanisi, ngakho I+J=∫_0^{π/2} 1 dx=π/2.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ingabe u-I ungenqunywa ngalolu lwazi kuphela?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kunesibalo esisodwa kuphela, I+J=π/2, ngakho u-I no-J abakwazi ukunqunywa ngokuhlukile. Udinga ukuthola enye indlela phakathi kuka-I no-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wahlukanise ngesigamu ngaphandle kokuhlola ukuthi I=J yini. I+J=π/2 iyindlela eyodwa nje phakathi kuka-I no-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Akunakunqunywa: I+J=π/2 ayisizi nhlobo ekuthatheni u-I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Inani lika-I+J lilulwazi olusizayo. Linikeze indlela eyodwa phakathi kuka-I no-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Akwanele okwamanje: udinga ukwazi enye indlela phakathi kuka-I no-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uqaphele ukuthi kunezingaziwa ezimbili, u-I no-J, kodwa kunesibalo esisodwa kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ku-J, vumela x=π/2−t. Khona-ke dx=−dt, futhi njengoba u-x esuka ku-0 eya ku-π/2, u-t usuka ku-π/2 aye ku-0. Njengoba sin(π/2−t)=cos t no-cos(π/2−t)=sin t, J=∫_{π/2}^{0} sin t/(sin t+cos t)·(−dt)=∫_0^{π/2} sin t/(sin t+cos t) dt, olingana no-I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I=J no-I+J=π/2, ngakho I=π/4 (cishe 0.785). Lokhu kuvumelana kahle nesilinganiso sokuqala esingu-0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Usebenzise izibalo ezimbili I=J no-I+J=π/2 ndawonye. Nakho kuvumelana nesilinganiso sokuqala esingu-0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uphathe inani lika-I+J njengenani lika-I. J iqukethe inani elifanayo nayo.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uphathe ukuphakama endaweni eyodwa ephakathi njengenani le-definite integral. Kufanele uphindaphinde ukuphakama ngobude bebanga.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwakungenzeka ukulinganisela kuphela, futhi noma ngemva kokuthola isibalo se-I+J, kwakubalulekile ukuthi "ukuhlukanisa ngesigamu" kwakusenesikhathi. Kuphela ngemva kokuba ukufaka esikhundleni kunike ubudlelwano J=I kwanqunywa u-I. Ngokusebenzisa ukulingana kwebanga ku-definite integral, ungathola inani ngaphandle kokuthola i-antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.prompt: Uma ufaka x=π/2−t ku-J, dx=−dt, kodwa J iba +I hhayi −I. Chaza ukuthi kungani, ugxile emikhawulweni yokuhlanganisa (ephezulu nephansi).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Thola inani lika-t elihambisana no-x=0 no-x=π/2, bese ubhala imikhawulo ephezulu nephansi ye-integral entsha.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi kwenzekani ophawini uma ubuyisela i-definite integral onomkhawulo ophezulu ongaphansi komkhawulo ophansi endleleni evamile.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale wena ukuthi ngemva kokufaka esikhundleni umkhawulo ophansi ngu-π/2 futhi ophezulu ngu-0?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale isinyathelo sokuguqula ∫_{π/2}^{0} kube ngu-−∫_0^{π/2}?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.0: Njengoba x isuka ku-0 iye ku-π/2, t isuka ku-π/2 iye ku-0, ngakho imikhawulo ephezulu nephansi ye-integral iyashintshwa. Ukuphendula ibanga kushintsha uphawu, futhi kanye nokukhipha okusuka ku-dx=−dt izimpawu ziyakhansela, ngakho J=+I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.1: Ngemva kokufaka esikhundleni, ibanga liyaphenduka, kusukela ku-π/2 kuya ku-0. Ukulungisa ibanga eliphenduliwe kudala uphawu olulodwa lokukhipha, futhi lokho nokukhipha okusuka ku-dx=−dt kuyaqedana, ngakho uphawu luphela lunhle.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha i-definite integral enganani layo lingatholakala ngendlela efanayo esetshenziswe ukuthola u-I (shintsha u-x ngo-π/2−x bese wengeza isibalo esibhanqiwe).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, bhala ukuthi kwenzekani ebangeni nasesihlukanisini uma u-x ushintshwa ngo-π/2−x.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi inombolo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi kuba lingana yini uma wengeza isibalo sokuqala nesibalo esishintshiwe.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.a: Uma ibanga ngu-[0,π/3], khona-ke u-x no-π/2−x abakabhanqwa ngaphakathi kwebanga elifanayo, ngakho indlela engenhla ayisebenzi njengoba injalo.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.b: Isihlukanisi asilingani, ngakho noma wengeza isibalo esibhanqiwe, ingxenyana ayisiyi lula ibe yinombolo eyodwa.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.c: Ubone ukuthi ukushintsha u-x ngo-π/2−x kushintshanisa u-sin³ no-cos³, nokuthi isamba sezibalo ezimbili singu-1.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.d: Isihlukanisi siba ngu-0 ngaphakathi kwebanga (ku-x=3π/4), ngakho i-definite integral ayichazwanga nhlobo.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.explain: Ku-c, ibanga [0,π/2] liziphindaphinda uma x→π/2−x, futhi isihlukanisi sin³x+cos³x siyalingana, ngakho ukwengeza isibalo esibhanqiwe kunika u-1. Ngakho inani ngu-π/4. Inkinga ku-a ibanga, ku-b ukulingana kwesihlukanisi, futhi ku-d iphoyinti lapho isihlukanisi singu-0 (3π/4).

n-m-h3-est-05.title: Ukuchazela Umngane Ngokulungile Umehluko Phakathi Kwezilinganiso Zamasampula Zamadolobha Amabili
n-m-h3-est-05.goal: Uma izilinganiso zamasampula ezimbili zihluka kancane kuphela, bala izikhawu zokuzethemba ukuhlola ukuhlangana, bese ubhala kabusha isimangalo ngamagama angamemezeli ontinga, bese uchazela umngane.
n-m-h3-est-05.material: Indatshana yephephandaba lasekhaya: "Abafundi besikole esiphakeme eDolobheni A basebenzisa omakhalekhukhwini babo ngesilinganiso samahora angu-3.4 ngosuku, okude kuneDolobha B (amahora angu-3.1). Abafundi beDolobha A basebenzisa isikhathi eside." Kuwo womabili amadolobha, kwakhethwa ngokungahleliwe abafundi abangu-100, isikhathi sokusebenzisa silandela ukusabalalisa okujwayelekile, futhi i-standard deviation yesibalo sabantu iyaziwa ukuthi ingamahora angu-1.5 kuwo womabili amadolobha.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.0: Bala izikhawu zokuzethemba wena ngokwakho bese uziqhathanisa
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.1: Hlukanisa umehluko wezilinganiso zamaphoyinti nokuhlangana kwezikhawu
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.2: Bhala kabusha ukulungisa ukuze kufanelane nomuntu ozokwamukela
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.0: Isikhawu sokuzethemba sesilinganiso sesibalo sabantu esivela ekusabalaliseni okujwayelekile nge-standard deviation yesibalo sabantu eyaziwayo
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.prompt: Thola isikhawu sokuzethemba esingu-95% sesilinganiso sesibalo sabantu sedolobha ngalinye bese ufaka amanani aphindaphindwe endaweni yesithathu yedesimali (ngakho, ngamadesimali amabili). (IDolobha A: imikhawulo ephansi nephezulu; IDolobha B: imikhawulo ephansi nephezulu)
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uthole i-standard deviation yesilinganiso sesampula sedolobha elilodwa, 1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.1: Phindaphinda leli nani ngo-1.96 ukuze uthole umkhawulo wephutha, bese uyengeza futhi uyisuse esilinganisweni sesampula sedolobha ngalinye.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.explain: Isilinganiso sesampula ± 1.96×1.5/√100 = ± 0.294, ngakho iDolobha A lisuka ku-3.106 kuya ku-3.694 futhi iDolobha B lisuka ku-2.806 kuya ku-3.394. Uma ungahlukanisi ngo-√n, njengo-3.4±1.96×1.5, isikhawu sibanzi kakhulu, futhi uma usebenzisa u-z=1.645, uthola isikhawu esingu-90%.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.prompt: Ubheka izikhawu zokuzethemba ezimbili, khetha isinqumo esifanele kakhulu mayelana nendatshana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dweba izikhawu ezimbili emgqeni wezinombolo bese uhlola ukuthi ziyahlangana yini.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi inani engxenyeni ehlangene lingaba isilinganiso sesibalo sabantu sawo womabili amadolobha yini.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.a: IDolobha A lide kakhulu, ngoba isilinganiso saso sesampula sikhulu ngamahora angu-0.3.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.a: Uqhathanise kuphela osayizi bamasilinganiso esampula. Isilinganiso sesampula sishintsha kusuka kusampula siye kusampula, ngakho uma uvumela iphutha, ukulandelana kungaphenduka.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.b: Kunzima ukusho ngokuqiniseka ukuthi Idolobha A lide kakhulu; izikhawu ziyagqagqana, ngakho zingase zilingane.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.c: Amadolobha womabili afana, ngoba izikhawu ezimbili ziyagqagqana, ngakho izilinganiso zesibalo sabantu zingathathwa njengezilinganayo.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.c: Ufunde ukugqagqana njengobufakazi be-"ukufana." Ukugqagqana kusho ukuthi ukulingana kusenakho ukwenzeka; akuqinisekisi ukuthi zilingana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.d: Akunakwahlulelwa; ngabafundi abayi-100 kuphela edolobheni ngalinye, akukho ukuqhathanisa okunengqondo.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.d: Isampula elincane alenzi isikhawu singabi nalusizo. Siyakutshela ukuthi izilinganiso ziphakathi kuluphi uhla.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.explain: Izikhawu ezimbili, 2.806 kuya ku-3.394 no-3.106 kuya ku-3.694, ziyagqagqana kusuka ku-3.106 kuya ku-3.394. Ukugqagqana kuwukuhlola okusheshayo kuphela; ngokunembile, kufanele ubheke ukuthi isikhawu se-95% somehluko wezilinganiso ezimbili siqukethe u-0 yini. Lapha isikhawu somehluko siyi-cishe −0.12 kuya ku-0.72, eziqukethe u-0, ngakho kunzima ukuphetha ukuthi Idolobha A lide kakhulu. Kodwa futhi akuqinisekisiwe ukuthi izilinganiso ezimbili zilingana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.prompt: Umngane ufunde lesi sihloko wathumela eqenjini lengxoxo, "Izingane zedolobha A zisebenzisa amafoni azo isikhathi eside ngokuqinisekile kunezingane zedolobha B." Ngokususelwa ekubalweni kwezikhawu okungenhla, bhala umyalezo olungisayo ngemisho emibili noma emithathu, ngamagama umngane wesikole esiphakeme angawaqonda.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qala umusho wokuqala ngokuvuma izinombolo zesihloko (3.4 no-3.1).
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bese, ngamagama alula, qhubeka ngokuthi yiliphi ithuba ukugqagqana kwezikhawu okulishiyayo livulekile.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Isihloko sithi amahora angu-3.4 namahora angu-3.1, kodwa ...
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngamagama alula umngane wakho angawaqonda?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhulume ngokugqagqana kwezikhawu njengobufakazi bakho okungenani kanye?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uhlale ulinganisile, uthi "kunzima ukuqiniseka" kunokuthi "akulungile"?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.0: Ukuthi ngu-3.4 amahora e-A no-3.1 e-B akusho ukuthi sekusheshe ukuthi i-A ide kakhulu. Bathole kuphela abafundi abayi-100 ngamunye, futhi izikhawu zokuzethemba ze-95%, cishe 3.11 kuya ku-3.69 ye-A futhi cishe 2.81 kuya ku-3.39 ye-B, ziyagqagqana. Empeleni, amadolobha womabili angase afane.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.1: Umehluko wamahora angu-0.3 kuzilinganiso zesampula uphakathi komkhawulo wephutha. Njengoba izikhawu ezimbili zokuzethemba ziyagqagqana, kunzima ukusho ukuthi i-A isebenzisa isikhathi eside, futhi zingase zilingane.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.2: Umehluko ungamahora angu-0.3 kuphela, ngakho zingase zifane, futhi ngeke ngiqiniseke. Izikhawu ezimbili ziyagqagqana.

n-m-h3-integc-02.title: Ukwenza Imisebenzi Ehlukile ye-Cubic Nge-Definite Integral 4
n-m-h3-integc-02.topic: Ukuhlanganisa: izici ze-definite integral — ukuhambisana kwamathemu e-power engaphindwayo esikhawini esilinganayo
n-m-h3-integc-02.goal: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi ama-definite integral amathemu e-power engaphindwayo esikhawini esilinganayo angu-0 ukwakha imisebenzi ehlukile enenani elifanayo le-definite integral, bese uchaza isakhiwo.
n-m-h3-integc-02.material: Cabanga nge-definite integral yomsebenzi we-cubic f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d ku-[−1,1]. (x³ kusho x ku-cube, futhi ∫_{-1}^{1} iyi-definite integral kusuka ku-−1 kuya ku-1.)
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.0: Bheka ukuthi izingxenye zesisho ziyahambisana yini esikhawini esilinganayo
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.1: Yakha imisebenzi ehlukile enikeza i-definite integral efanayo
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.2: Hlola imigomo lapho le ndlela ingasetshenziswa khona (isikhawu esilinganayo, i-power engaphindwayo)
n-m-h3-integc-02.prereq.1: Indlela uphawu lwenani lomsebenzi luhluka ngayo ku-x no-−x
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imisebenzi i-definite integral yayo ku-[−1,1] engu-0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa isisho ngasinye sibe amathemu bese ukhombisa ukuthi yimaphi amathemu ashintsha kanjani uma ufaka u-−x esikhundleni sika-x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha isisho esisodwa i-definite integral yaso engeyona u-0 bese ubala i-integral yethemu ngalinye ku-[−1,1] ukuze uhlole.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.a: Amathemu e-power ephindwayo anenani elifanayo ku-x no-−x, ngakho awahambisani. Bala i-definite integral yethemu ngalinye kwamabili.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.b: Ubone ukuthi kunamathemu e-power engaphindwayo kuphela, ngakho amanani ku-x no-−x aphambene.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.e: Ubone ukuthi kunamathemu e-power engaphindwayo kuphela, ngakho amanani ku-x no-−x aphambene.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.c: Ithemu elingaguquki u-1 linenani elifanayo ku-x no-−x, ngakho alihambisani. Hlola i-integral yethemu elingaguquki.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.d: Ithemu lika-x liyahambisana kodwa ithemu lika-x² alihambisani. Wahlulele isisho sonke ngethemu elilodwa kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.explain: Kumathemu anamanani aphambene ku-x no-−x (x, x³, x⁵, …), indawo esobunxeleni nendawo esokudleni ku-[−1,1] ihluka ngophawu kuphela, ngakho i-definite integral ingu-0. Ku-x⁴−x² ingu-2/5−2/3, ku-x³+1 ingu-2, futhi ku-x²+x ingu-2/3, akukho kukho okungu-0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.prompt: Vumela f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d yizinombolo ezifelele kusuka ku-−20 kuya ku-20 kufakiwe) ene-∫_{-1}^{1} f(x)dx = 4, bese wenza ama-f amathathu ahlukile anethemu lika-x³ nethemu lika-x ngempela (a≠0, c≠0). Faka a, b, c, d ngalinye.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubale ukuthi uthola ini uma uhlanganisa u-ax³ no-cx ngokuhlukile ku-[−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ukhethe (b, d) ukuze isisho esisele 2b/3+2d silingane no-4, bese ugcwalisa u-a no-c ngezinombolo ezingezona u-0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Wonke ama-coefficient amane ayizinombolo ezifelele ngaphakathi kobubanzi.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ama-coefficient amane kufanele abe yizinombolo ezifelele kusuka ku-−20 kuya ku-20 kufakiwe.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma u-a engu-0, akukho themu lika-x³.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Uma u-c engu-0, akukho themu lika-x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.explain: Ku-[−1,1], ∫ax³dx=0 no-∫cx dx=0, ngakho ∫f(x)dx = 2b/3 + 2d. Uma lokhu kungu-4, khona-ke b+3d=6. Izibonelo ngu-(1,0,2,2), (3,3,−1,1), no-(−2,6,5,0). (1,3,2,2) inikeza 2+4=6, hhayi 4, futhi izibonelo ezine-a=0 noma c=0 ziyasuswa yimigomo.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ngemva kokuthola ama-f amathathu noma ngaphezulu ahlukile, ubona ukuthi i-definite integral isala ifana nakuba u-a no-c bashintsha ngokukhululeka. Chaza ukuthi kungani.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bala i-integral ye-ax³ ne-cx ngayinye ku-[−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala njengesisho ukuthi i-integral yamathemu asele isebenzisa u-b no-d kuphela yini.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uxhumanise ukuthi kungani u-x³ no-x benayo i-definite integral engu-0 ku-[−1,1] nokulingana kwesikhawu?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqinisekise ngesisho ukuthi i-integral inqunywa u-b no-d abasele kuphela?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: U-ax³ no-cx banezimpawu eziphambene ku-x no-−x, ngakho ku-[−1,1] ama-definite integral abo ayahambisana futhi angu-0. Ngakho inani linqunywa kuphela ngama-integral ka-bx² no-d, 2b/3+2d.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ama-definite integral amathemu e-power engaphindwayo ax³ no-cx angu-0, ngakho u-a no-c abakwazi ukuthinta inani. Kuphela u-b we-power ephindwayo nethemu elingaguquki u-d kunomthelela.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.prompt: Lesi sici singasetshenziswa lapho isikhawu silingana ku-0, njengo-[−1,1]. Khetha i-definite integral lapho le ndlela ifanelekile khona.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala uhlole ukuthi isikhawu sigxile ku-0 yini, nobude obulinganayo kwesobunxele nakwesokudla.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bese uhlola ukuthi ukushintsha u-x ngo-−x ku-integrand kushintsha kuphela uphawu yini.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.a: Uqaphele ukuthi isikhawu silingana ku-0 futhi i-integrand inamathemu e-power engaphindwayo kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.b: I-integrand iyimsebenzi ophindwayo, ngakho akukho kuhambisana. Bala inani langempela.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.c: Isikhawu [0,2] asilingani ku-0. Ngisho nakumsebenzi ongaphindwayo, isikhawu kufanele silingane ukuze kwesobunxele nakwesokudla kuhambisane.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.d: Isikhawu [−1,3] asilingani ku-0. Udinga ukuphatha ingxenye elinganayo nengxenye elinganayo ngokuhlukile.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.explain: ∫_{-2}^{2}(x³−4x)dx ingu-0 ngoba isikhawu silingana futhi i-integrand inamathemu e-power engaphindwayo kuphela. [0,2] no-[−1,3] abalingani, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ngokushesha ukuthi i-integral ingu-0, futhi u-x²−4 uyimsebenzi ophindwayo, ngakho awuhambisani (inani ngu-−32/3).

n-m-h3-integc-03.title: Ivolumu Eyenziwe Ngokujikisa Indawo Eseduze Kwamajika Amabili: Kuphutheke Kuphi?
n-m-h3-integc-03.topic: Ukuhlanganisa: ivolumu yesisindo esenziwe ngokujikisa indawo eseduze kwamajika amabili (isimo sesiqephu)
n-m-h3-integc-03.goal: Esixazululweni sevolumu yesisindo sokujikisa sendawo eseduze kwamajika amabili, thola futhi ulungise umugqa owenze iphutha esimeni sesiqephu, bese ukhomba ukuthi isisho esingalungile sinikeza ivolumu yaliphi indawo ngempela.
n-m-h3-integc-03.material: USoyoung wathola ivolumu yesisindo esenziwe ngokujikisa indawo ezungezwe amajika amabili y=x no-y=x² kanye ezungeze i-x-axis. (x² kusho x isikwele.)
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.0: Dweba isimo sesiqephu eduze kwephoyinti elilodwa
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.1: Sebenza emuva ukuthola indawo emelwe yisisho esingalungile
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.2: Qinisekisa iphutha ngokuqhathanisa ngqo izindawo zesiqephu
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaSoyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha iphoyinti elilodwa elinjengo-x=1/2 bese udweba ukuthi indawo ime kude kangakanani ne-x-axis lapho nokuthi inwebeka kuphi.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nquma ukuthi isiqephu esijikisiwe siyidiski eqinile noma idiski enomgodi.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.0: Amajika y=x no-y=x² ahlangana ku-x=0 no-x=1, futhi ku-0≤x≤1, x≥x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.1: Uma le ndawo ijikiswa ezungeze i-x-axis, isiqephu ku-x siyindingilizi enerediyasi u-x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 uyiwona wokuqala ohamba kabi. Uma indawo eseduze kwamajika amabili ijikiswa ezungeze i-x-axis, isiqephu siyiwashara, idiski enomgodi (irediyasi yangaphandle u-x, irediyasi yangaphakathi u-x²). Akuyona indingilizi erediyasi yayo ingumehluko wamarediyasi amabili. Kusukela emugqeni 3, ukubala kulandela isiqephu esingalungile somugqa 2, ngakho izibalo zilungile kodwa umphumela awulungile.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa ongalungile bese uthola ivolumu. Bese, usebenzisa isiqephu ku-x=1/2, chaza emshweni owodwa noma emibili ukuthi kungani isisho sikaSoyoung singalungile.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dweba isiqephu ku-x ukuhlola ukuthi siyindingilizi enkulu erediyasi u-x enendingilizi encane erediyasi u-x² isusiwe yini.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ku-x=1/2, bhala phansi bese uqhathanisa izindawo zendingilizi enkulu, indingilizi encane, nendingilizi kaSoyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale irediyasi yangaphandle nerediyasi yangaphakathi yesiqephu ku-x bese uthola indawo yaso?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhathanise indawo yesiqephu sikaSoyoung nesilungile ku-x=1/2?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.0: Isiqephu ku-x siyiwashara enerediyasi yangaphandle u-x nerediyasi yangaphakathi u-x², ngakho indawo yaso ngu-π(x²−x⁴). V=π∫_0^1 (x²−x⁴)dx=π(1/3−1/5)=2π/15. Ku-x=1/2 isiqephu esilungile singu-π(1/4−1/16)=3π/16, kodwa isisho sikaSoyoung siyindingilizi erediyasi u-1/4, engu-π/16 kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.1: Isiqephu esenziwe ngokujikisa indawo eseduze kwamajika amabili siyidiski enkulu ngaphandle kwedisiki encane, ngakho siyi-π(x²)−π(x²)², futhi ivolumu ngu-2π/15. Ukwenza isikwele somehluko wamarediyasi akufani nomehluko wezindawo zezindingilizi ezinkulu nezincane.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.prompt: Isisho uSoyoung asithola, π∫_0^1 (x−x²)² dx, yivolumu yokujikisa iyiphi indawo kanye ezungeze i-x-axis?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.0: π∫_0^1 (umsebenzi othile)² dx kuhlanganisa amadisiki aqinile erediyasi yawo ingu-"inani lalowo msebenzi." Thola ukuthi lowo msebenzi uyisiqongo sejika elimuphi.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kunketho ngayinye, bhala phansi isimo sesiqephu ku-x lapho sijikiswa ezungeze i-x-axis.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.a: Le ndawo ikhiqiza isiqephu esinomgodi, ngakho kungadingeka uhlanganise u-π(x²−x⁴). Hlola isiqephu ku-x=1/2.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.b: Isiqephu salendawo siyindingilizi eqinile erediyasi u-x, ngakho siba ngu-π∫x²dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.c: Isiqephu salendawo siyindingilizi eqinile erediyasi u-x², ngakho siba ngu-π∫x⁴dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.d: Uqaphele ukuthi le yindawo ekhiqiza izindingilizi eziqinile erediyasi yazo ingumsebenzi wesiqongo sejika u-x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.explain: U-y=x−x² okungenani ungu-0 ku-0≤x≤1, futhi lapho indawo eseduze kwaleli jika ne-x-axis ijikiswa ezungeze i-x-axis, isiqephu siyindingilizi eqinile erediyasi u-x−x². Isisho sikaSoyoung sinikeza ivolumu yalendawo (π/30), futhi ivolumu yendawo enkingeni (eseduze kwamajika amabili) ingu-2π/15.

n-m-h3-integc-05.title: Ama-Definite Integral Emisebenzi Ephindaphindwayo: Udinga Ukwazi Ini?
n-m-h3-integc-05.topic: Ukuhlanganisa: izakhiwo zama-definite integral — ama-definite integral emisebenzi ephindaphindwayo nokukhetha ulwazi oludingekayo
n-m-h3-integc-05.goal: Uma uthola i-definite integral yomsebenzi ophindaphindwayo, hlunga ulwazi oludingekayo (isikhathi, inani ngesikhathi esisodwa) nolungadingeki, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi okubalulekile ukuthi ubude bebanga buyiphindaphinda yesikhathi yini.
n-m-h3-integc-05.material: Kukhona umsebenzi oqhubekayo f. Ufuna ukuthola inani le-definite integral ∫_2^{11} f(x)dx. (∫_2^{11} i-definite integral kusuka ku-2 kuya ku-11.)
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.prompt: f umsebenzi oqhubekayo kuzo zonke izinombolo ezingempela. Khetha zonke izingcezu zolwazi ezingezansi ezidingekayo ngokuphelele ukunquma inani le-∫_2^{11} f(x)dx. (Ukwazi konke okudingekayo kwanele; ungakhethi okungadingeki.)
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Thola ubude bebanga [2,11], bese ulihlukanisa ngo-3 ubone ukuthi kwenzekani.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.hint.1: Susa ucezu ngalunye lolwazi ngasinye bese uhlola ukuthi inani lisanqunyiwe ngaphandle kwalo yini.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.a: Ibanga [0,2] alihlangani no-[2,11]. Cabanga ukuthi leli nani lizosetshenziswa kanjani enanini ku-[2,11].
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.b: Ubone ukuthi lolu lwazi lokuthi isimo esifanayo siphindaphindeka njalo emayunithi angu-3, ngakho luxhumanisa amanani emabangeni ahlukile.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.c: Iqiniso lokuthi f iyalingana kusho kuphela ukuthi ilingana ngakwesobunxele nangakwesokudla ku-0; alisetshenziselwa ukuhlukanisa u-[2,11] abe amabanga aphindaphindwayo.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.d: Ubone ukuthi udinga inani le-definite integral ebangeni elilodwa eliphindaphindwayo ukunquma lonke inani.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.e: Inani lomsebenzi ephoyintini elilodwa alithinti inani le-definite integral.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.explain: Ubude be-[2,11] bungu-9, okuyizikhathi ezi-3 zesikhathi 3. Noma ibanga lesikhathi liqala kuphi, i-definite integral ebangeni elilodwa eliphindaphindwayo iyafana, ngakho ∫_2^{11} f = 3×6 = 18. Kulokho udinga ukuphindaphindeka (b) nenani le-definite integral ngesikhathi esisodwa (d), futhi akukho okunye okudingekayo.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa ulwazi lokuthi isikhathi singu-3 no-∫_0^3 f(x)dx=6 kuphela, thola amabanga amabili [p,q] lapho inani le-∫_p^q f(x)dx lingancunywa, bese ufaka p no-q. (p no-q yizinombolo eziphelele, p akuyona ephindwe ngo-3, 0<p, 4≤q−p≤20, q≤40)
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Okokuqala, usebenzisa ukuphindaphindeka, cabanga ukuthi i-definite integral ebangeni [1,4], elinobude obungu-3, izoba yini.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha (p, q) ukuze ubude bebanga bubhakwe ngo-3 buyinombolo ephelele, bese uhlola ukuthi p ayiyona ephindwe ngo-3.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: p no-q yizinombolo eziphelele ngaphakathi kwebanga.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: p no-q kufanele babe yizinombolo eziphelele ne-0
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Ubude bebanga buphakathi kuka-4 no-20 kuhlanganise.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ubude q−p bebanga abuphakathi kuka-4 no-20 kuhlanganise.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Ubude bebanga abuyisiphindaphindo sika-3, ngakho inani alinqunyiwe.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.explain: Uma ubude bebanga buyisiphindaphindo sika-3, benziwe ngamabanga aphelele amaningana esikhathi alandelana, ngakho ngokungaguquki kwendawo yokuqala inani ngu-(ubude/3)×6. (1,7) inika 6, (2,11) inika 18, no-(4,19) inika 30. (1,8) inobude obungu-7, okungesona isiphindaphindo sika-3, ngakho inani alinqunyiwe; (3,9) isuswe ngoba p iyaphindwa ngo-3; futhi (1,4) inobude obungu-3, obungaphansi kuka-4.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani inani linqunyiwe noma indawo yokuqala p ingeyona ephindwe ngo-3.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Hlukanisa u-[p,q] abe amabanga alandelanayo obude obungu-3. Uhlukana abe izingcezu ezingaki?
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Usebenzisa ukuphindaphindeka, cabanga ukuthi ama-definite integral emabangeni obude obungu-3 [1,4] no-[2,5] ngamunye azoba yini.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlolile ukuthi i-definite integral ebangeni elinobude obungu-3 ingu-6 ngisho nesibonelweni lapho p ingeyona ephindwe ngo-3?
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi ibanga elinobude obungu-9 lihlukana libe amabanga esikhathi angu-3?
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma ubude bebanga buyisiphindaphindo sika-3, lingahlukaniswa libe amabanga esikhathi amaningana, futhi noma ukuqala kuphi, i-definite integral ebangeni elilodwa lesikhathi iyafana ngu-6. Ngakho ngokungaguquki kwendawo yokuqala, inani ngu-(ubude/3)×6.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma ubude q−p buyisiphindaphindo esithile sika-3, khona-ke [p,q] ngamabanga amaningana obude obungu-3 ahlanganiswe ndawonye, futhi ibanga elinobude obungu-3 linenani lokuhlanganisa elingu-6 noma liqala kuphi, ngakho akunandaba ukuthi p iyaphindwa ngo-3 yini.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.prompt: Kunikezwe ulwazi olufanayo (isikhathi 3, ∫_0^3 f(x)dx=6). Khetha isitatimende esilungile mayelana no-∫_2^{10} f(x)dx.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Hlukanisa u-[2,10] abe amabanga alandelanayo obude obungu-3 bese uthola ubude bengxenye esele ekugcineni.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa amanani ka-f ahlukile ahlangabezana nesikhathi 3 no-∫_0^3 f=6 (umsebenzi ongaguquki f=2 nomunye).
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.a: Kunqunyiwe: ukuphakama okuphakathi ngesikhathi esisodwa kungu-2, ngakho ngobude obungu-8 ngu-16.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.a: Uma ingahlukani ngqo ibe amabanga aphelele esikhathi, awukwazi ukubala usebenzisa isilinganiso. Leli banga liqukethe izikhathi ezingu-2.67.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.b: Kunqunyiwe: amabanga amabili esikhathi anika u-12, futhi insalela ithathwa njengo-0.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.b: Akukho sisekelo sokuthi i-integral yengxenye esele enobude obungu-2 ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.c: Akunqunyiwe: ngemva kokususa amabanga amabili esikhathi, inani lengxenye esele enobude obungu-2 alikwazi ukwaziwa.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.c: Uqaphele ukuthi ubude obungu-8 abuyona isiphindaphindo sika-3, ngakho abuhlukani ngqo bube amabanga esikhathi.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.d: Akunqunyiwe: ngoba indawo yokuqala 2 ayiyona ephindwe ngo-3.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.d: Ukuthi indawo yokuqala iyaphindwa ngo-3 akunandaba. Khumbula lokho okuhloliwe esinyathelweni sangaphambilini.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.explain: [2,10] inobude obungu-8, ngakho ihlukana yaba amabanga amabili esikhathi (ubude 6) nengxenye esele enobude obungu-2. I-integral yengxenye esele ayikwazi ukwaziwa kusukela kulwazi olunikeziwe. Isibonelo, uma f(x)=2 ngu-16, futhi uma f(x)=2+cos(2πx/3) ngu-16.83 cishe. Kokubili kunesikhathi 3 no-∫_0^3 f=6. Ukuthi indawo yokuqala iyaphindwa ngo-3 akunandaba.

n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.ok.c1: p no-q yizinombolo eziphelele ngaphakathi kwebanga.
n-m-h3-integc-07.title: Uma I-Definite Integral Incane, Ingabe Umsebenzi Mncane Yonke Indawo?
n-m-h3-integc-07.topic: Ukuhlanganisa: izakhiwo zama-definite integral — ingabe okuphambene nesakhiwo sokuqhathanisa kuyasebenza?
n-m-h3-integc-07.goal: Qinisekisa ngokwakha isibonelo esiphikisayo sakho ukuthi isakhiwo sokuqhathanisa sama-definite integral siya ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela, bese uhlunga ukuthi yini engasho kolunye uhlangothi (ukuba khona).
n-m-h3-integc-07.material: Lokhu ukucabanga kuka-Minsu mayelana nemisebenzi emibili f no-g echazwe ebangeni 0≤x≤2. (∫_0^2 i-definite integral kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-2.)
n-m-h3-integc-07.thinking.2: Sebenzisa i-contrapositive ukunquma ukuthi yini engasho ngokuqinisekile
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala lapho umqondo uphutha khona ekucabangeni kuka-Minsu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Emigqeni 1 no-2, thola "ukucabanga" ne-"siphetho" kokukodwa bese uqhathanisa ukuthi zishintshiwe yini.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umugqa 3 ukhombisa ubufakazi bokuthi umugqa 2 ulungile njalo, noma isibonelo esisodwa nje.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.0: Uma f(x)≤g(x) ku-0≤x≤2, khona-ke ∫_0^2 f(x)dx ≤ ∫_0^2 g(x)dx.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.1: Ngokuphambene, uma ∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx, khona-ke f(x)<g(x) kuyo yonke x ku-0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.2: Isibonelo, uma f(x)=x no-g(x)=3, khona-ke ∫_0^2 f(x)dx=2 < 6=∫_0^2 g(x)dx, futhi f(x)<g(x) ku-0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 uphutha. Isakhiwo sokuqhathanisa sama-definite integral siya ohlangothini olulodwa: "uma f≤g kuyo yonke x, khona-ke i-integral ka-f ingu-ngaphansi noma ilingana ne-integral ka-g." Okuphambene kwaso (uma i-integral incane, umsebenzi mncane kuyo yonke x) akusebenzi ngokuvamile. Umugqa 3 ukhombise isibonelo esisodwa kuphela lapho kwenzeka ukuthi isebenza; akuyona ubufakazi bokuthi umugqa 2 ulungile.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.prompt: Khombisa ngezibonelo ukuthi kungani umugqa 2 ka-Minsu uphutha. Kuma-f(x)=px no-g(x)=q (p no-q yizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30 kuhlanganise), thola amapheya amathathu (p, q) lapho ∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx kodwa kukhona u-x othile ku-0≤x≤2 one-f(x)>g(x), bese uwafaka.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala u-∫_0^2 px dx no-∫_0^2 q dx ngokuya ku-p no-q, bese uguqula ukuqhathanisa kwabo kube yisimo.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.1: f(x)=px iba nkulu njengoba x iba nkulu. Bhala isimo esiqhathanisa u-f(2) no-g(2) esiphethweni sebanga, x=2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.fail.c1: U-p no-q kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-30 kuhlanganisiwe.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.explain: ∫_0^2 px dx = 2p no-∫_0^2 q dx = 2q. U-2p<2q usho ukuthi p<q, futhi ukuze u-f(2)=2p abe mkhulu kuno-g(2)=q ku-x=2 udinga u-q<2p. Ngakho izibonelo ezinjengo-p<q<2p, njenge-(3,4), (5,7), ne-(10,11), ziyizibonelo eziphikisayo. U-(3,6) unika u-q=2p, ngakho u-f(2)=g(2) futhi u-f(x)≤g(x) kuyiqiniso kuwo wonke ama-x, ngakho akusona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha elilodwa kula ma-(p, q) owabhalile, futhi unikeze inani elilodwa luka-x lapho u-f(x)>g(x) namanani ama-definite integral amabili, uchaze ukuthi kungani kuyisibonelo esiphikisa umugqa 2 kaMinsu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khetha u-x oyedwa lapho u-f(x)>g(x) futhi ubhale amanani ka-f no-g lapho.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala amanani ama-definite integral amabili futhi uqhathanise ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.placeholder: isb. Uma u-(p, q)=(...), ku-x=... u-f(x)=... no-g(x)=..., ngakho ...
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Uqinisekise ngezinombolo eziqondile u-x lapho u-f(x)>g(x)?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ubale amanani ama-definite integral amabili futhi wahlola ukungalingani?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma u-(p, q)=(3,4), bese u-∫_0^2 3x dx=6 no-∫_0^2 4 dx=8, ngakho u-∫f<∫g. Kodwa ku-x=2, u-f(2)=6 no-g(2)=4, ngakho u-f(2)>g(2). I-integral luka-f incane, nokho ku-x othile u-f mkhulu, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisa umugqa 2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ku-(5,7), ama-definite integral angu-10 no-14, ngakho luka-f luncane. Kodwa ku-x=2, u-f(2)=10 mkhulu kuno-g(2)=7. Ngakho noma i-integral incane, umsebenzi awuncane ku-x ngamunye.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi u-∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx uyiqiniso. Yini ongayisho ngokuqinisekile kulesi simo?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi ukuqhathanisa kwama-definite integral kwakuyoba kuni uma ucabanga ukuthi "u-f≥g ku-x ngamunye."
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yisiphi isiphetho esisalayo uma leso siphumo siphikisana nesimo esinikeziwe.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.o.a: Kunokungenani u-x oyedwa esikhawini lapho u-f(x)<g(x).
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.a: Usebenzise i-contrapositive yesakhiwo sokuthi uma u-f≥g ku-x ngamunye, i-integral luka-f kumele ibe nkulu okungenani njenge-integral luka-g.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.b: Awukwazi ukunquma inani endaweni eyodwa ku-x=1 ngokuqhathanisa ama-definite integral. Ungakha nesibonelo lapho u-f emkhulu ku-x=1.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.c: Isibonelo esiphikisayo esakhiwe ngaphambili siyawephula lo mbono. Noma i-integral incane, u-f angaba mkhulu ku-x othile.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.d: Esibonelweni esiphikisayo, u-f(2)>g(2) ku-x=2. Kungaba nezindawo lapho u-f emkhulu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.explain: Uma u-f(x)≥g(x) ku-x ngamunye, bese u-∫f ≥ ∫g kumele kube yiqiniso. Isimo esinikeziwe u-∫f<∫g siyaphikisana nalokhu, ngakho kunokungenani u-x oyedwa onokuthi u-f(x)<g(x). Kodwa awukwazi ukuthi lowo u-x ukuphi, bangaki, noma ukuthi ikhona yini ama-x anokuthi u-f>g.

n-m-h3-integc-06.title: Ukuhlanganisa Ngezingxenye: Ungakhetha U Noma Ngayiphi Indlela?
n-m-h3-integc-06.topic: Ukuhlanganisa: izilinganiso zokukhetha u no-v' ekuhlanganisweni ngezingxenye
n-m-h3-integc-06.goal: Qinisekisa ukuthi ubunzima be-integral esele bukuya ngokuthi ukhetha kanjani u no-v' ekuhlanganisweni ngezingxenye, bese uchaza izilinganiso zokukhetha ngamagama umngane angawaqonda.
n-m-h3-integc-06.material: U-Hajun wenze ukuhlanganisa ngezingxenye ku-∫ x eˣ dx no-u=eˣ no-v'=x, futhi isibalo saba nzima. U-Hajun uthi, "Awukwazi yini ukukhetha u no-v' ngayiphi indlela ekuhlanganisweni ngezingxenye?" (eˣ ngu-e emandleni ka-x, futhi ln x ngu-logarithm yemvelo ka-x.)
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi i-integral esele ishintsha kanjani kuye ngokukhetha
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.1: Setha isilinganiso sokukhetha (iba lula uma iphuma / kulula ukuyihlanganisa)
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.prompt: U-Hajun wenze ukuhlanganisa ngezingxenye ku-∫ x eˣ dx no-u=eˣ no-v'=x. Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuchaza lokho okwenzekayo ngalokhu kukhetha?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ngo-u=eˣ no-v'=x, thola u-u' no-v wena bese ubhala i-integral ohlangothini lwesokudla lwefomula uv − ∫u'v dx.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa i-integral yokuqala ne-integral esele ubone ukuthi amandla ka-x ashintshe kanjani.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.a: I-integral esele iqukethe u-x², ngakho amandla ka-x empeleni akhuphuka.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.a: Ubone ukuthi uma u no-v' kushintshaniswa, ukuhlanganisa u-v' kukhuphula amandla, futhi ngenxa yalokho i-integral esele ingaba nzima kunokuqala.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.b: I-integral esele iba ngu-0, ngakho impendulo iphuma ngokushesha
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.b: Ukuze i-integral esele ibe ngu-0, u'v kufanele ibe ngu-0. Thola u-u' no-v wena bese uhlola.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.c: Ifomula yokuhlanganisa ngezingxenye ayisebenzi, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxazululwa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.c: Ifomula isebenza noma yisiphi isici osithatha njenge-u. Okushintshayo ubunzima be-integral esele.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.d: I-integral esele ngu-eˣ nje, ngakho iba lula kakhulu.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.d: Okusele yisiphumo sika-u'=eˣ no-v=x²/2. Thola u-u' no-v wena.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.explain: Ngo-u=eˣ no-v'=x, u'=eˣ no-v=x²/2, ngakho ∫ x eˣ dx = (x²/2)eˣ − ∫ (x²/2)eˣ dx. I-integral esele inoku-x onamandla aphezulu ngoyedwa kunoqobo, ngakho yaba nzima. Ifomula iyasebenza, kodwa ukukhetha bekungemuhle. Uma uthatha u=x no-v'=eˣ, i-integral esele ngu-∫ eˣ dx nje.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukuthola ∫ x ln x dx usebenzisa ukuhlanganisa ngezingxenye. Khetha iseluleko esifanele sokunika u-Hajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, qala uhlole ukuthi ungathola u-v ngokushesha yini.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isiphumo sika-u' no-v silula kune-integral yokuqala yini.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.a: Okulula kakhulu ukuthatha u=x no-v'=ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.a: Ukuthola u-v kusuka ku-v'=ln x akusheshi (v=x ln x−x). I-integral esele iqukethe ne-ln x futhi ayiyi lula.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.b: Okulula kakhulu ukuthatha u=1 no-v'=x ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.b: Ukuthola i-antiderivative ka-v'=x ln x kufana nenkinga yokuqala, ngakho akukho ukuqhubeka.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.c: Okulula kakhulu ukuthatha u=ln x no-v'=x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.c: Uthathe isici esiba lula uma siphuma (ln x) njenge-u nesici esilula ukusihlanganisa (x) njenge-v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.d: Akunandaba ukuthi ukhetha kanjani, ngoba i-integral esele inzima ngokulinganayo, ngakho khetha noma yini.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.d: Kuye ngokukhetha, i-integral esele ingaba lula noma nzima. Khumbula ulwazi luka-Hajun esinyathelweni sangaphambilini.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.explain: Ngo-u=ln x no-v'=x, u'=1/x no-v=x²/2, futhi ∫ x ln x dx = (x²/2)ln x − ∫ (x/2) dx = (x²/2)ln x − x²/4 + C. I-integral esele isibalo se-linear ku-x, ngakho ilula. Isilinganiso sokukhetha okuhle ukuthatha isici esiba lula uma siphuma (ln x → 1/x) njenge-u, nesici esilula ukusihlanganisa (x) njenge-v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo ku-Hajun. U-Hajun wathi, "Awukwazi yini ukukhetha u no-v' ngayiphi indlela ekuhlanganisweni ngezingxenye?" Usebenzisa ∫ x ln x dx njengesibonelo, chaza ngamagama alula ukuthi ungakhetha kanjani kahle nokuthi kungani.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ku-∫ x ln x dx, thola ukuthi yiliphi phakathi kuka-ln x no-x eliba lula uma liphuma nokuthi yiliphi elilula ukulihlanganisa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi i-integral esele iyini ngalokho kukhetha, bese uyisebenzisa njengobufakazi ozoyikhombisa u-Hajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho isilinganiso sokukhetha, emshweni owodwa, esikhundleni se-"noma ngayiphi indlela"?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usebenzise ngempela isilinganiso ku-∫ x ln x dx?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ukubhale ngamagama u-Hajun angawaqonda (hhayi uhlu lwezimpawu kuphela)?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.0: Hajun, ifomula isebenza noma ukhetha kanjani, kodwa ukuthi i-integral esele iba lula yini kuhlukile. Ku-∫ x ln x dx, kufanele uthathe u=ln x no-v'=x. ln x iba lula, 1/x, uma iphuma, futhi x ilula ukuyihlanganisa. Khona-ke i-integral esele iba ∫ x/2 dx elula.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.1: Zama u=ln x no-v'=x. Isilinganiso ukuthatha isici esiba lula uma siphuma njenge-u nesici esilula ukusihlanganisa njenge-v'. Khona-ke i-integral esele ngu-x/2 nje, ixazululwa ngokushesha. Uma uthatha u=x esikhundleni salokho, kufanele uqale ngokuhlanganisa ln x, okunzima kakhulu.

n-m-h3-prob-03.title: Iyiphi I-App Yokufunda Esebenza Kangcono?
n-m-h3-prob-03.topic: Ithuba: ithuba elinemibandela, ukuzimela nokuncika, ukucabanga kwesitayela sika-Bayes, ukusetha isikhala sesampuli
n-m-h3-prob-03.goal: Hlola ukuthi amazinga ayisiyonke namazinga ngaphakathi kweqembu ngalinye angakhomba ezinhlangothini eziphambene, uvuselele isinqumo sakho esigabeni ngasinye njengoba kwembulwa idatha eyengeziwe.
n-m-h3-prob-03.material: Ufuna ukuqhathanisa u-"amaphesenti abafundi abathuthuke emamakeni abo" phakathi kwabafundi esikoleni abasebenzise i-app u-A noma u-B. Izinombolo zembulwa esigabeni ngesigaba.
n-m-h3-prob-03.thinking.1: Uvuselela isinqumo usebenzisa amazinga anemibandela ngaphakathi kwamaqembu
n-m-h3-prob-03.prereq.0: Ithuba elinemibandela yisilinganiso phakathi kwamacala afanelana nombandela
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.prompt: Idatha ibonakaliswa isigaba nesigaba. Esigabeni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo usebenzisa kuphela lokho okwaziwa kuze kube manje.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, hlola ukuthi uqhathanisa izinga leliphi iqembu.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bala izinga eliphelele nezinga lekilasi ngalinye, bese ucabanga ukuthi iliphi liqhathanisa abafundi abasesimweni esifanayo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Esikoleni esisodwa, abafundi bakhethe i-app yokufunda A noma B bebodwa bayisebenzisa isemester eyodwa. Kubafundi abangu-200 abasebenzise i-A, abangu-132 bathuthukise amamaki abo, futhi kubafundi abangu-200 abasebenzise i-B, abangu-152 bathuthukise.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Iyiphi i-app ebonakala isebenza kangcono ekuthuthukiseni amamaki?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Izinga eliphelele libonakala likhulu ku-B. Kodwa uma singazi ukuthi amaqembu amabili abafundi anohlobo olufanayo yini, kusheshe ukuphetha lutho ngomphumela wama-app ngalezi zinombolo kuphela.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: B: ngoba iphesenti labafundi abathuthukise amamaki likhulu
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqhathanise amazinga aphelele (66% no-76%) njengoba enjalo. Lesi yisinqumo sokuqala esifika engqondweni.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A: noma bambalwa abafundi abasebenzise i-A abathuthukisile, kungenxa yokuthi ngokungaba abafundi abanenkinga abayisebenzisile
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthathe ngaphandle kobufakazi ukuthi abasebenzisi be-A bangabafundi abanenkinga. Asikwazi ukwazi ukwakheka kwabafundi okwamanje.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kusheshe ukusho: ngoba asazi ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lwabafundi olusebenzise i-app ngayinye
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uqaphele ukuthi kudingeka ulwazi olwengeziwe ngaphandle kwamazinga.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Abafundi bahlukaniswe baba ikilasi eliyisithuthuthu nekilasi elisisekelo bese kubalwa futhi. I-App A: abangu-36 kwabangu-40 ekilasini eliphezulu nabangu-96 kwabangu-160 ekilasini elisisekelo bathuthukile. I-App B: abangu-136 kwabangu-160 ekilasini eliphezulu nabangu-16 kwabangu-40 ekilasini elisisekelo bathuthukile.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje, iyiphi i-app ebonakala isebenza kangcono?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ekilasini eliphezulu kungu-36/40=90% vs 136/160=85%, futhi ekilasini elisisekelo kungu-96/160=60% vs 16/40=40%. Izinga le-A likhulu emakilasini womabili, kodwa i-B ibonakale ikhulu sekuphelele. Izinga eliphelele namazinga ekilasi ngalinye kungakhomba ezinhlangothini eziphikisanayo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: B: izinga layo eliphelele likhulu, ngakho izinombolo ezihlukaniswe ngekilasi aziphathi lutho
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Nakuba idatha ehlukaniswe ngekilasi inikeziwe, ubheke kuphela izinga eliphelele. Awusebenzisanga ukuqhathanisa phakathi kwabafundi bekilasi elifanayo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A: izinga le-A likhulu ekilasini eliphezulu (90% no-85%) nasekilasini elisisekelo (60% no-40%)
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uqhathanise abafundi bekilasi elifanayo ukuze ubheke umphumela we-app ngokwehlukile.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Cishe kufana: i-A ihamba phambili kwelinye ikilasi futhi i-B ihamba phambili kwelinye, ngakho ziyakhansela
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: I-A ihamba phambili emakilasini womabili, kodwa ukufunde njengoba i-B ihamba phambili kwelinye ikilasi. Qhathanisa izinombolo futhi.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Abafundi bazikhethele ama-app. Kubafundi abangu-200 abasebenzise i-A, abangu-160 babekwikilasi elisisekelo, kanti kubafundi abangu-200 abasebenzise i-B, abangu-40 kuphela ababekwikilasi elisisekelo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ekugcineni, iyiphi isiphetho esifanele kakhulu ukuthi sishiwo kule datha?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ikilasi elisisekelo liyiqembu elinezinga eliphansi lokuthuthuka kwamamaki noma iyiphi i-app esetshenzisiwe, futhi labo bafundi bahlangene ku-A, okwehlisile izinga eliphelele le-A. Ngaphakathi kwekilasi elifanayo i-A ihamba phambili, kodwa njengoba abafundi bazikhethele ama-app, kunomkhawulo ekuphetheni ukuthi lokhu kungumphumela we-app.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I-A ibonakala isebenza kangcono. Izinga layo eliphelele liphansi kuphela ngoba abafundi abaningi bekilasi elisisekelo bayisebenzisile; ngaphakathi kwekilasi elifanayo i-A ihamba phambili, kodwa kusheshe ukuqiniseka
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wahlulele ngokuqhathanisa ngaphakathi kwekilasi elifanayo, futhi uphinde wakhuluma ngomkhawulo wokuthi idatha ivela ekukhetheni kwabafundi bona.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: I-B ibonakala isebenza kangcono. Izinga layo eliphelele lamamaki athuthukile likhulu, kodwa kusheshe ukuqiniseka
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ulandele kuphela izinga eliphelele. Awusebenzisanga ulwazi lokuthi abafundi bekilasi elisisekelo bahlangene ku-A, okwehlise izinga layo eliphelele.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Asikwazi ukusho kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi. Ukuhlukanisa ngekilasi kuphendule umphumela, ngakho idatha yonkana ayikwazi ukuthenjwa, futhi kusheshe ukuqiniseka
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ulahle konke ngoba idatha iphenduke. Ukuqhathanisa ngaphakathi kwekilasi elifanayo kusanikeza ulwazi.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni wahlulele ngamazinga aphelele ukuthi i-B ingcono, kodwa lapho abafundi sebehlukaniswe baba amaqembu, isiphetho siphenduke. "Izinga lokuthuthuka phakathi kwabafundi abasebenzise i-app A" kanye "nezinga lokuthuthuka phakathi kwabafundi bekilasi elisisekelo abasebenzise i-app A" amathuba anemibandela ahlukene. Ukuqhathanisa, qala uhlole ukuthi amaqembu aqhathaniswayo anokwakheka okufanayo yini.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.prompt: Chazela umngane owaqale wacabanga ukuthi "i-B isebenza kangcono" ukuthi kungani izinga eliphelele likhulu ku-B kuyilapho amazinga ekilasi ngalinye makhulu ku-A, nokuthi ukuqhathanisa kufanele kwenziwe kanjani.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bala ukuthi iliphi ikilasi abaningi babafundi abasebenzise i-A nabafundi abasebenzise i-B abakulo, bese uqhathanisa.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.hint.1: Xhumanisa ukuthi abafundi bekilasi elinjani bathuthuka kalula nokuthi yiyiphi i-app abaningi balabo bafundi abayisebenzisile.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ukhombile ukuthi ukwakheka kwabasebenzisi be-A kuhlukile kwabasebenzisi be-B?

n-m-h3-prob-05.title: Izinhloko Ezinhlanu Ngokulandelana: Ingabe Sekuyisikhathi Sezingalo?
n-m-h3-prob-05.goal: Hlonza ukungaqondi kahle ngethuba ngemva kochungechunge lwemiphumela, bese ushiya umqondo ofanayo ngamanye amagama ukuze umfowenu noma udadewenu omncane osesikoleni esiphakathi akwazi ukuwuqonda.
n-m-h3-prob-05.material: Umfowenu noma udadewenu omncane ubeqoqa uhlamvu lwemali olufanele wathi, "Izinhloko zivele izikhathi ezi-5 ngokulandelana! Akusiso isikhathi sezingalo?" Uhlamvu lwemali lufanele: izinhloko nezingalo kunamathuba alinganayo. Umfowenu noma udadewenu osebangeni lesi-7.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.prompt: Uphonse uhlamvu lwemali olufanele wathola izinhloko izikhathi ezi-5 ngokulandelana. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nethuba lezinhloko ekuphonseni kwesithupha esilungile?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi uhlamvu lwemali lukhumbula ukuphonswa okwedlule noma lizama ukukuqedela yini.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi lokho esikuqagelayo kuhluke kanjani phakathi kwe-"uma singazi ukuphonswa kokuqala okungu-5" ne-"ngemva kokuba izinhloko ezi-5 zokuqala sezenzekile."

n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.a: Nakuba uhlamvu lwemali lufanele, ucabange ukuthi imiphumela eyedlule ishintsha ubuntu bohlamvu lwemali.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.b: Izinhloko zivele kakhulu, ngakho manje yisikhathi sezingalo, futhi ithuba lezinhloko lingaphansi kuka-1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi imiphumela edlule kumele "iqedelwe." Uhlamvu lwemali alukhumbuli imiphumela edlule futhi lizishintshe lihambisane nayo.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.c: Noma ngabe yiziphi izinhlobo zokuphonswa kokuqala okungu-5, ithuba lokuthi ukuphonswa kwesithupha kube izinhloko kuhlala ku-1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.d: Ithuba lezinhloko ezi-6 ngokulandelana li-1/64, ngakho ithuba lezinhloko ekuphonseni kwesithupha nalo li-1/64.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.d: Uhlanganise ithuba lokuqagela konke ukuphonswa okuthandathu kusukela ekuqaleni nethuba lokuqagela ukuphonswa okukodwa ngemva kokuba okuhlanu kokuqala sekwenzekile.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.explain: Ukuphonswa ngakunye kohlamvu lwemali olufanele kuzimele, ngakho noma sazi imiphumela edlule, ithuba lezinhloko ekuphonseni kwesithupha li-1/2. Ithuba elingu-1/64 lezinhloko ezi-6 ngokulandelana lilona inani lokuqagela konke ukuphonswa okuthandathu ngaphambi kokuphonsa; ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi izinhloko ezi-5 zokuqala sezenzekile, li-(1/64)÷(1/32)=1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukuchazela umfowenu noma udadewenu osebangeni lesi-7 "kungani ukuphonswa kwesithupha nakho kuyi-50-50 izinhloko noma izingalo." Khetha incazelo efanele kakhulu.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kuncazelo ngayinye, bhala ngomugqa owodwa ukuthi umfowenu noma udadewenu wayezothini ngokulandelayo.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ngokwehlukile ukuthi okuqukethwe kulungile yini nokuthi umfowenu noma udadewenu angakufunda futhi akuqonde yini.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.a: Njengoba izehlakalo zizimele, P(H6 | H1~H5) = P(H6) = 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.r.a: Kunezimpawu namagama amaningi, ngakho kunzima ukuthi umfowenu noma udadewenu alandele. Kuntula isinyathelo sokushintsha okufanayo ngolimi lwansuku zonke.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.b: Uhlamvu lwemali alukwazi ukukhumbula imiphumela edlule. Uluphonsa kabusha njalo, ngakho ukuphonswa kwesithupha nakho kuyi-50-50 izinhloko noma izingalo.

n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uchaze usebenzisa kuphela amagama umfowenu noma udadewenu awaziyo?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.model.0: 1/64 yithuba lokuthi zonke izinkathi eziyisithupha zibe yizinhloko, elinqunywe ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuphonsa. Manje ezi-5 zokuqala sezenzekile futhi kusele ukuphonswa kwesithupha kuphela, ngakho kuleli phonsa elilodwa, izinhloko nezingalo kunamathuba alinganayo.
