n-m-h3-vec-01.thinking.0: Ukuthola umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni lapho kuphutha khona
n-m-h3-vec-01.title: Ukuhlola Isixazululo Sohla Lwe-k Olunikeza I-engeli Ebanzi
n-m-h3-vec-01.goal: Thola futhi ulungise umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni esiguqule isimo se-engeli ebanzi sibe uphawu lwe-dot product, bese unquma ukuthi ukuhlola okufanayo kudingeka yini esimweni se-engeli ebukhali.
n-m-h3-vec-01.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaDain sohla lwezinombolo zangempela k lapho i-engeli phakathi kwama-vector amabili a=(1, 2) no-b=(k, −1) ibanzi. (k inombolo yangempela, θ ifundwa "theta," −1 ngu-"negative one," futhi a·b ifundwa "a dot b.")
n-m-h3-vec-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-dot product ne-engeli phakathi kwama-vector amabili a·b=|a||b|cosθ
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala osixazululweni sikaDain ohamba kabi.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngokuphoqelekile kowedlule, noma uyisitatimende okumele i-converse yaso ihlolwe ngokwehlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala uhla lwe-θ lapho cosθ<0, kusuka ku-0° kuya ku-180°, kufaka imiphetho.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.1: Uma i-engeli ibanzi, bese cosθ<0 no-|a|, |b| balungile, ngakho a·b<0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.2: Ngokuphambene, uma a·b<0 bese i-engeli ibanzi, ngakho isimo esiwukuphela se-engeli ebanzi ngu-a·b<0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.explain: Iqala ukuhamba kabi emugqeni wesi-3. Umugqa wesi-2 usho isiqondiso esisodwa kuphela: "uma i-engeli ibanzi, bese a·b<0." Umugqa wesi-3 uthwale isiqondiso esiphambene ("uma a·b<0, bese i-engeli ibanzi") njengoba injalo, kodwa a·b<0 ifaka wonke amacala lapho θ inkulu kuno-90° futhi ingaphezu kuka-180°, ngakho u-180° (ukuhambisana ezinkombeni eziphambene ncamashi) nakho kufakiwe. Imigqa 4 no-5 ilandela umugqa wesi-3, ngakho isiphetho asilungile. Ukubala emugqeni 1 kulungile.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa onephutha bese ubhala uhla olulungile lwe-k. Bese, uma likhona inani okumele likhishwe kuhla, bhala lelo nani futhi uchaze ukuthi ama-vector amabili abukeka kanjani ngaleso sikhathi.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthole u-k lapho b iyisiphindaphindi sangempela ku-a (ama-vector ahambisanayo).
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kuleso k, bhala uphawu lwe-a·b nezinkomba zama-vector amabili eceleni komunye nomunye bese uqhathanisa.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.placeholder: isb., a·b<0, kodwa ifaka amacala lapho ..., ngakho ...
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uthole inani lika-k lapho b ihambisana no-a?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Kuleli nani, ingabe uhlole kokubili uphawu lwe-a·b nobukhulu be-engeli?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ngomusho owodwa ukuthi kungani "a·b<0" ne-"engeli ebanzi" kungesona isitatimende esifanayo?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuze b ihambisane no-a, ku-(k, −1)=λ(1, 2) sithola λ=−1/2 no-k=−1/2. Khona-ke a·b=−5/2 ayilungile, kodwa b ikhomba ngqo ohlangothini oluphambene no-a, ngakho i-engeli ingu-180° futhi ayibanzi. Ngakho uhla lungu-k<2, k≠−1/2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.model.1: Uma a·b<0 bese 90°<θ≤180°, ngakho u-180° uyangena. Uma k=−1/2, b=(−1/2, −1)=−(1/2)a, ngakho ziyahambisana ezinkombeni eziphambene. Ukukhipha leli nani, k<2 futhi k akulona −1/2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.prompt: Usebenzisa indlela efanayo, uhla lwe-m lapho i-engeli phakathi kuka-a=(1, 2) no-c=(m, 4) ibukhali lwaxazululwa nge-"a·c>0." Khetha inani elilodwa okumele lihlolwe ngokwehlukile noma likhishwe kuhla.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala uthole inani lika-m lapho c iyisiphindaphindi sangempela esilungile sika-a.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi leyo m ingaphakathi kwamanani afeza a·c>0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.a: m=−8 yinani lapho a·c=0, okuvele kukhishwa uphawu lwe-">". Akuyona inani elisha lokuhlola.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.b: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlola ukuthi, phakathi kwamanani ane-a·c>0, kukhona yini icala lapho c ihambisana no-a ohlangothini olufanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.c: c=(8, 4) ayihambisani no-a. Yinani elijwayelekile elinikeza i-engeli ebukhali.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.d: c=(−2, 4) ine-a·c>0 futhi ayihambisani no-a. Yinani elijwayelekile elinikeza i-engeli ebukhali.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.explain: Uma a·c=m+8>0, bese m>−8. Phakathi kwalokhu, icala lapho c=(m, 4) ihambisana no-a=(1, 2) ohlangothini olufanayo ngu-c=2a, okungukuthi, m=2, futhi khona-ke i-engeli ingu-0°, okungabukhali. Ngakho m>−8, m≠2. Ku-engeli ebanzi, inkomba eyiphambene ncamashi (180°) ingena emkhawulweni, futhi ku-engeli ebukhali, inkomba efanayo (0°) iyangena.

n-m-h3-vec-02.title: Sidinga Ukwazi Ini Ukuze Sithole Ibanga Phakathi Kwephoyinti Nendiza?
n-m-h3-vec-02.goal: Hlela ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwanele nolungenele ukunquma ibanga elisuka ephoyintini liye endizeni, chaza izimo ezingenele ngezibonelo eziphikisayo, bese usetha isibalo sendiza sangempela bese uthola ibanga.
n-m-h3-vec-02.material: Ufuna ukuthola ibanga elisuka ephoyintini P(1, 1, 1) emkhathini liye endizeni α. Cabanga ukuthi ucezu ngalunye lolwazi olungezansi lunikezwa ngokwehlukile mayelana nendiza α. (I-normal vector yi-vector engqo endizeni. Ama-coordinate afundwa njenge-(x, y, z).)
n-m-h3-vec-02.thinking.1: Ukuchaza ngezibonelo eziphikisayo ukuthi kungani ulwazi lungenele
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kolwazi olulandelayo, khetha lonke lapho, uma lolo lwazi kuphela lunikeziwe, ibanga elisuka ku-P liye ku-α linqunywa njengenani elilodwa.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kucezu ngalunye lolwazi, cabanga ukuthi mingaki indiza engalufeza.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.hint.1: Uma ungathola izindiza ezimbili ezinamabanga ahlukile, lolo lwazi alwenele.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.a: Izindiza ezidlula emaphoyinti amabili zingajikijelwa ngolayini odlula kuwo, ngakho zinengeqiniso. Ibanga alinqunywanga.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.b: Iphoyinti elilodwa ku-α ne-normal vector ye-α
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.b: Iphoyinti lilungisa indawo yendiza futhi i-normal vector ilungisa ukuqina kwayo. Uqaphele ukuthi lolu ulwazi olunquma indiza ngokuhlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.c: I-normal vector isho kuphela ukuqina kwendiza. Kunezindiza ezihambisanayo ezingenamkhawulo ezinama-normal vector afanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.d: Amaphoyinti amathathu ku-α angekho kulayini oyedwa
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.d: Amaphoyinti amathathu angekho kulayini oyedwa anquma indiza ngokuhlukile. Uma indiza isinqunyiwe, nebanga liyanqunywa.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.e: Uma amaphoyinti amathathu esekulayini oyedwa, ngempela kungulwazi ngolayini kuphela, ngakho indiza ayinqunywa.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuze ibanga linqunywe njengenani elilodwa, indiza α kumele inqunywe ngokuhlukile. Indiza inqunywa "iphoyinti ne-normal vector" noma "amaphoyinti amathathu angekho kulayini oyedwa." Amaphoyinti amabili ahlukile noma amaphoyinti amathathu asekulayini oyedwa ashiya izindiza ezingenamkhawulo, futhi i-normal vector yodwa ishiya izindiza ezihambisanayo ezingenamkhawulo.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.prompt: Ulwazi lokuthi "i-normal vector ye-α kuphela inikeziwe" alunquni ibanga. Chaza ngokunikeza isibonelo sezindiza ezimbili ezinama-normal vector afanayo kodwa amabanga ahlukile asuka ku-P.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala izibalo ezimbili zezindiza ezinama-normal vector angu-(0, 0, 1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ibanga elisuka ephoyintini P liye endizeni ngayinye yezimbili bese uziqhathanisa.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale izibalo zezindiza ezimbili ngokukhethekile?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubale ibanga elisuka ku-P liye endizeni ngayinye bese ukhombisa ukuthi lihluke?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungachaza ngamagama athi "ukuqina okufanayo, indawo ehlukile"?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.0: Noma i-normal vector ifana, (1, 0, 0), izindiza x=2 no-x=5 yizindiza ezihambisanayo ezihlukile. Amabanga azo asuka ku-P(1, 1, 1) angu-1 no-4, ahlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.1: Kunezindiza ezihambisanayo ezingenamkhawulo ezinama-normal vector afanayo, futhi izindawo zazo ziyahluka. Isibonelo, z=0 no-z=3 zinama-normal afanayo, kodwa amabanga azo asuka ku-P aphuma ehlukile, angu-1 no-2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.2: Izindiza z=0 no-z=3, ene-normal (0,0,1), ziphakathi kwamabanga angu-1 no-2 ukusuka ephoyintini P(1,1,1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.3: Izindiza z=1 no-z=4 zinama-normal vector afanayo (0,0,1). Amabanga azo asuka ku-P angu-0 no-3, ngakho ayahluka.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi α idlula emaphoyintini amathathu A(1, 0, 0), B(0, 2, 0), C(0, 0, 3). Khetha ibanga elisuka ku-P(1, 1, 1) liye ku-α.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi amaphoyinti amathathu alele ku-axes ama-coordinate ukuze usethe isibalo sendiza kuqala, bese uhlola ngokufaka amaphoyinti amathathu.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi isihlukanisi efomulani yebanga yi-magnitude ye-normal vector.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.a: Cishe usebenzise inani lesikwele 49 esihlukanisini esikhundleni se-magnitude ye-normal vector √(36+9+4)=7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.b: Usethe indiza njenge-6x+3y+2z=6, wathola 6+3+2−6=5, wahlukanisa nge-magnitude ye-normal 7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.c: Cishe awukhipha ithemu eyingqayizivele yendiza 6 kunani elifakiwe 6+3+2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.d: Cishe uphutha ama-intercept 1, 2, 3 ngama-coefficient wasetha indiza njengento efana ne-x+2y+3z=1.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.explain: Amaphoyinti amathathu anesiphambuko se-x 1, isiphambuko se-y 2, isiphambuko se-z 3, ngakho indiza iyi-x/1+y/2+z/3=1, okungukuthi, 6x+3y+2z−6=0. Ibanga elisuka ku-P liyi-|6+3+2−6|/√(36+9+4)=5/7.

n-m-h3-vec-03.title: Uma Ama-Direction Vector Ehambisana, Ingabe Imigqa Iyafana?
n-m-h3-vec-03.goal: Hlela ukuthi yibuphi ubufakazi obuvela kuma-direction vector namaphoyinti emigqa emibili obuwanele ukunquma ukuthi iyalingana yini, bese uhlola wena icala lapho ubufakazi bungenele.
n-m-h3-vec-03.material:
Imigqa emithathu emkhathini ibhalwe nge-parameters t no-s. (t no-s bayizinombolo zangempela. l₁ ifundwa "l one," futhi (2, −1, 1) yi-vector enezingxenye 2, −1, 1.)
l₁: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 2) + t(2, −1, 1)
l₂: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 3) + s(−4, 2, −2)
l₃: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 4) + s(−4, 2, −2)
UMina, uHajun, uSeoyun, noDohyun benze izimangalo ezilandelayo mayelana nobudlelwano phakathi kwe-l₁ ne-l₂.
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ukuthi imigqa ifana yini noma izisho zihlukile
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwezimangalo zabantu abane mayelana ne-l₁ ne-l₂, khetha isimangalo esisebenzisa isizathu esingenamigoqo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uhlole ukuthi iyiphi inombolo ophindaphinda ngayo i-direction vector eyodwa ukuze uthole enye.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bese ufaka ama-coordinate ephoyinti i-l₂ edlula kulo efomulani ye-l₁ ubone ukuthi i-t efanele ikhona yini.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.a: UMina: Ama-direction vector (2, −1, 1) no-(−4, 2, −2) awalingani, ngakho i-l₁ ne-l₂ yimigqa ehlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.a: Ubheke kuphela iqiniso lokuthi ama-direction vector akusona isisho esifanayo. Lapho kunqunywa ulayini, i-direction vector ingabhalwa ngobude nesiqondiso (uphawu) esihlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.b: UHajun: Ama-direction vector (2, −1, 1) no-(−4, 2, −2) ayahambisana, ngakho i-l₁ ne-l₂ ngulayini ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.b: Isiphetho silungile kodwa isizathu asenele. Imigqa enama-direction vector ahambisanayo kuphela ingaba yimigqa ehambisanayo ehlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.c: USeoyun: Ama-direction vector (2, −1, 1) no-(−4, 2, −2) awahambisani, ngakho i-l₁ ne-l₂ ziyi-skew.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.c: (−4, 2, −2) ingu-−2 kaphindwe ngo-(2, −1, 1), ngakho ayahambisana. Awuhlolanga ngisho ukubala ukuthi ayahambisana yini.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.d: UDohyun: Ama-direction vector ayahambisana futhi iphoyinti (3, −1, 3) i-l₂ edlula kulo liku-l₁, ngakho imigqa emibili ngulayini ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.d: Izinkomba ziyafana futhi zabelana ngephoyinti, ngakho imigqa iyahlangana. Zombili izimo zihloliwe njengobufakazi.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.explain: (−4, 2, −2)=−2(2, −1, 1), ngakho ama-direction vector ayahambisana. Futhi, ukufaka t=1 ku-l₁ kunikeza (3, −1, 3), ngakho iphoyinti le-l₂ liku-l₁. Uma izinkomba ziyahambisana futhi iphoyinti elilodwa liyahlangana, imigqa iyafana. Ama-direction vector ahambisanayo kuphela awanele, futhi ama-direction vector angasona isisho esifanayo akusho ukuthi imigqa ihlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu, qhathanisa i-l₃ (iphoyinti (3, −1, 4), i-direction vector (−4, 2, −2)) ne-l₁. Nquma ukuthi imigqa emibili iyafana yini, bese ubhala isizathu sesinqumo sakho kanye nokubala kwakho.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.0: Fanisa ama-coordinate we-x no-y wephoyinti le-l₃ (3, −1, 4) nefomula ye-l₁ bese uthola t.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa leyo t ukubala ne-z coordinate bese uyiqhathanisa nephoyinti le-l₃.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.placeholder: isb., I-direction vector ye-l₃ ngu-... futhi iphoyinti le-l₃ ngu-...
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqale wahlola ukuthi ama-direction vector ayahambisana?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ufake iphoyinti le-l₃ efomulani ye-l₁ bese uqhathanisa wonke ama-coordinate amathathu?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uthe "imigqa ingaba nezinkomba ezihambisanayo ngaphandle kokuba ngulayini ofanayo"?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.0: I-direction vector ye-l₃ ingu-−2 kaphindwe nge-l₁, ngakho iyahambisana. Kodwa uma sifaka iphoyinti le-l₃ (3, −1, 4) ku-l₁, x no-y banikeza t=1, bese z=3, ehlukile ku-4, ngakho iphoyinti aliku-l₁. Ngakho ziyahambisana kodwa aziyona ulayini ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.1: Ngisho nangenkomba efanayo, asikwazi ukusho ukuthi bangulayini ofanayo. Ku-(1+2t, −t, 2+t)=(3, −1, 4), izibalo ezimbili zokuqala zinikeza t=1 kodwa owesithathu unikeza t=2, ukuphikisana. Iphoyinti aliku-l₁, ngakho yimigqa ehambisanayo ehlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwano phakathi kukalayini l₄: (x, y, z) = (5, −2, 4) + u(−6, 3, −3) ne-l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala uthole ubudlelwano besiphindaphindi phakathi kwama-direction vector.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.1: Faka iphoyinti le-l₄ efomulani ye-l₁ ukuze uhlole ukuthi liku-l₁ yini.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.a: Uhlole kuphela ukuthi ama-direction vector ayahambisana futhi awuhlolanga ukuthi iphoyinti liku-l₁ yini.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.b: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlole kokubili ukuthi ama-direction vector ayahambisana nokuthi iphoyinti liku-l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.c: Imigqa emibili enama-direction vector ahambisanayo ayikwazi ukuhlangana endaweni eyodwa ncamashi. Uma ihlangana, iyahlangana; kungenjalo ayihlangani.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.d: Imigqa emibili enama-direction vector ahambisanayo ayikwazi ukuba yi-skew. Imigqa ye-skew ayihambisani futhi ayinqamuli.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.explain: (−6, 3, −3)=−3(2, −1, 1), ngakho ayahambisana. Ukufaka t=2 ku-l₁ kunikeza (5, −2, 4), ngakho iphoyinti le-l₄ liku-l₁. Ngakho i-l₄ ngulayini ofanayo ne-l₁. Ulayini ofanayo ungaveza ngokukhetha kunoma yiliphi iphoyinti ne-direction vector.

n-m-h3-vec-05.title: Ukwenza Umugqa Ongahlangani Nepulani
n-m-h3-vec-05.goal: Ungacabangi ngemfanelo yomugqa ongahlangani nepulani njengemfanelo eyodwa ye-vector yesiqondiso; cabanga nangesimo lapho umugqa ulele epulanini, bese wenza izibonelo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.material: Endaweni kunepulani α: x + y − 2z = 0. Ufuna ukwenza umugqa l odlula endaweni (p, 1, 1) one-vector yesiqondiso (a, b, c) ukuze ungahlangani ne-α. (l ifundwa "el," p iyinombolo ephelele, futhi i-vector yesiqondiso (a, b, c) iyi-vector enezingxenye a, b, c.)
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.2: Ukunquma isikhundla somugqa maqondana nepulani ngezimo ezimbili
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha (p, a, b, c) ukuze umugqa l: (x, y, z) = (p, 1, 1) + t(a, b, c) ungahlangani nepulani α: x + y − 2z = 0. p, a, b, c ziyizinombolo eziphelele futhi (a, b, c) akumele ibe i-zero vector. Ukuze ama-vector esiqondiso aqonde ohlangothini olufanayo angaphindwa, isihlukanisi esivamile esikhulu kakhulu sika-a, b, c kumele sibe ngu-1, futhi noma a>0 noma (a=0 no-b>0). Yenza izibonelo ezintathu ezinama-vector esiqondiso ahlukene.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi i-vector yesiqondiso ne-normal vector yepulani kumele zibe nobudlelwano obunjani ukuze umugqa uhambisane nepulani.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ngemva kokwenza isibonelo esisodwa, hlola nokuthi iphoyinti elisemugqeni likwipulani yini.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c1: p, a, b, c ziyizinombolo eziphelele ezinenani eliphelele elingu-50 ubuningi.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c1: p, a, b, c kumele ziyizinombolo eziphelele ezinenani eliphelele elingu-50 ubuningi.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c2: I-vector yesiqondiso akuyona i-zero vector, isihlukanisi sayo esivamile esikhulu singu-1, futhi nemfanelo yophawu iyagcwaliseka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c2: I-vector yesiqondiso akumele ibe i-zero vector, isihlukanisi sayo esivamile esikhulu kumele sibe ngu-1, futhi noma a>0 noma (a=0 no-b>0).
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c3: I-vector yesiqondiso ime ngqo ku-normal vector yepulani.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Hlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-vector yesiqondiso ne-normal vector yepulani (1, 1, −2) ukuze isiqondiso somugqa sihambisane nepulani.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c4: Hlola ukuthi umugqa awuhlangani nepulani ngisho nasephoyintini elilodwa, nokuthi iphoyinti (p, 1, 1) elisemugqeni likwipulani yini.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.explain: I-normal vector yepulani ingu-(1, 1, −2). Ukuze umugqa ungahlangani nepulani, i-vector yayo yesiqondiso kumele ime ngqo ku-normal vector, ngakho a+b−2c=0. Kodwa lokho kuphela kungase kushiye umugqa ulele epulanini. Uma iphoyinti (p, 1, 1) elisemugqeni likwipulani (p+1−2=0, okungukuthi p=1), wonke umugqa ulele epulanini. Ngakho p≠1 iyadingeka futhi.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani ungasebenzisi i-vector yesiqondiso eyanelisa a+b−2c=0 uma p=1.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.0: Uma p=1, faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti umugqa odlula kulo esibalweni sepulani.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani kamanye amaphoyinti asemugqeni lapho nemfanelo ye-vector yesiqondiso isetshenziswa.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale ukuthi iphoyinti (1, 1, 1) elisemugqeni likwipulani x+y−2z=0 yini uma p=1?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ungasho yini ukuthi kungani imfanelo ye-vector yesiqondiso yodwa ingenzi isiqiniseko sokuthi "akuhlangani"?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.0: Uma p=1, iphoyinti (1, 1, 1) umugqa odlula kulo likwipulani. Futhi uma nesiqondiso sihambisana nepulani, wonke amaphoyinti asemugqeni akwipulani, ngakho umugqa ulele epulanini. Ngakho akusikho ukuthi awuhlangani nepulani; uhlangana nayo emaphoyinteni angenamkhawulo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.1: Uma p=1, (1,1,1) iyanelisa ipulani x+y−2z=0, ngakho iphoyinti elisemugqeni likwipulani. I-vector yesiqondiso ime ngqo ku-normal, ngakho wonke umugqa ulele epulanini, okwenza ube ngaphakathi kwepulani kunokuba uhambisane nayo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwano phakathi komugqa m: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 0) + t(0, 1, 1) nepulani β: y − z = 0.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubale i-dot product ye-vector yesiqondiso ne-normal vector yepulani.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.1: Faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti umugqa odlula kulo esibalweni sepulani.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.a: Kungenzeka ukuthi awuhlolanga ukuthi i-dot product ye-vector yesiqondiso ne-normal vector (0, 1, −1) ingu-0 yini.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.b: Kungenzeka ukuthi uhlole kuphela ukuthi isiqondiso sihambisana nepulani futhi awuhlolanga ukuthi iphoyinti elisemugqeni likwipulani yini.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlole ukuthi i-vector yesiqondiso ime ngqo ku-normal nokuthi iphoyinti (1, 0, 0) elisemugqeni likwipulani.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.d: Uma i-vector yesiqondiso ime ngqo ku-normal vector, umugqa uhambisana nepulani. Ukuze ume ngqo kwipulani, i-vector yesiqondiso kumele ihambisane ne-normal vector.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.explain: I-dot product ye-vector yesiqondiso (0, 1, 1) ne-normal vector (0, 1, −1) ingu-0, ngakho umugqa uhambisana nepulani. Futhi, iphoyinti (1, 0, 0) liyanelisa y−z=0, ngakho likwipulani. Ngakho umugqa ulele epulanini.

n-m-h3-vec-06.title: Ukuchazela Umnawe Ongakazi I-Cosine I-Dot Product
n-m-h3-vec-06.goal: Chaza incazelo ye-dot product (inombolo eyodwa evezwa ukuthi ama-vector amabili aqonda kangakanani ohlangothini olufanayo) kubalaleli abangayazi i-cosine, ngokushintsha isimo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.material: UJisu uchaze i-dot product yama-vector kumnawe webanga lesi-7 kanje: "I-dot product yama-vector amabili a no-b ingu-|a||b|cosθ. Uphindaphinda nje izingxenye bese uzidlulisela, futhi ingu-0 uma ime ngqo." Umnawe wakhe ubengakafundi i-cos, ngakho wabuza, "Kodwa i-dot product iyini?" (|a| ubukhulu buka-a, θ ifundwa "theta," futhi i-cos iyi-cosine.)
n-m-h3-vec-06.thinking.2: Ukuchaza nezimo zesiqondiso esiphambene nesime ngqo
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-dot product ne-engeli phakathi kwama-vector amabili
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.1: Uphawu lwe-dot product nemfanelo yokuma ngqo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umusho ochaza kahle kakhulu incazelo ye-dot product ngamagama umnawe wakho angawaqonda.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala usho ukuthi umusho ngamunye uthi umphumela we-dot product uyinombolo noma i-vector.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola umusho ngamunye ngesikhathi ngasinye ukuthi kwenzekani lapho ama-vector amabili aqonda ohlangothini olufanayo, ime ngqo, naqonda ezinhlangothini eziphambene.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.a: I-dot product iyinombolo eyodwa ebonisa ukuthi i-vector eyodwa iqonda kangakanani ohlangothini olufanayo nenye, kucatshangelwa usayizi wazo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.a: Lencazelo ibamba zonke izimfanelo ze-dot product: inkulu kakhulu uma iziqondiso zivumelana kakhulu, ingu-0 uma ime ngqo, futhi iyinegethivu uma ziqonda ezinhlangothini eziphambene.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.b: I-dot product iyikubala okuphindaphinda izingxenye zama-vector amabili ngazinye ukwenza i-vector entsha. Umphumela nawo uyimicibisholo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.b: Umphumela we-dot product awuyona i-vector kodwa uyinombolo eyodwa. Uxubanise indlela yokubala nohlobo lomphumela.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.c: I-dot product iwumkhiqizo wosayizi bama-vector amabili. Inikeza inani elifanayo noma imicibisholo emibili iqonde ndlela bani.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.c: Inani le-dot product lincike ku-engeli phakathi kwama-vector amabili. Lencazelo ayikunaki isiqondiso.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.d: I-dot product iyinani elikutshela i-engeli phakathi kwama-vector amabili ngamadigri. Uma ime ngqo, uthola u-90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.d: I-dot product ayiyona i-engeli ngokwayo. Ekume ngqo i-dot product ingu-0, hhayi u-90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.explain: I-dot product iyinombolo eyodwa encike kokubili usayizi wama-vector amabili ne-engeli phakathi kwawo. Iba nkulu kakhulu uma iziqondiso zifana kakhulu, ingu-0 uma ime ngqo, futhi iyinegethivu uma iqonda ezinhlangothini eziphambene. A uthathe umphumela njenge-vector, B ushiye isiqondiso, futhi D uxubanise nayo i-engeli ngokwayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.prompt: Manje ngokwakho bhala incazelo ozoyithumela kumnawe wakho. (1) Yichaze ngesimo sokudonsa isileji ngentambo, (2) qhathanisa ukudonsa ohlangothini olufanayo nalapho isileji siya kuyo nokudonsa ngokuma ngqo (phezulu), futhi (3) ungasebenzisi amagama anjenge-cos, θ, noma i-projection.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ucabange isimo lapho isiqondiso sokuhamba kwesileji nesiqondiso sokudonsa kwentambo kufana.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bese ucabanga ukuthi kusetshenziswa kangakanani ukuya phambili lapho ukudonsa kwentambo kuku-engeli elungile ngokuya ngesiqondiso sokunyakaza.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ushintshele esimeni umnawe wakho angasiqonda (isileji, inqola, njll.)?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhathanise isiqondiso esifanayo, isiqondiso esithambekile, nesimo sokuma ngqo?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubeke "kusetshenziswa kangakanani ohlangothini olufanayo" emagameni esikhundleni sefomula?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.0: Uma udonsa isileji ngentambo, uma intambo iqonde ohlangothini isileji esiya kuyo, wonke amandla akho aya ekuhambeni phambili. Uma intambo ithambekile, uhlobo lwamandla kuphela olusetshenzisiwe, futhi uma udonsa ngqo phezulu ezulwini, akukho okuya ekuhambeni phambili, ngakho kungu-0. I-dot product iyinombolo eyodwa ekutshela ukuthi kusetshenziswa kangakanani amandla ohlangothini aya kulo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.1: Uma ushukumisa inqola, iya kahle kakhulu uma ushukumisa ohlangothini iya kulo. Uma isiqondiso siphambuka kancane, iya kancane, futhi uma ushukumisa eceleni ku-engeli elungile, akusizi inqola ukuya phambili, ngakho kungu-0. I-dot product iyinombolo yokuthi imicibisholo emibili iqonde kangakanani ohlangothini olufanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.2: Uma udonsa intambo uyiphakamisa, akukho okusetshenziselwa ukuya phambili, ngakho kungu-0. Uma kuphelele ohlangothini isileji esiya kuyo, wonke amandla asetshenzisiwe.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.3: Uma udonsa ngqo ohlangothini isileji esiya kuyo, wonke amandla asetshenzisiwe, futhi uma kuthambekile, ingxenye kuphela esetshenzisiwe. Ku-engeli elungile, kungu-0.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.prompt: Umnawe wakho ubuze, "Pho isimo lapho i-dot product iyinegethivu siyini?" Khetha esifanele esimeni sesileji.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.0: Esiqondisweni esifanayo, esime ngqo, nesiphambene, bhala ukuthi ngasinye siyasiza noma siyakhubaza ukuya phambili.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi uphawu lwe-dot product luxhumana kanjani nokuthi lusiza kangakanani.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.a: Uma intambo idonsa ngqo ohlangothini isileji esiya kuyo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.a: Esiqondisweni esifanayo, i-dot product iyinombolo enkulu kakhulu eyiphozithivu.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.b: Uma intambo idonsiwe iphezulu ku-engeli elungile
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.c: Uma intambo idonsa iphambene nohlangothi isileji esiya kuyo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.c: Uma iqonde ohlangothini oluphambene, ikhubaza ukuya phambili, ngakho i-dot product iyinegethivu.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.d: Uma intambo idonsa ithambekile ohlangothini olufanayo ngokujwayelekile nesileji esiya kuyo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.d: Esiqondisweni esithambekile ohlangothini olufanayo, i-dot product iyiphozithivu futhi i-engeli ingaphansi kuka-90°.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.explain: I-dot product iba yinombolo eyiphozithivu enkulu kakhulu uma ama-vector amabili aqonda ohlangothini olufanayo kakhulu, ingu-0 uma ime ngqo, futhi iyinegethivu uma aqonda ezinhlangothini eziphambene. Esimeni sesileji, ukudonsa ohlangothini oluphambene kukhubaza ukuya phambili, ngakho kuhambisana nenani elinegethivu.

n-m-h3-vec-07.title: Uma Kungekho Mapulani Amabili Ahambisanayo, Amapulani Amathathu Ahlangana Ephoyintini Elilodwa Yini?
n-m-h3-vec-07.goal: Hlola isibikezelo ngezikhundla zamapulani amathathu ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ozenzela sona, bese uchaza ukwakheka lesibonelo esiphikisayo esinakho.
n-m-h3-vec-07.material: Cabanga ngamapulani amathathu ahlukene. Umngani uthe uma kungekho mapulani amabili ahambisanayo, amapulani amathathu ahlangana njalo ephoyintini elilodwa. Amapulani amabili x=0 no-y=0 awahambisani, futhi ahlangana emugqeni. (x=0 ifundwa "x elingana no-0," futhi ax+by+cz=d yisibalo sepulani.)
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.2: Ukuchaza izikhundla ngokusebenzisa ukuhleleka kwemigqa yokuhlangana
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uthole umugqa lapho amapulani x=0 no-y=0 ehlangana khona.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi lokho abakwabelana ngakho kuyashintsha yini kuye ngokuthi ipulani yesithathu ihlangana kanjani nalowo mugqa.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.a: Akuyona into eyiqiniso njalo. Kunezimo lapho amapulani amathathu engenaphoyinti elivamile
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo siphinde sacabanga ngobudlelwano phakathi komugqa lapho amapulani amabili ehlangana khona nepulani yesithathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.b: Kuyiqiniso njalo. Amapulani angahambisani ayahlangana, ngakho amapulani amathathu nawo ahlangana ephoyintini elilodwa
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.b: Amapulani amabili ahlangana ngamabili namapulani amathathu anephoyinti elivamile kuyizinto ezihlukile.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.c: Akuyona into eyiqiniso njalo. Kodwa kunezimo ezimbili kuphela: ukuhlangana ephoyintini noma emugqeni
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.c: Awuhlolanga isimo esingenaphoyinti elivamile. Cabanga ngesimo lapho ipulani yesithathu ihambisana nomugqa wokuhlangana wamabili okuqala.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.d: Kuyiqiniso njalo. Amapulani amathathu awahlangani kuphela uma amabili awo ehambisana
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.d: Lesi yisinqumo esingahlolanga ngqo ukuthi kungenzeka yini kungabi khona iphoyinti elivamile ngisho nangaphandle kwamapulani ahambisanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.explain: Amapulani x=0 no-y=0 ahlangana ku-z-axis. Umphumela uncike ekutheni ipulani yesithathu ihlangana yini nalo mugqa. Ngisho noma kungekho mapulani amabili kwamathathu ahambisanayo, kungenzeka angabi naphoyinti elivamile. Hlola ukuthi lokhu kuyiqiniso yini ngokwenza isibonelo wena.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.prompt: Kunamapulani x=0 no-y=0. Khetha ipulani yesithathu ax + by + cz = d ukuze kungabi namapulani amabili kwamathathu ahambisanayo futhi amapulani amathathu angabi naphoyinti elivamile. a, b, c, d zizinombolo ezingempela. Yenza amapulani amathathu ahlukene.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthole ukuthi umugqa lapho amapulani x=0 no-y=0 ehlangana khona ukuphi.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isibalo kumele sibe nesimo esinjani ukuze kungabikho phoyinti elisemugqeni elanelisa ipulani yesithathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Ipulani yesithathu ihambisana nepulani x=0. Hlola ukuthi i-normal vector (a, b, c) ihambisana ne-(1, 0, 0) yini.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Indiza yesithathu ihambisana nendiza u-y=0. Hlola ukuthi i-normal vector (a, b, c) ihambisana no-(0, 1, 0) yini.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Alikho iphoyinti okudlula kulo zonke izindiza ezintathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Likhona iphoyinti okudlula kulo zonke izindiza ezintathu. Hlola ukuthi iphoyinti emgqeni lapho izindiza u-x=0 no-y=0 zihlangana khona likuyo yini indiza yesithathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.explain: Izindiza u-x=0 no-y=0 zihlangana ku-z-axis. Uma indiza yesithathu idlula ngisho nasephoyinti elilodwa ku-z-axis, izindiza ezintathu zinephoyinti elivamile. Ukufaka iphoyinti (0, 0, z) ku-z-axis kunika u-cz=d, futhi ukuze kungabi nasiphi u-z esanelisa lokhu sidinga u-c=0 no-d≠0. Futhi, u-a no-b kumele bangabi ngu-0 ukuze indiza ingahambisani no-x=0 no-y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.prompt: Uthatha eyodwa yezindiza ozenzile njengesibonelo, chaza ukuthi kungani izindiza ezintathu zihlangana ngababili kodwa azinaphoyinti elivamile kuzo zontathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka iphoyinti emgqeni owenziwe ngu-x=0 no-y=0 endizeni oyenzile.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi imigqa emithathu eyakhiwe lapho izindiza zihlangana ngababili ixhumene kanjani komunye nomunye.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Umugqa lapho u-x=0 no-y=0 behlangana ngu-..., futhi indiza yesithathu ...
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Usho ukuthi imigqa emithathu yokuhlangana kwezindiza ihlelwe kanjani?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ubonise ngefomula ukuthi kungani indiza yesithathu ingahlangani ne-z-axis?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uhlukanise ukuthi zihlangana ngababili kodwa azihlangani zontathu ndawonye?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.0: Thatha u-x+y=1, isibonelo. U-x=0 no-y=0 bahlangana ku-z-axis, kodwa u-x+y=1 uhambisana ne-z-axis, futhi iphoyinti ku-z-axis linika u-x+y=0, ngakho alikwazi ukwanelisa leyo ndiza. Azikho izindiza ezimbili ezihambisanayo, kodwa alikho iphoyinti elivamile kuzo zontathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.1: Imigqa emithathu yokuhlangana kwezindiza yonke ingemigqa ehambisana ne-z-axis. Njengobuso obuthathu bohlangothi be-triangular prism, izindiza zihlangana ngababili, kodwa alikho iphoyinti elidlula kulo zonke zontathu ndawonye.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.2: U-x+y=1 uhambisana ne-z-axis. Ukufaka iphoyinti (0,0,z) ku-z-axis kuyo kunika u-0=1, okungenakwenzeka, ngakho alikho iphoyinti elivamile ezindizeni ezintathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.3: I-z-axis ihambisana nendiza yesithathu, ngakho azihlangani. Ngakho izindiza zihlangana ngababili, kodwa alikho iphoyinti lapho zihlangana khona zontathu ndawonye.
